 Manager Business Consulting \- Organizational Change Management (OCM) Job
   

  

 Date: Aug 30, 2026
   

  

 Job Requisition Id: 64406
   

  

 Location:
   

  

 Pune, MH, IN Pune, IN Bangalore, KA, IN MY RJ, IN Gurgaon, IN Hyderabad, TG, IN Noida, IN Bangalore, KA, IN Indore, MP, IN Indore, MP, IN Indore, MP, IN, 452001 Hyderabad, TG, IN Hyderabad, IN Indore, IN Indore, IN IN Hyderabad, IN
   

  

 YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
   

  

 At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
   

  

**We are looking forward to hire Organizational Change Management (OCM) Professionals in the following areas :**
* Leverage established change management methodologies and tools to execute strategic plans and support the implementation, execution, and adoption of new ways of working.
* Design and deliver effective change management strategy, approach, and plans in conjunction with the project and client team for the transformation program.
* Build relationships, establish credibility, and instill confidence in clients.
* Work with senior leadership to create alignment in order to support program success. Comfortably interact with C\-Level Executives.
* Design and develop holistic change management strategies that articulate how change will be managed throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify and deploy communication and stakeholder engagement tools and techniques.
* Deliver programs that support agile/iterative transformation.
* Conduct key change management activities such as stakeholder assessment, readiness assessment, impact assessment, communication design and execution, training plan design and facilitation, etc.
* Design and deliver material utilizing various channels of communication to drive awareness, education, and engagement across the organization.
* Design, develop, and roll\-out communication strategy and materials.
* Work with relevant stakeholders to build change management understanding and ensure buy\-in.
* Drive continuous improvements to the quality and efficiency of the change management process.
* Leverage cross\-geography insights and practitioners to enhance client service delivery.
* Participate in internal initiatives and business development efforts including proposal development, client presentations, etc.
* Lead and contribute to internal practice and organization development initiatives including culture building, internal community involvement, eminence, recruiting, whitepapers, etc.
* Continually improve frameworks and approaches along with the development of tools and methods.
* Participate in business development efforts, including proposal development, client presentations, etc.
* Mentor and guide a team of consultants to build change management skills.
* Understand key objectives for clients and YASH, align people to objectives, and set priorities and direction.


****Requirements:****
* Experience in change management – should have been a part of at least 6 change management implementations. Should have been part of end\-to\-end change management implementation lifecycle on a transformation program (prefer technology\-driven change management experience).
* Good to have a global roll\-out experience.
* 6\-8 years of experience in consulting/industry with a primary focus on change management.
* Experience in change management and employee experience in projects including stakeholder management, impact analysis, culture assessment, user engagement, and readiness assessment.
* Practical client experience including planning, design, and delivery.
* Delivering change management and training programs in a wide variety of contexts including complex ERP implementations, Digital implementations, and transformation change programs.
* Understanding of standard project methodologies and change interventions during project lifecycle phases. Nice to have experience on PROSCI or any other change management approach.
* Good understanding of IT, HR, Finance functional processes, and transformation in general.
* Excellent skills with PowerPoint, Excel, and analytical approaches.
* Ability to work and team with people across functions, sectors, geographies, and cultures.
* Good analytical, judgment, tact, and decision\-making ability along with critical thinking skills.
* Excellent oral, written, and presentation skills.
* Excellent time management skills to ensure the ability to deliver work products of the highest quality and overcome risks and issues to ensure timely delivery.
* MBA is strongly preferred.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills.
* Technology\-driven change management experience (ERP systems SAP/Oracle/Workday).
* Willingness and ability to travel for client engagements.


 At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self\-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration

* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Customer Success Manager - Scaled
description:
**About Alaan** 

 Alaan is the Middle East’s first AI\-powered spend management platform, built to help businesses save time and money.
 



  





 Our all\-in\-one solution combines smart corporate cards, real\-time expense tracking, AI\-powered automation, seamless accounting integrations, and deep financial insights\- designed to simplify finance operations and maximize control over company spend.
 



  





 Founded in 2022, Alaan is already the trusted partner of over 2000 leading businesses across the UAE and KSA, including G42, Careem, McDonald’s, Tabby, Al Barari, Rove Hotels, Rivoli, and CarSwitch. Together, our customers have saved over AED 100 million with Alaan.
 



  





 In just three years, Alaan has become the \#1 expense management platform in the Middle East\- and we’ve done it while becoming profitable.
 



  





 Alaan is also backed by Y Combinator and top global investors, including Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India \& SEA), and built by a world\-class team with experience from McKinsey, BCG, Goldman Sachs, Careem, Rippling, and other high\-growth companies. This creates an environment where employees learn from top\-tier talent while building at startup speed.
 



  





 We’re not just building software. We’re reimagining how finance works for modern businesses across the region.
 



  




**About the role** 

**Scaled Customer Success** 
 is where activated accounts become growing ones. Every account in your portfolio has cleared Implementation, has a validated spend baseline, and has been routed here based on their profile. Your job is to take that starting point and build on it: deeper adoption, higher spend, new products attached, and the right accounts identified for graduation.
 



  





 As a Scaled CSM, you own a high\-volume portfolio of accounts and your job is to move them forward. You work at scale, supported by automation, lifecycle programs, and health signals. But the instinct that drives performance in this role is not operational. It is commercial. You spot the account that is quietly stalling before it churns. You identify the spend category that has not been unlocked yet. You find the accounts that are ready to graduate and push them there. Tools assist. Judgment drives.
 



  





 This is a signal\-driven, programmatic role. Success here does not come from managing relationships across hundreds of accounts one conversation at a time. It comes from designing the right interventions, deploying them at the right moment, reading what the data is telling you, and knowing when to go hands\-on.
 



  




**What you'll do** 

***Portfolio management and growth:***



* Own a high\-volume portfolio of accounts across the full post\-activation lifecycle
* Drive GTV ramp across your book by identifying and unlocking untapped spend potential within each account
* Monitor adoption signals across spend categories, card penetration, and user growth, and intervene early when accounts stall
* Cross\-sell SuperPay and SuperCard growth opportunities where product signals indicate readiness.



***Scaled programs and automation:***



* Design and deploy one\-to\-many engagement programs: automated email campaigns, in\-app messaging, and lifecycle nudges triggered by product milestones and behavioural signals
* Build and maintain scalable resources that help customers progress independently, onboarding guides, usage walkthroughs, and self\-serve content tied to specific lifecycle stages
* Automate renewal and expansion pipelines for accounts showing strong adoption, reserving direct engagement for accounts that need it
* Implement time\-based intervention triggers for accounts that have not reached key configuration milestones within defined windows



***Health monitoring and churn prevention:***



* Track portfolio\-wide health scores built on behavioural signals: spend activity, feature adoption, category configuration, and engagement patterns
* Manage churn risk proactively by acting on signals, not cancellation requests
* Distinguish at\-risk accounts from inactive ones and apply the appropriate playbook to each



***Data and product feedback:***



* Analyse usage data across your portfolio to identify patterns, surface insights, and drive data\-backed recommendations
* Feed structured product and process insights back to the Product team regularly: what is blocking adoption, where customers are dropping off, and what signals consistently precede churn or graduation



  




**What we are looking for** 
* **2 \- 4 Years** 
 of experience in
 **customer success** 
 ,
 **account management** 
 , or a commercial role managing high volume of accounts
* A
 **hunter mindset** 
 : you are energised by growth and graduation targets, not just retention metrics
* **Programmatic thinker** 
 : you design automated lifecycle campaigns and scalable resources, not just reactive touchpoints
* **Strong data literacy** 
 : you can analyse usage patterns across hundreds of accounts, build a view of portfolio health, and act on what you find
* Comfortable working with
 **automation and customer success platforms** 
 rather than relying on manual relationship management
* Commercial instincts sharp enough to read an account, identify the opportunity, and act without being told
* **Fintech, SaaS, or payments background** 
 preferred
* **UAE market experience** 
 is an advantage



  




**What's in it for you** 
* Contribute to building the Middle East’s most beloved fintech brand from the ground up
* Benefit from a role with significant ownership and accountability
* Thrive in a flexible hybrid culture with ample work\-life balance
* Participate in exciting offsite events
* Competitive salary and equity
* Enjoy additional perks like travel allowances, gym memberships, and more

title: AI Success Manager (US East Customer Hours)
description:
**About Glean**
 Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles.
   

  

 At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
   

  

 Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
   

  

 If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more \- deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Glean is seeking an
 **AI Success Manager (AISM)** 
 for
 **US East hours.** 
 As an AISM, you will serve as the primary post\-sales point of contact, accountable for platform health. The AISM is a hands\-on role where you will lead and orchestrate successful implementations and long\-term customer engagements, making our customers wildly successful. You will be responsible for ensuring efficient technical deployment, delivering proactive strategic guidance, and building, then delivering against, joint success plans and EBRs. AISMs collaborate closely with Account Executives, AI Outcomes Managers, Solution Architects, Support, and R\&D on scoped engagements.
   

  

**You Will**
* Help our customers achieve real business outcomes through the use of AI
* Serve as the primary lead on new customer deployments including hands on guidance for the setup of SSO and connectors
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery from kickoff to go\-live through renewal, ensuring clarity on expectations, timeline, and services budget for all stakeholders.
* Create and execute joint success plans and EBRs that drive additional adoption, deepen engagement, and result in measurable business value.
* Provide overall program management.
* Develop, communicate, and execute tailored project plans; facilitate cross\-functional collaboration across delivery, operations, and technical teams.
* Provide a blend of technical guidance and strategic partnership, acting as escalation manager when necessary.
* Monitor and report on deployment progress, customer adoption, and satisfaction metrics.
* Proactively identify risks or blockers and drive resolution—escalating internally when appropriate.
* Guide and document improvements for onboarding processes, playbooks, and best practices.
* Contribute to continuous process and product improvements by providing actionable feedback and participating in internal initiatives


**About You**
* 3–5 years of experience in technical deployment, implementation management, technical customer success, or technical account management of SaaS products for enterprise customers.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycles and methodologies, including Agile and DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and related services. Certification preferred.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a focus on troubleshooting technical issues as well as building consensus around outcomes and success measures.
* Strong organizational, project management, and communication abilities.
* Proven experience serving enterprise clients in strategic, consultative, and tactical, hands\-on roles.
* Experience with process documentation, playbooks, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Solutions\-oriented mindset; trusted advisor with the capability to own escalations.
* Capable of handling ambiguity and thriving in a fast\-paced environment.


**Note** 
 : This role with require you to work in US East hours.
   

  

**Location:**
* This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)


**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
   

  

 We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
   

  

**AI\-First Mindset At Glean**
 At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work.
 **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** 
 Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.
   

  

**Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants**
 Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our
 **Privacy Policy** 
 . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our
 **Applicant Arbitration Agreement** 
 .
   

  

 By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the
 **Applicant Arbitration Agreement** 
 , and I agree to the terms.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 \- all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors \- including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Rippling is looking for a customer\-obsessed Technical Account Manager (TAM) to join our Global TAM team in Bangalore! As part of our dedicated Technical Account Management organisation, you will work closely with our rapidly scaling and maturing globally headquartered customers to understand their needs, demonstrate where Rippling can solve their problems, and help drive their adoption of Rippling’s product suite.
   

  

 You will own the key admin relationships, and be responsible for turning customers into long\-term champions, developing account strategy, and enabling Rippling’s customers, all while providing an impeccable customer experience along the way. If you are a self\-starter, find yourself constantly taking on new challenges, working feverishly until you find solutions, and pride yourself in providing an excellent customer experience, you're in the right place!
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Ensure customer satisfaction for Rippling's customers based in India and the wider APAC region, and take ownership of retaining a book of business
* Serve as a global Subject Matter Expert (SME) on the Technical Account Management team, providing support to customers expanding predominantly into Singapore and India
* Foster strong cross\-functional partnerships and represent the Voice of the Customer for APAC customer needs
* Drive increased adoption of key features, new product releases, and best practices
* Swiftly prioritise and resolve critical customer issues
* Serve as the dedicated Rippling liaison for customer questions, issues, or escalations, displaying a strong sense of urgency and advocacy to ensure prompt resolution
* Collaborate directly with customers to understand and optimise their HR, payroll, benefits administration, and IT workflows
* Master the full suite of Rippling products to provide comprehensive advice


**What You Will Need**
* 3\+ years of work experience at a SaaS company in a customer\-facing role
* Experience with payroll strongly preferred, bonus points for HRIS or other HR/HCM SaaS
* Excellent at time management, prioritizing tasks, and adapting on a day\-to\-day basis
* Proven experience with a scaled book of business
* Track record of building strong customer relationships
* Hunger to work extremely hard on a growing team
* Stellar written and verbal communication skills
* Flexibility with changing job duties and responsibilities
* Passion for enabling both customers and internal teams
* Interest in actively working with product and engineering team


**Additional Information**
 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com
   

  

 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

* **This job requires you a to work in the EST/PST shift**

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a trusted customer advocate and technical advisor. You will understand customer business requirements, translate them into integrated technology and process solutions, and guide customers through cloud adoption and transformation.
   

  

 You will provide leadership across the solution lifecycle, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and help customers deploy and optimize Oracle Cloud workloads. This role combines technical depth, customer relationship management, and program delivery expertise to drive successful customer outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, challenges, and desired outcomes, then translate them into practical solution designs.
* Conduct fit\-gap assessments and develop roadmaps for transitioning, implementing, and optimizing customer solutions.
* Define and align the functional and technical vision for program solutions with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery across requirements intake, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Guide deployment of customer workloads to Oracle Cloud, support cloud\-adoption models, and recommend actions to overcome delivery blockers.
* Align customer solutions with Oracle product roadmaps, release cycles, business enhancements, and production break\-fix requirements.
* Collaborate with portfolio management and cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, integration specialists, quality assurance, development, support, services, and third\-party partners.
* Communicate technical concepts, solution options, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support strategic planning, program direction, customer satisfaction, and successful delivery of IT solutions within agreed timelines and budgets.


**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Mandatory**
* 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing, consultative, or technology\-related role; or an equivalent combination of education and experience:
+ Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field plus 4 years of relevant experience.
+ Master’s degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field plus 2 years of relevant experience.
+ Doctorate in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field.

* 5–15 years of IT industry experience, including at least 3 years of demonstrated OCI experience.
* Strong understanding of Oracle products, including Fusion applications, OCI, and on\-premises offerings.
* Ability to translate business requirements into system, application, process, and solution designs.
* Experience leading business analysis, business\-process design, and software development lifecycle activities.
* Demonstrated ability to assess technology assumptions, identify systems, subsystems, and interfaces, and evaluate solution alternatives.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to consider broader cross\-module impacts.
* Proven customer service and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to build effective working relationships across business and IT teams in a collaborative, remote environment.
* Ability to travel to customer locations and internal sessions up to 25%.


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Relevant cloud certifications.
* One full cloud implementation lifecycle.
* Experience with IT service management.
* Experience with account management.
* Experience working with operating budgets or project financials.
* Familiarity with the CSS service portfolio across cloud and on\-premises services.


**Self\-Assessment Questions**
* Do I have experience working directly with customers to understand their business needs and translate them into technology solutions?
* Have I supported or led cloud adoption, implementation, or migration activities involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?
* Can I guide stakeholders through requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, and go\-live activities?
* Am I comfortable collaborating with technical and non\-technical teams to resolve blockers and keep a program on track?
* Can I clearly explain technical options, risks, and recommendations to customer stakeholders at different levels?


**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Regional Account Manager, Asia Pacific
description:
**Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team**
**Regional Account Manager, Asia Pacific (Remote)**
*Full time, Bangalore, India*
 In this role, you will be responsible for managing assigned aspects of client portfolio of a regional account(s) to include but not limited to client retention, contract negotiation, implementation and business consolidation, sales of products and services, financials (budgets, billing, payment and profitability), business planning and reviews, and establishing relationships with key decision makers.
   

  

**As a Regional Account Manager, Asia Pacific, you will**
* Be accountable for the regional coordination of all communication across the region, both BCD Travel and client’s global initiatives and interests
* Work with National Account Managers to create supporting regional business plans/initiatives to support the regional/global plan
* Develop business plans, implement key deliverables, and measure results
* Measure and report on a regional level: Service Level Agreement for Service, Financial, MIS/CDS, Program Performance, Technology and Communication indicators
* Assist with regional budgets and financials (includes billing, payment, and profitability)
* Build key relationships within the region and manage relationship mapping
* Support regional negotiations and measure performance
* Ensure service delivery within the region, working with Operations counterparts


**About You**
* Prior travel industry experience in an account management role
* Thorough knowledge of business travel management and travel industry technology
* Experience implementing and managing large market/ regional clients
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally on regular basis

title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 As a Principal Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a trusted customer advocate and senior technical advisor. You will translate customer business requirements into integrated solutions, assess cloud environments, identify gaps, and guide customers through cloud adoption and implementation.
   

  

 You will provide technical leadership across the full solution lifecycle—from discovery and design through build, testing, deployment, and go\-live—while coordinating cross\-functional teams to remove blockers and drive successful customer outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with customers to understand business goals, requirements, challenges, and desired outcomes, translating them into practical technical and process solutions.
* Lead fit\-gap assessments of customer cloud environments and develop roadmaps for cloud transition, implementation, and optimization.
* Define and align the functional and technical vision for program solutions with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and oversee end\-to\-end delivery across requirements intake, design, build, testing, deployment, and go\-live.
* Design secure, scalable OCI architectures, including networking, security, identity and access management, and infrastructure frameworks.
* Guide deployment of customer workloads to OCI, support cloud\-adoption models, and recommend actions to remove delivery blockers.
* Align customer solutions with Oracle product roadmaps, release cycles, business enhancements, and production break\-fix requirements.
* Collaborate with portfolio management and cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, integration specialists, quality assurance, development, support, services, and third\-party partners.
* Communicate solution options, risks, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical customer stakeholders.
* Contribute to strategic planning, program governance, customer satisfaction, service delivery, and cross\-functional team leadership.


**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Mandatory**
* 11 years of experience in a customer\-facing, consultative, or technology\-related role; or an equivalent combination of education and experience:
+ Bachelor’s degree in business, computer information systems, computer science, or a related field plus 7 years of relevant experience.
+ Master’s degree in a related field plus 5 years of relevant experience.
+ Doctorate in a related field plus 3 years of relevant experience.

* 8–15 years of IT industry experience, including at least 5 years of demonstrated OCI experience.
* Hands\-on expertise with OCI, including cloud architecture, workload deployment, networking, security, and IAM.
* Strong Terraform experience for provisioning and managing OCI resources.
* Proficiency in Bash, Python, Shell, or similar scripting and programming languages.
* Experience deploying and managing containerised workloads on Kubernetes, ideally Oracle Kubernetes Engine.
* Experience building observability dashboards and alerts with Prometheus and Grafana.
* Demonstrated experience leading business analysis, business\-process design, and software delivery lifecycle activities.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional programs, coordinate stakeholders, manage resources, and deliver solutions on time and within budget.
* Strong client relationship, service delivery, incident response, account management, contract management, and compliance capabilities.
* Excellent analytical, written, verbal, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to travel to customer and internal locations up to 25%.


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* OCI or other relevant cloud certifications.
* Experience with modern CI/CD and DevOps tools and practices.
* At least one full cloud implementation lifecycle.
* Experience supporting operating budgets or project financials.
* Deep familiarity with the CSS service portfolio across cloud and on\-premises offerings.
* Additional experience in IT service management and account management.


**Self\-Assessment Questions**
* Do I have hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting secure workloads on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?
* Can I use Terraform and scripting tools such as Python, Bash, or Shell to provision and manage cloud infrastructure?
* Have I led a customer solution through discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, and go\-live while coordinating multiple stakeholders?
* Am I comfortable translating customer business needs into technical architectures, cloud\-adoption roadmaps, and actionable recommendations?
* Have I worked with Kubernetes, cloud networking, IAM, security controls, and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana?


**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Account Manager - Securities Services
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Account Manager – Securities Services.**
**In This Role, You Will**
* Client retention – work in tandem with product management, service delivery and client management to ensure high levels of client satisfaction and a reference\-able client base. Create and maintain detailed client plans that effectively map the organizational structure and key contact points in the assigned clients. Coordinate daily checks on impacted Legal Entity Booking Instances (LEBIs) with onshore teams globally.
* Ensure proactive management of issues across all products and jurisdictions by directing the resources in each service component or jurisdiction. Capture, advocate and drive service improvement opportunities and priorities change management agendas across the business. Establish/adhere to an agreed governance framework and meeting schedules to deliver strong senior client engagement and maintain full compliance with internal controls
* Produce monthly Management information reporting and managed legacy exits and/or others via providing quarterly reporting to regional. Assisting Customer due diligence team to identify any Securities Services relationship for Know your customer renewal.
* Establish contracting parties to new accounts opened in source systems and perform reconciliation to ensure terminated fund records are removed as reflected in the source systems to assure data quality.
* The role\-holder will effectively support Client Executives and Sales Directors on new and cross\-sales initiatives for strategic clients/prospects, as well as owning commercials and maximizing profitability and incremental growth opportunities with clients. To achieve this, the role\-holder will need to forge deep relationships with key stakeholders including from the following business partners:
* Client Service Management, Client Executives, Operations, Digital \& Data, Client \& Sales Enablement, Product and Portfolio Delivery. Managing relationships with clients and other stakeholders throughout the industry will also be key to the success of the role, and will necessitate that client events are planned and attended appropriately and that client feedback and key management reporting is effectively produced and utilised.
* The role holder will also provide support to the Client Selection and Exit management (CSEM) process across designated regions for Securities Services as well as maintaining a central Client Repository for Securities Services (CRSS) to establish a single client list as a by\-product from Global Standards besides maintaining an existing database consisting of all accounts serviced by HSBC Securities Services.
* In summary, the role\-holder will ensure we attain the highest levels of satisfaction, retention and reference\-ability of the Securities Services client base. Additionally, the role\-holder will be acting as the core relationship touch point across Securities Services products for a select number of clients. Many of the Securities Services teams, including client management, are virtual and spread over multiple geographical locations, making collaboration with client and internal stakeholders a crucial component of the success of the business.


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience of Securities Services, client management, business implementation/change, business development and/or senior operational leadership experience. Client facing with excellent communication and presentation skills, including an ability to lead and manage meetings.
* Track record in maintaining and retaining client relationships across securities services products with an ability to help execute departmental strategy. Understanding of core commercial and contractual drivers and business performance.
* Proven ability to adapt to the changing demands of the industry, clients and internal stakeholders. Proven capacity to operate across a complex organization collaboratively, whilst ensuring that the agreed client/HSBC agenda is effectively managed.
* Fully proficient in understanding the regulations that drive the securities services arena and in particular those that govern client management. Sound understanding of controls, risk management (product and market) and mitigation techniques
* The role holder will ensure the HSBC values are present in everything we do, both individually and as an organization.
* This will be achieved by consistently displaying the behaviors of Client centricity \- client focus in everything we do today, and tomorrow. Leadership \& drive – mobilize, motivate and positively influence the business to drive change.
* Strong relationship understanding – tracking, managing and reporting satisfaction and reference\-ability
* Dependability and doing the right thing \- delivering fair outcomes for our customers and ensuring own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets.


**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. title: Account Delivery & Growth Director - Bangalore, India
description:
**Company Description** 
 VDart Digital is a high\-growth global digital solutions, product development, and professional services firm headquartered in Atlanta, GA, with a strong presence across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, including India. The company specializes in building next\-generation solutions and connected platforms that drive digital transformation and optimize business operations. VDart Digital delivers turnkey solutions in areas such as AI/ML/GenAI, intelligent automation, data analytics, blockchain, cloud, IoT, identity and access management, UI/UX, and full\-stack and mobile development. Its product suite includes innovations like TestSamurAI, LendSmartAI, IDocLens, VGo fleet management, Vvalidate document verification, and the V Engage employee engagement app, offering diverse opportunities for professionals to work on cutting\-edge technologies.
 



  





**Role Focus:** 
 Strategic Account Management \| Account Growth \| Delivery Leadership \| P\&L Ownership
 



  





**Role Overview: VDart Digital is seeking an experienced Account Delivery \& Growth Director** 
 to own, manage, and expand an existing strategic client account.
 



  





 This is a client\-facing leadership role with responsibility for the overall health and growth of the account, including
 **executive client relationships, account strategy, revenue growth, delivery excellence, financial performance, resource planning, governance, and customer satisfaction** 
 .
 



  





 The successful candidate will operate as the senior point of accountability for the account, working closely with client executives and stakeholders as well as VDart Digital's delivery, technology, sales, presales, finance, talent acquisition, and operations teams.
 



  





 This role is particularly suited for an experienced leader from a
 **technology consulting, system integration, or IT services organization** 
 who has successfully managed and grown enterprise accounts while overseeing complex global delivery engagements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Account Management \& Growth** 



* Own the overall strategy, performance, and growth of the assigned client account.
* Develop trusted relationships with client executives, business leaders, technology leaders, procurement teams, and key stakeholders.
* Build a deep understanding of the client's business priorities, technology landscape, transformation initiatives, challenges, and investment roadmap.
* Develop and execute annual and quarterly account plans covering revenue, pipeline, delivery, relationships, capabilities, and growth opportunities.
* Identify and develop opportunities for
 **new projects, managed services, consulting engagements, technology services, and expansion into new business units or functions** 
 .
* Collaborate with sales, presales, solution architects, and practice leaders to convert identified opportunities into proposals and engagements.
* Lead or support proposals, SOWs, renewals, change requests, pricing, and commercial discussions.
* Drive account retention, customer satisfaction, wallet\-share expansion, and sustainable year\-over\-year growth.
* Build and maintain a qualified account pipeline with clear ownership, next steps, and closure plans.



  





**Delivery Leadership** 



* Provide executive oversight for all technology programs, projects, and services delivered within the account.
* Ensure commitments are delivered according to agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, SLAs, and commercial terms.
* Establish clear delivery governance, performance measures, and accountability across onsite, offshore, and distributed teams.
* Monitor delivery health, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Anticipate potential delivery challenges and intervene before they become client escalations.
* Own senior\-level client escalations and drive timely resolution and recovery plans.
* Ensure delivery excellence strengthens the relationship and creates opportunities for account expansion.



  





**Financial \& Commercial Management** 



* Own account\-level financial performance, including
 **revenue, gross margin, profitability, costs, budgets, and forecasts** 
 .
* Develop accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue and margin forecasts.
* Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, contracts, and business targets.
* Identify and address revenue leakage, margin erosion, unbilled work, cost overruns, and other financial risks.
* Drive commercial discipline across SOWs, change requests, billing, invoicing, collections, renewals, and contractual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to improve account profitability through productivity, automation, delivery optimization, resource mix, and operating leverage.



  





**Resource \& Workforce Management** 



* Own workforce planning and resource strategy for the account.
* Forecast resource demand based on existing engagements, delivery plans, pipeline, and anticipated account growth.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, delivery leaders, and practice teams to ensure timely fulfillment of resource requirements.
* Monitor utilization, capacity, productivity, skills, resource mix, and deployment across the account.
* Ensure appropriate onsite/offshore and senior/junior resource mix while maintaining delivery quality and financial objectives.
* Support hiring, onboarding, succession planning, retention, and capability development for key account resources.
* Build a scalable delivery organization capable of supporting future account growth.



  





**Governance, Risk \& Executive Reporting** 



* Establish and lead appropriate account and delivery governance with client and internal leadership.
* Conduct periodic account reviews, steering committee meetings, delivery reviews, financial reviews, and executive business reviews.
* Maintain visibility into delivery, operational, commercial, financial, resource, and relationship risks.
* Develop mitigation and recovery plans for critical risks and ensure appropriate ownership and closure.
* Provide leadership with concise reporting on account health, revenue, margins, pipeline, delivery performance, customer sentiment, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Maintain appropriate governance around commitments, decisions, actions, and contractual obligations.



  





**Leadership \& Collaboration** 



* Lead and mentor delivery managers, project managers, technical leaders, consultants, and other account team members.
* Create a culture of accountability, customer focus, collaboration, urgency, and delivery excellence.
* Work closely with VDart Digital's technology practices and solution teams to introduce relevant capabilities and solutions to the client.
* Collaborate across sales, presales, finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, legal, technology practices, and operations.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery quality, productivity, automation, governance, and profitability.
* Develop future leaders within the account and reduce dependency on individual resources.



  





**Required Experience** 



* **12–18\+ years of experience** 
 in IT services, technology consulting, system integration, or digital transformation environments, with meaningful experience in client\-facing account and delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience
 **managing and growing an existing enterprise client account** 
 .
* Demonstrated success building relationships with senior client stakeholders and executive decision\-makers.
* Experience identifying opportunities and expanding existing relationships into new projects, services, capabilities, or business units.
* Strong experience overseeing complex technology projects, managed services, or transformation programs involving distributed global teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of
 **revenue, gross margin, profitability, budgeting, forecasting, and account\-level financial performance** 
 .
* Strong understanding of commercial constructs including SOWs, T\&M, fixed\-price, managed services, change requests, renewals, and resource\-based engagements.
* Experience with resource planning, utilization management, workforce forecasting, and onsite\-offshore delivery models.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Ability to manage multiple programs, priorities, stakeholders, and geographically distributed teams simultaneously.
* Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage difficult client situations and escalations while protecting long\-term relationships.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline. MBA is preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, ITIL, or equivalent professional certifications are advantageous.
* Experience working with North American or other global enterprise clients.
* Experience managing significant enterprise accounts within a global IT services organization.
* Experience participating in solution development, proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, commercial negotiations, and contract renewals.
* Familiarity with modern digital capabilities such as
 **AI/GenAI, Data \& Analytics, Cloud, DevSecOps, Enterprise Applications, Cybersecurity, and Managed Services** 
 is advantageous.



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




**Success in this role will be measured across four primary dimensions:** 




**Account Growth:** 
 Sustainable revenue growth, qualified pipeline development, expansion into new services and business areas, and successful renewals.
 



**Client Relationships:** 
 Strong executive relationships, high customer satisfaction, retention, and trusted\-partner positioning.
 



**Delivery Excellence:** 
 Predictable delivery, achievement of SLAs and commitments, strong quality, proactive risk management, and effective resolution of escalations.
 



**Financial Performance:** 
 Achievement of revenue and gross\-margin targets, accurate forecasting, strong utilization, commercial discipline, and continued improvement in account profitability.
 



 The Account Delivery \& Growth Director is ultimately accountable for ensuring that
 **excellent delivery creates client trust, client trust creates opportunities, and those opportunities translate into sustainable account growth.**

 Customer Engagement

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
description:
**The Company**
 CommerceIQ is building the AI platform that runs commerce for the world's largest brands. We are not selling AI demos. We are shipping
 **AI agents** 
 for content, media, and sales into the workflows of the Fortune 100 every week.
   

  

 2,200\+
   

  

 Customers
   

  

 10 of Top 12
   

  

 CPG Companies
   

  

 900\+
   

  

 Retailers Connected
   

  

 $200M\+
   

  

 Raised
   

  

 Customers include Coca\-Cola, Nestlé, Colgate\-Palmolive, Mondelez, Samsung, and Kellogg's. Backed by SoftBank, Insight Partners, and Madrona. Headquartered in Mountain View with teams across the US, India, Canada, and the UK. Pre\-IPO.
   

  

**The Role**
 We have thousands of enterprise users, proven product\-market fit across digital shelf analytics, retail media, and sales operations, and the Fortune 100 running on our platform. That part works. Now we are building something new:
 **autonomous AI agents** 
 that are already in customer hands and scaling fast. This is a 0\-to\-1 build inside a company that has the distribution, the data, and the customers to make it real.
   

  

 The AI Labs team operates as a startup within the company. It needs its own engineering leader. Someone who can recruit a world\-class team in CIQ, set the technical direction for agentic AI in commerce, and ship at a pace that matches the opportunity. We have engineering teams across the US, India, Canada, and the UK. Mountain View is the center of gravity for AI leadership.
   

  

 This role reports directly to the Founders. We ship with
 **Claude, GPT\-4, and open\-source models in production** 
 . Our engineers already write the majority of code with AI. Some things are great. Some things need to be rebuilt. The next leader will know the difference.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Deploy AI Solutions with Customers**
* Work directly with enterprise customers to implement AI agents and workflows across content, media, and sales use cases
* Customize and adapt CommerceIQ's platform to fit real\-world customer environments
* Drive rapid iteration cycles based on customer feedback and usage


**Bridge Customer Needs with Product \& Engineering**
* Translate ambiguous business problems into technical solutions and product requirements
* Provide structured feedback to product and engineering teams to improve core platform capabilities
* Identify patterns across customers and help shape repeatable product features vs one\-off solutions


**Lead a High\-Impact Engineering Pod**
* Manage a small team of engineers focused on customer deployments and solutioning
* Ensure high quality of delivery while maintaining speed and adaptability
* Balance hands\-on technical software development with ai tools like claude, cursor (\~40%) with leadership and stakeholder management


**Drive Business Impact**
* Understand customer KPIs and ensure deployed solutions drive measurable outcomes
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customer stakeholders
* Partner with GTM and Customer Success teams to expand and deepen customer value
* Close pilots


**Shape the Future of AI at CommerceIQ**
* Bring frontline insights into how AI is used in production
* Influence how CommerceIQ evolves from SaaS to AI\-native workflows and agents
* Help define best practices for deploying AI systems at enterprise scale


**What We Look For**
 This is not a caretaker role. We need a builder. Here is what matters:
   

  

**Builder with Customer Instinct.**
* Experience working in customer\-facing engineering, solutions engineering, or consulting roles
* Background in technology consulting, business consulting, or forward deployed engineering
* Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and solve real business problems


**AI Product Exposure.**
* LLM\-powered features
* AI copilots / assistants
* Workflow automation
* Understanding of how AI systems behave in real\-world production environments


**Product \& Business Thinking.**
* Ability to connect technical solutions to business outcomes
* Strong intuition for what should be productized vs customized
* Experience collaborating closely with product teams
* Business Consulting exp is a must have


**Leadership \& Execution.**
* Experience managing engineers or leading small teams
* Ability to drive high\-velocity execution in dynamic environments
* Strong communication skills across technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**Why This Role is Unique**
* You are closest to the customer problem \- not building in isolation
* You influence both product direction and customer success
* You operate at the intersection of: Engineering, AI, and Business outcomes


**Why join now:**
* **The window is now.** 
 The company has product\-market fit, revenue, and customers. The AI Labs team is being built right now. In 12 months this team will be set. The founding members will define the culture, the architecture, and the trajectory. This is that moment.
* **Real AI, not AI theater.** 
 Most companies are bolting AI onto legacy products and calling it innovation. We are rebuilding the entire platform around autonomous agents. Our agents are already in production, already in customer workflows, already making decisions. If you want to lead a team doing real AI, this is it.
* **Fortune 100 scale.** 
 Your decisions will directly affect how 2,200\+ brands run their ecommerce. The Fortune 100 uses our platform to manage billions of dollars in commerce. This is not a sandbox.


 Check out our LinkedIn page to learn more about what it's like to work at CommerceIQ!

title: Customer Success Intern
description:
**Customer Success Intern** 




  





 Location: Bengaluru (On\-site)
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time (5 Days in Office, HSR Layout)
 



  





**ABOUT CONTRAVAULT AI** 




  





 Tenders and RFPs often run to hundreds of pages, and a single overlooked clause can turn a winning bid into a costly one.
 



  





 ContraVault AI is an AI\-powered platform that transforms how organisations manage the end\-to\-end tender and RFP analysis process, from intelligent tender review, risk analysis, and synopsis generation to contradiction detection and strategic bid decision support.
 



  





 Built specifically for complex tender workflows, our contextual AI extracts and interprets critical information from both scanned and digital PDFs. Teams use ContraVault AI to uncover hidden risks, navigate non\-standard clauses, and make accurate, real\-time Go/No\-Go decisions. The result is faster evaluation, stronger compliance, higher\-quality submissions, and more confident bidding.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 As a Customer Success Intern, you will be the bridge between our customers and the people who build, sell, and support ContraVault AI. You will own customer conversations, dig into how accounts actually use the platform, and turn what you learn into better products and clearer documentation.
 



  





 This is not a shadowing internship. You will carry real responsibility from the start, and your opinions will be expected, not just tolerated.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING** 



* Be the person customers trust. Customer queries come straight to you. You will look past the surface question to understand the real problem behind it, and stay with it until it is properly solved.
* Analyse how customers actually use the platform. Work with usage and adoption data to see which features drive value, where engagement drops off, and which accounts need attention before they ask for it. Then turn that analysis into clear recommendations the team can act on.
* Turn what customers say into what we build. Gather feedback, spot the patterns in it, and carry those insights into product, sales, and engineering conversations. Interns here are expected to have opinions, and to back them up.
* Build the knowledge that helps us scale. Write FAQs, user guides, and how\-to content, and maintain a clean record of recurring issues and their fixes. Every article you write is a conversation the team never has to repeat.
* Work across the whole company. Sit at the centre of our product, sales, and technical teams, translating customer needs into requirements, and technical detail into language customers understand.



**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* Education: Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a degree in business, engineering, computer science, management, or a related field.
* Communication: Strong communication and interpersonal skills. You can explain a concept clearly and genuinely listen to what someone needs.
* Language: Proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Customer mindset: Patience, a problem\-solving instinct, and a real interest in building long\-term relationships.
* Tech curiosity: A basic understanding of SaaS or technology products, and genuine curiosity about AI, data, or workflow automation.
* Organisation: Attention to detail, good time management, and the ability to juggle several customer requests without dropping one.
* Location and pace: Willing to work on\-site in Bengaluru and comfortable moving at startup pace.



**NICE TO HAVE** 



* Comfort working with data in Excel or Google Sheets (basic SQL is a bonus) to spot trends and build simple reports.
* Prior customer\-facing experience, whether in support, sales, campus roles, or client projects.
* Some familiarity with tenders, procurement, contracts, or RFPs.
* Examples of clear written work, such as articles, documentation, or reports.
* WHAT YOU'LL GAIN
* Real ownership of customer relationships and outcomes, with work that has visible impact.
* Hands\-on exposure to how an AI SaaS product is built, sold, and supported.
* A voice in the room across product, sales, and engineering, where your insights help shape what we build.
* Transferable skills in customer success, data analysis, and technical writing that carry into any career in tech.

description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

This role focuses on delivering an exceptional customer experience by overseeing service performance, driving improvements, resolving escalations, and guiding customers across connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, IoT, SD\-WAN and other telecom services. title: Manufacturing Customer Success Manager
description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.
   

  

 We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to facilitate our customers' success by expediting task completion, reassignment, or escalation to leadership based on the nature of the request. As our second line of defense against requests languishing in queues and losing valuable delivery time, you will orchestrate task completion throughout the order/job life cycle, serving as a primary point of contact for the customer community, ensuring seamless communication, proactively addressing challenges, and maintaining clear visibility throughout the order process.
   

  

 This role requires exceptional interpersonal, queue management, and cross\-software platform expertise, paired with notable strengths in collaboration, organizational understanding, and a dedication to exceeding customer expectations and delivering organizational results. You will also contribute to the broader team by providing support, as necessary, to facilitate throughput and success during peak periods.
   

  

**How You'll Contribute**
* Serve as the primary liaison for customers, facilitating seamless communication and building trust\-based relationships throughout the order life cycle
* Orchestrate the order process by maintaining awareness of communication queues to ensure work is prioritized effectively Perform regular portfolio reviews to document progress and identify potential delays
* Coordinate with Partner Success Managers to mitigate risks before they impact customer satisfaction
* Identify technical blockers and building process issues that could stall order fulfillment
* Manage and resolve customer escalations cross\-functionally, including determining when an order should be reassigned to a different manufacturing partner and managing the implications of doing so
* Collaborate with internal Operations and Product teams to bridge communication gaps and implement solutions that keep orders on track during peak periods
* Negotiate order adjustments, credits, or resolutions resulting from quality issues or delivery misses
* Maintain accurate documentation in central databases, ensuring all case activity adheres to quality management systems and safety procedures
* Identify opportunities for process automation and provide peer support to ensure continuous coverage of Customer Success Team activities


**What You'll Bring To Xometry**
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in customer success, account management, and/or customer service, preferably in manufacturing operations
* Proven track record of successfully managing and meeting schedule commitments by managing expectations of an identified customer group
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, timelines, and documentation
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to implement solutions keeping orders on track
* Self\-starter with a take\-charge attitude and ability to independently drive project completion
* Excellent organizational skills, demonstrated ability to multitask, and understanding of our communication platform's interface while tenaciously working to meet deadlines
* Superior verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively manage relationships with all stakeholders
* Excellent attention to detail and collaboration skills
* Proficiency in ERP tools and communication software
* Experience with quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001\)
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and high\-growth environment
* Experience working with Xometry's digital marketplace or similar platforms is a plus
* Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Google Sheets) is a plus
* Experience working in a manufacturing environment is a plus


**Conditions**
**Language Skills**
 English C1\+
   

  

**Holiday Calendar**
 USA holidays
   

  

**Time Zone**
 Eastern Time \- USA
   

  

**Benefits**
 Competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package
   

  

 Health and life insurance
   

  

 Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick leave, and floating and fixed holidays
   

  

 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and other wellbeing resources
   

  

**Team Spirit and Friendly Atmosphere:** 
 We work in an open, friendly, and trusting environment that welcomes initiative. In the Xometry team, everyone is ready to help and support in difficult times, and we always celebrate victories together and appreciate the contribution of everyone.
   

  

**Development Opportunities:** 
 We are a fast\-growing company, and each new task is an interesting challenge for the team.
   

  

**We Care:** 
 We offer ongoing, free of charge well\-being activities for our people and charity projects worldwide.
   

  

**Flexibility:** 
 Speed and flexibility are some of our advantages, allowing us to achieve amazing results. We have flexible processes and planning, we can respond to rapidly changing conditions, and we remain effective in the face of uncertainty.
   

  

**Onboarding:** 
 We provide a well\-structured onboarding plan for new employees, combining all process, technology, and systems components into one.
   

  

 Apply now and become part of our journey!
   

  

 \#Promoted
   

  

 Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
   

  

 Please read our privacy policy here.

title: Senior Manager - Customer Success
description:
**About Flipkart Commerce Cloud:** 




  





 Flipkart Commerce Cloud (FCC) offers cutting\-edge, composable commerce solutions designed to make enterprise digital commerce easy, scalable, and profitable. Our offerings include a headless and composable retail tech stack, a robust consumer experience suite, advanced seller ecosystem management, and end\-to\-end supply chain management.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 The Senior Manager, Customer Success drives enterprise account health, platform adoption, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and value realization as FCC’s primary executive bridge and first line of escalation. While Program Delivery leads and Group Product Managers (GPMs) own execution schedules, you will enforce scope guardrails, protect product integrity, and safeguard critical delivery milestones. You will own the full customer lifecycle—running structured governance rhythms (VRCIs, MBRs, QBRs, EBRs), building client champions, leading renewal negotiations with procurement, forecasting churn/growth risks, qualifying upsells for Sales, and aligning client Annual Operating Plans (AOP) with FCC’s product roadmap to drive measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 ●
 **Executive Governance \& Operating Rhythms:** 
 Establish high\-touch governance with client leadership via Weekly/Bi\-Weekly Value Realization Check\-ins (VRCIs), Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and Executive Business Reviews (EBRs).
 



 ●
 **Value Realization \& Champion Building:** 
 Ensure client business metrics are met, converting client executives into long\-term FCC champions while driving deep platform adoption among daily practitioners.
 



**● NPS \& Health Scoring:** 
 Own Net Promoter Score (NPS) programs, track client sentiment proactively, execute Customer Success Plans (CSPs), and lead risk mitigation for at\-risk accounts.
 



**● Renewals, Churn Forecasting \& Procurement:** 
 Own the account renewal strategy. Accurately forecast churn and growth risks, and lead renewal negotiations directly with client procurement and executive leadership to defend Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR).
 



**● Upsell Qualification \& Expansion:** 
 Identify expansion opportunities, lead initial upsell\-qualifying conversations with executive sponsors, and hand off qualified leads to Sales for execution.
 



**● Client AOP \& Product Roadmap Alignment:** 
 Drive client Annual Operating Plan (AOP) conversations and feed strategic needs to Product teams. Partner with Product leads on Quarterly Release Demos and Roadmap updates to keep clients aligned with FCC’s module evolution.
 



 ●
 **Multi\-Product Adoption across FCC Suite:** 
 Drive value realization across FCC’s full composable stack: Catalog \& Headless Commerce, OMS \& Supply Chain, Pricing \& Offer Engines, Retail Media Networks (RMN), and Seller Ecosystem Management.
 



**● Scope Governance \& Guardrails:** 
 Partner with Program Delivery and GPMs to monitor critical path health. Act as an escalation point to manage client scope expectations, protect product boundaries, and safeguard go\-live gates.
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




  





 ● Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, IT, Computer Science, or a related field. ● 6–8\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Technical Program Management within enterprise SaaS, digital commerce, or retail tech.
 



 ● Proven track record of managing $M\+ Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) accounts, driving renewals, forecasting churn, and qualifying upsells.
 



 ● Direct experience negotiating renewals with enterprise procurement teams and C\-suite sponsors. ● Working knowledge of modular e\-commerce stacks (headless commerce, OMS, dynamic pricing, retail ad\-tech, supply chain).
 



 ● Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
 



 ● Willingness to travel as needed for client QBRs, EBRs, and executive on\-site sessions.
 



  





**Required Skills:** 




  





**● CS Rhythms \& Retention:** 
 Expertise in VRCIs, Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), NPS programs, and Customer Success Plans (CSPs).
 



**● Commercial \& Renewal Rigor:** 
 Proficiency in churn/growth forecasting, procurement negotiations, Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) defense, and upsell qualification.
 



**● Value Coaching \& Adoption:** 
 Ability to drive practitioner\-level adoption, build executive champions, and demonstrate clear ROI.
 



**● Strategic AOP \& Roadmap Alignment:** 
 Skill in mapping client Annual Operating Plans (AOP) to FCC product roadmaps and driving quarterly release demos.
 



**● FCC Product Domain:** 
 Functional understanding across Headless Commerce, Catalog (PIM), OMS, Dynamic Pricing, Offer Engines, Retail Media, Seller Ecosystems, and Supply Chain.
 



**● Scope Guardrails \& Escalation:** 
 Mastery in setting firm boundaries with client leads, mitigating scope creep, and managing go\-live risks.
 



  





**Why Join Us:** 




  





 At Flipkart Commerce Cloud, you'll be part of a dynamic team that's reshaping the future of digital commerce. We offer a collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to drive real\-world impact in a culture built on collaboration, autonomy, and technical excellence.
