title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Vectra® is the leader in AI\-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi\-cloud enterprises.
   

  

 The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber\-attacks. With 35 patents in AI\-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www.vectra.ai.
   

  

 Vectra® is the leader in AI\-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi\-cloud enterprises.
   

  

 The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber\-attacks. With 35 patents in AI\-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www.vectra.ai.
   

  

**Technical Account Manager**
**Your Role:** 
  

  

 The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a critical role at Vectra and is responsible for developing and managing Vectra's customers in an assigned region. You will own the relationships with your customers, connecting with key business executives, security and IT stakeholders to develop an understanding of their strategic business needs and goals.
   

  

**Your Impact:** 
  

  

 Leveraging this customer knowledge and your expertise in Vectra products and cybersecurity, you will provide an ongoing adoption and industry best practices strategy to ensure your customers understand and maximize value from their investment in Vectra.
   

  

 This role demands interaction with enterprises at the senior level (CISO), as well as with technical staff within the IT and Security organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities:** 
  

  

* Drive high touch customer success focusing on large and highly complex enterprise organizations
* Lead customers throughout the entire customer journey: onboarding, value realization, adoption and expansion
* Own the customer relationship, providing ongoing support and proactive leadership to Vectra's customers, to drive high levels of customer satisfaction, deep engagement, and mutual success.
* Conduct customer touchpoints, executive business reviews and proactively monitor customer health
* Drive deep integration of the Vectra Cognito platform into our customer's business processes and technical ecosystem to create and increase stickiness.
* Identify and grow expansion opportunities within the customer base and collaborate with the sales team to facilitate growth attainment.
* Identify and assess renewal risks; develop and collaborate with internal teams in executing the remediation plans.
* Direct crisis and incident response with urgency, working cross\-functionally to ensure timely resolution while communicating effectively with customers.
* Identify, develop and implement repeatable programs and processes across your portfolio of customers to maximize product adoption and usage and achievement of customer's business objectives.
* Track, measure and report on key metrics such as: customer satisfaction, customer health score, adoption rates, etc.
* Able and willing to travel for on\-site customer visits as required (25\- 50%)


**Requirements:** 
  

  

 Successful candidates will have a solid technical foundation in network security and enterprise software, a proven track record of successfully interfacing with customers on both technical and non\-technical levels, strong business acumen and sales experience, and above all a passion for ensuring a top quality customer experience.
   

  

* A minimum of 5 years of experience in enterprise subscription\-based vendors in a customer\-facing role (such as Technical Account Manager \- TAM, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, or Strategic Customer Service)
* Role must be based in Bangalore and willing to regularly go to the office (Hybrid) and occasionally as needed travel to customer site.
* Extensive experience as a hands\-on CSM or TAM supporting high touch enterprise customers (Fortune 500 or other large companies)
* Strong experience of security product lines (firewalls, sandboxing, SIEM, forensics\-type platforms)
* Strong Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, VPN and SSL technology
* Strong understanding of current security technologies and risks
* Project management skills with a high attention to detail
* Experience in supporting customers with strong empathy AND passion for revenue and growth
* Proven record of establishing and building successful C\-level relationships
* Service management minded with strong commitment to customer service
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, both verbal and written
* Excellent organizational, analytical, negotiation, and influence skills
* Relevant Bachelor's degree; preference for computer science or related degrees
* Demonstrated ability to use AI\-enabled tools to improve productivity, quality, decision\-making, and customer outcomes—for example, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot and AI\-enabled analytics tools.
* Comfortable using AI for practical work such as drafting customer communications, summarizing cases, analyzing trends, preparing reports, researching technical issues, and automating routine workflows.
* Able to critically validate AI\-generated outputs, apply sound judgment, and protect confidential and customer information.
* Identifies opportunities to responsibly embed AI and automation into team processes and supports adoption of approved tools.


 Vectra provides a comprehensive total rewards package that supports the financial, physical, mental and overall health of our employees and their families.  Customer Success / Customer Excellence

 Head of Customer Success

 Remote / Hybrid

 Periodic travel to customer sites, industry events, and internal planning sessions
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Customer Excellence Manager (CEM) is responsible for helping strategic customers achieve measurable business and engineering outcomes through successful adoption of our simulation and engineering software solutions.
   

  

 The CEM serves as the trusted advisor and primary post\-sales relationship owner, developing customer success plans, driving adoption initiatives, monitoring customer health and sentiment, and ensuring customers realize maximum value from their investment.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong CAE and engineering software knowledge with customer engagement, strategic account management, stakeholder alignment, and business acumen. This role requires close collaboration with Sales, Application Engineering, Support, Product Management, and Marketing teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes while supporting retention and long\-term account growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Customer Success \& Value Realization: Own customer success outcomes by driving product adoption, value realization, and achievement of customer business and engineering objectives throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Strategic Customer Engagement: Build trusted relationships with technical, management, and executive stakeholders, serving as a strategic advisor and advocate for customer success.
* Customer Health \& Retention: Monitor customer health, adoption trends, and sentiment to proactively identify risks, develop recovery plans, and support long\-term customer retention.
* Account Planning \& Growth: Collaborate with Sales and Account Teams to contribute customer insights, support account planning activities, and identify opportunities for product adoption, expansion, and growth.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Coordinate activities across Sales, Application Engineering, Support, Product Management, Professional Services, and Marketing to ensure successful customer outcomes.
* Voice of the Customer: Represent customer needs and feedback within the organization, helping influence product priorities, adoption strategies, and customer experience improvements.
* Executive Business Reviews \& Governance: Lead customer governance discussions and business reviews that demonstrate value, align stakeholders, identify opportunities, and strengthen strategic relationships.
* Customer Advocacy: Develop customer champions and advocates who can participate in reference programs, industry events, case studies, and other strategic engagement initiatives.


**Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Business Development, Application Engineering, Technical Consulting, Pre\-Sales, or Account Management within engineering software, CAE, simulation, PLM, CAD, or related technology industries.
* Experience managing strategic customer relationships and driving long\-term adoption programs.
* Experience conducting customer reviews, executive engagements, and technical discussions with multiple stakeholder levels.
* Proven history of supporting customer retention, adoption growth, and business expansion initiatives.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong customer\-centric mindset.
* Strategic account planning and stakeholder management.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to enhance customer engagement, adoption, reporting, and productivity.
* Executive communication and presentation skills.
* Customer health and sentiment management.
* Value realization and adoption planning.
* Cross\-functional leadership and influence without authority.
* Analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong business and commercial acumen.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


 Tools \& Platforms
   

  

* CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight.
* Bring AI expertise
* Customer adoption and engagement analytics tools.
* Microsoft Office and collaboration platforms.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Customer Outcomes: Achievement of customer success plan objectives; customer adoption and utilization growth; successful onboarding and adoption milestones.
* Customer Health: Customer health score improvements; customer sentiment and relationship strength; risk identification and mitigation effectiveness.
* Retention \& Growth: Customer retention rate; contribution to Net Revenue Retention (NRR); expansion opportunities identified and supported; renewal readiness and account stability.
* Customer Advocacy: Customer references and success stories generated; product feedback submitted and acted upon; participation in advocacy and community initiatives.
* Operational \& Reporting: Accurate customer planning, reporting, and cross\-functional execution.


 Ideal Candidate Profile
   

  

**A successful candidate will be a technically credible CAE professional who can build trusted relationships, drive customer adoption, influence cross\-functional teams, manage customer sentiment, contribute to account planning, and identify business growth opportunities while ensuring customers achieve measurable engineering and business outcomes.**
**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Partner Growth Manager – Agencies

We are looking for a Partner Growth Manager – Agencies whose job is to turn our agency partnerships into a consistent source of pipeline and revenue. This is not a traditional partnerships role focused on signing agreements and maintaining relationships. You will work closely with our agency partners after the partnership is established, identify opportunities across their client portfolio, enable their teams to position Zigment, and jointly take solutions to market. You should be commercially strong, comfortable working with senior agency teams, and understand performance marketing and MarTech well enough to identify where customer journeys are breaking and where Zigment can create measurable impact.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Service Delivery Manager to lead service operations, manage customer relationships, ensure SLA compliance, and drive continuous service improvement. The candidate will act as the primary point of contact for customers and coordinate with technical teams, onsite engineers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure reliable and high\-quality service delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of managed IT, infrastructure, network, security, AV, and end\-user support services.
* Act as the primary service contact for assigned customers and maintain strong stakeholder relationships.
* Ensure incidents, service requests, problems, and changes are handled within agreed SLAs.
* Monitor service performance, ticket queues, response times, resolution times, escalations, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead daily, weekly, and monthly service reviews with customers and internal teams.
* Prepare and present SLA reports, service dashboards, incident summaries, availability reports, and improvement plans.
* Manage critical incidents and coordinate technical teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders until service restoration.
* Ensure Root Cause Analysis reports and corrective action plans are completed for major incidents.
* Identify recurring issues, service gaps, operational risks, and opportunities for automation or process improvement.
* Manage onsite and remote support teams, including shift planning, resource allocation, attendance, leave, and backup coverage.
* Set team objectives, review engineer performance, provide feedback, and support training and development.
* Ensure proper ticket documentation, customer communication, escalation quality, and timely closure.
* Coordinate onboarding, transition, and stabilisation of new managed\-service customers.
* Maintain service\-management documentation, escalation matrices, SOPs, runbooks, asset records, and customer\-specific procedures.
* Ensure compliance with change management, information security, access control, backup, and customer governance requirements.
* Coordinate with OEMs, third\-party vendors, and support partners for technical escalations and service restoration.
* Track contract scope, resource utilisation, service credits, penalties, renewals, and commercial risks.
* Support pre\-sales teams with effort estimation, resource planning, service scope, transition plans, and solution presentations.
* Conduct regular customer satisfaction reviews and implement agreed service\-improvement actions.
* Provide management with regular updates on service performance, customer concerns, risks, and account health.



  





**Technical and Functional Skills** 



* Strong understanding of IT managed services and service\-delivery operations.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices covering incident, problem, change, request, service\-level, and configuration management.
* Experience managing service desks, onsite support, infrastructure, network, security, cloud, AV, or end\-user support teams.
* Strong knowledge of SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, escalation management, and service\-reporting frameworks.
* Experience using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Zoho Desk, ManageEngine, Jira Service Management, or equivalent.
* Ability to prepare dashboards, service reports, RCA documents, capacity reports, and improvement plans.
* Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, servers, cloud services, cybersecurity, backup, and business continuity.
* Experience in customer onboarding, service transition, resource planning, and operational governance.
* Working knowledge of contracts, scope management, effort estimation, and service commercials.
* Good command of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.



  





**Qualification and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 year s of experience in IT services, including at least 3–5 years in service delivery or managed\-service leadership.
* Proven experience managing enterprise customers, technical teams, SLAs, escalations, and service reviews.
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification is preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, ISO 20000, or relevant technical certifications will be an advantage.



  





**Benefits** 




 • Health insurance coverage for employees and their families.
 



 • Long\-term benefit savings plan with employer matching contributions.
 



 • Opportunities for professional development and advancement within the organization.

 Protection Starts with People. Proofpoint.
   

  

 The Professional Services Consultant will oversee implementations and consultative engagements for the Proofpoint Data Security products. This includes Endpoint DLP, Insider Threat Management (ITM) SaaS, Email DLP, Cloud Application Security Broker (CASB), SaaS Isolation \& Adaptive Access Control (AAC), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Threat Detection (ITD), ITM On\-Premises, and Proofpoint Isolation. This individual will develop new services, implement best practices, and assist in customer escalations as needed. The ideal candidate has the demonstrated ability to ensure successful service delivery and customer success as well as third party DLP solutions (Microsoft \+ Symantec DLP offerings) to support migrating legacy solutions to the Proofpoint Data Security Posture Platform. Proofpoint’s Consultants are service delivery experts who manage and align client business priorities with data protection strategies. As subject matter experts on a wide spectrum of information security models, best practices, and operational strategies, our Consultants reduce clients’ security risk by mapping technology to organizational processes and resources. This role is challenged with delivering innovative ideas and solutions that derive measurable results. This is a critical and visible role as it involves support for several of Proofpoint’s top accounts. The Consultant must be confident in working with technical resources, analysts, project sponsors, and executive levels to provide excellent service delivery and communication which includes product deliverables, conducting conference calls/meetings, consulting process reviews/workshops, and briefings. * Work closely with your corresponding sales organization to ensure customer needs are met and customer satisfaction continues to rank high.
* Present updates to management identifying risks, challenges, and proposed solutions.


 What you bring to the team
   

  

* 8\+ years industry experience in a customer\-facing role
* 8\+ years of experience in IT consulting or related fields.
* Familiarity with Data Security Insider Threat Management, Endpoint Security, Cloud Security, Data Security Posture Management, and/or Identity Threat Detection concepts.
* Clear and effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Demonstrated organizational abilities with a keen eye for detail.
* Commitment to delivering exceptional client service, with the confidence to engage in\-person and virtually.
* Proven ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and follow through to concepts.
* Clear and effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Demonstrated organizational abilities with a keen eye for detail.
* Commitment to delivering exceptional client service, with the confidence to engage in\-person and virtually.
* Proven ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and follow through to completion.
* English proficiency in both technical and non\-technical communication is required.
* Desired Skills Proficiency in Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), GPO management, and PowerShell scripting o Experience with identity security tools, deep knowledge of "identity\-centric indicators of compromise", and understanding Exposure to Microsoft or Symantec DLP solutions


 Why Proofpoint
   

  

 Protecting people is at the heart of our award\-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions, and the people who work here are the key to our success. We’re a customer\-focused and a driven\-to\-win organization with leading\-edge products. We are an inclusive, diverse, multinational company that believes in culture fit, but more importantly ‘culture\-add’, and we strongly encourage people from all walks of life to apply.
   

  

 We believe in hiring the best and the brightest to help cultivate our culture of collaboration and appreciation. Apply today and explore your future at Proofpoint!
   

  

**Why Proofpoint?**
 At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us
   

  

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits
* Career success on your terms
* Flexible work environment
* Annual wellness and community outreach days
* Always on recognition for your contributions
* Global collaboration and networking opportunities


**Our Culture**
 Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success\-every day, for everyone.
   

  

 We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information\- we can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Senior Delivery Manager
description:

It digitally captures patient consent, enables legally binding electronic signatures, and ensures compliance with major regulations including HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, SOC 2 Type II, and CMS\-0053\-F, while integrating directly with EHR systems like Epic and Oracle Cerner.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




  





 Certinal is looking for an
 **Implementation \& Delivery Head** 
 to own end\-to\-end delivery of customer implementations globally, including eSignature deployments, DPDP consent platform rollouts, integrations, and migrations. You will be responsible for ensuring smooth execution from implementation kickoff through go\-live and hypercare.
 



  





 This is a leadership role focused on driving
 **on\-time go\-lives, implementation margins, and customer satisfaction** 
 , while building a scalable delivery organization. You will establish the processes, team, and delivery framework required to support Certinal’s growing customer base and scale with the DPDP pipeline ahead of the May 2027 enforcement deadline.

 8\+ years

* Own the global delivery portfolio: implementation plans, SOWs, resource allocation, and go\-live commitments across all active accounts
* Build and run the delivery methodology: kickoff, configuration, UAT, cutover, hypercare, and handover to Customer Success
* Scale the delivery team for DPDP volume: hiring, partner/SI enablement, and a repeatable implementation playbook per vertical (healthcare, NBFC, pharma)

The role ensures effective EMR adoption, clinical workflow alignment, user training, compliance with regulatory requirements, and continuous improvement of digital healthcare initiatives.

 Understand and optimize clinical workflows within the EMR.
   

  

 Collaborate with doctors, nurses, and allied health professionals to improve system utilization.
   

  

 Analyze workflow gaps and recommend process improvements.
   

  

 Support implementation of new clinical modules and functionality.

 Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
   

  

 Manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables.
   

  

 Ensure successful deployment and adoption of new features.

 Develop and conduct training programs for clinical and non\-clinical users.
   

  

 Create user manuals, SOPs, quick reference guides, and training materials.
   

  

 Drive EMR adoption initiatives across all departments.
   

  

 Monitor usage patterns and identify areas requiring additional training.

 Oversee clinical master data maintenance.
   

  

 Ensure accuracy of templates, forms, clinical documentation, and workflows.
   

  

 Coordinate updates to specialty\-specific documentation requirements.
   

  

 Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

 Generate and analyze EMR utilization reports.

 Support management reporting and decision\-making through EMR analytics.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Aarjavam Polysquare Pvt Ltd (APPL) is a Bangalore\-based manufacturer and wholesaler specializing in premium paper\-based packaging solutions. With operations across 40\+ locations and a portfolio of over 3,000 products, APPL serves a wide range of sectors including food service, hospitality, retail, and wellness. Its state\-of\-the\-art facilities produce items such as paper bags, food containers, trays, cups, pizza boxes, and customized packaging tailored to diverse business needs. The company is known for reliable, durable, and liquid\-resistant packaging that supports brand elevation for clients nationwide.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Export Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for overseeing and expanding APPL’s international sales and export operations. This role involves identifying new global markets, managing existing international clients, and coordinating end\-to\-end export processes, including documentation, compliance, and logistics. The Export Manager will develop and implement export strategies, track market trends, and work closely with production, finance, and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries and cost\-effective operations. Daily tasks include preparing export quotations, negotiating contracts, monitoring shipment schedules, and ensuring adherence to international trade regulations and quality standards. The role also requires regular reporting on export performance, margin analysis, and contributing to long\-term business planning for international growth.

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Export operations, including documentation, compliance, and coordination with freight forwarders and customs agents.

* Bachelor’s degree in International Business, Commerce, Management, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent specialization in international trade is an advantage.
* Experience in packaging, manufacturing, FMCG, or related industries and familiarity with export documentation (INCOTERMS, LC, invoices, packing lists) are highly beneficial.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, proficiency in MS Office and ERP systems, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Proven ability to manage multiple export accounts, prioritize tasks, and maintain accuracy under time\-sensitive conditions.



  





**Salary Range \- 4 to 6 LPA depending on Experience** 




 • 1\+ years of Wholesale Import and Export experience

* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

 https://peepal.co
 
 \| For media queries, contact: press@peepal.co
 



  





**About Zing** 




 Zing is your personal trading assistant and technical analysis tool, built directly for your charts. It is a plug\-and\-play Chrome extension that works across your favourite web trading platforms, with no coding or complex setup required.
 



 Zing offers a library of curated strategies, real\-time market signals, and one\-click execution with targets and stop\-losses built in and sent directly to your broker. Whether you're placing your first or thousandth F\&O trade, Zing is designed to help traders make more informed decisions.
 



 Zing is currently in beta and is building a new experience for advanced traders.
 



 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a
 **Partnerships Manager** 
 to build and manage Zing's partnerships with
 **creators, influencers, trading coaches, and other partners** 
 who bring traders to the platform.
 



 This is a relationship\-driven role that combines
 **partnership management, business development, relationship management, and customer success** 
 . You will own partner relationships end\-to\-end—from identifying and onboarding new partners to managing ongoing relationships and ensuring successful outcomes.
 



 What You Will Do
 



**1\. Relationship Management**

* Build strong, long\-term relationships with creators, influencers, coaches, and other partners.

**2\. Partnership Management**

**3\. Creator \& Influencer Partnerships**

**4\. Trading Coach Partnerships** 



* Build relationships with trading coaches and educators.

**5\. Business Development** 



* Identify new partnership opportunities and channels for acquiring traders.
* Take partnerships from the first conversation through negotiation, launch, and ongoing management.
* Explore new ways to grow Zing's reach and user base through strategic partnerships.



**6\. Customer Success** 



* Stay connected with traders acquired through partnerships.
* Understand their experience with Zing and help address relevant issues or concerns.
* Work with internal teams to improve partner and user experience based on feedback.



 What We Are Looking For
 


* Experience in
 **partnership management, business development, creator/influencer partnerships, or customer success** 
 .

 **creators, influencers, trading coaches, educators, or online communities** 
 .

* Ability to identify opportunities and take them from
 **initial conversation to execution** 
 .

 **trading, financial markets, F\&O, and advanced charting tools** 
 is highly preferred.

*Disclaimer: We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.*

**About the Role**




 You will own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of our AI\-powered inspection projects — from technical scoping through installation, configuration, commissioning, UAT, and handover. You will lead a team of Field Application Engineers and Project Managers, and you will be the person our Fortune 500 customers rely on to get their line running. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will be in the detail on project plans, SLAs, and escalations, and you will also be building the systems and standards that let us scale from 30 parallel projects to many more without adding chaos. You will work closely with the Head of Operations, Product and Engineering, and the Sales team.
 



  





**Project Delivery \& Execution** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of projects — scoping, timelines, installation, configuration, commissioning, UAT, and customer handover.
 



 • Deliver projects on time and within budget, and hold the team to the same standard.
 



 • Track and manage timelines and deliverables across technical verticals; anticipate slippage before it happens rather than reporting it afterwards.
 



 • Own Response and Resolution SLAs across queues coming in from Product, Sales, and customers, and ensure optimal work distribution.
 



 • Run root\-cause analysis on delays and rework, and close the loop so the same failure does not repeat.
 



  





**Technical Excellence** 




 • Translate new requirements from Account Executives and customers into clear scope, technical requirements, and realistic timelines.
 



 • Drive delivery of deep\-tech projects (AI / ML / Computer Vision) with a hardware and software footprint on live production lines.
 



 • Represent Operations in project discussions and client calls — identify the exact technical deliverable, communicate it clearly to the technical team, and drive it to completion.
 



 • Continuously improve efficiency metrics: productivity, quality, first\-time\-right installation, and SLA adherence.
 



 • Partner with Product and Engineering to feed structured field learnings back into the roadmap.
 



  





**Customer Delight** 




 • Own the relationship with client SPOCs through proactive communication and disciplined review cadence.
 



 • Make sure what was agreed during the sales process is exactly what gets delivered — and that we consistently over\-deliver.
 



 • Align with the customer's own KPIs and drive improvement initiatives after the system goes live.
 



 • Handle escalations and outages calmly and decisively — with the customer, and on the customer's behalf with third\-party vendors.
 



 • Communicate credibly with plant leadership and senior stakeholders at Fortune 500 manufacturers.
 



  





**Planning \& Resource Management** 




 • Manage day\-to\-day planning, allocation, and problem\-solving across a distributed field team.
 



 • Own resource planning: who goes where, when, and for how long — balancing project urgency against team wellbeing.
 



 • Track work hours and utilisation, and make the case for additional capacity with data when it is genuinely needed.
 



 • Manage project costs, travel, and hardware logistics in coordination with Finance and Supply Chain
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Application Engineers and Project Managers.
 



 • Hire FAEs as our project count and geographic footprint expand — we look for technically stellar and deeply empathetic people.
 



 • Build a high\-performance environment that people want to stay in; our Operations team is one of the most driven teams at SwitchOn and keeping it that way is part of the job.
 



 • Run regular one\-on\-ones and team meetings, surface issues early, and resolve conflict directly and fairly.
 



 • Present team performance honestly to the Head of Operations and senior leadership — including what is not working.
 



  





**Systems, Data \& Reporting** 




 • Maintain accurate records of execution time, delays, and root causes so that leadership can make data\-driven decisions.
 



 • Own operational hygiene in our tooling (JIRA / Asana / Zoho) as a source of truth, not an afterthought.
 



 • Build and improve the SOPs, checklists, and playbooks that let a new FAE deliver to standard from their first site visit.

title: Operations Support Manager
description:
**Support Operations Manager — New Products** 




 Function: Operations · Location: Bangalore · Experience: 2–5 years
 



  





**How we hire** 




 Real humans read this. No cover letters.
 



 Send a short note on
 **one process you automated with AI** 
 — what you built, what broke, what it saved.
 



  





**The role** 




 We run a portfolio of consumer apps with 300M\+ users, and this role is for everything we launch next.
 



 You own support for every new product we ship: the queue, the quality, the team, the numbers. At its core this is a support job — early users, real complaints, refunds, bugs, angry reviews.
 



 What makes it different is how you run it. AI is the default here, not an experiment. Every recurring query gets automated; humans handle only what genuinely needs judgement. You'll write prompts and build no\-code workflows — but no product code.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **Support for every launch.** 
 From day zero: SOPs, canned responses, escalation paths, AI flows. Day\-one users get real answers, not silence.
* **The numbers.** 
 First\-response time, resolution time, CSAT, backlog. You report them weekly and you defend them.
* **The team.** 
 Lead a small group of support agents — hiring, training, rostering, quality reviews, daily priorities. Keep the team small and sharp by automating everything that doesn't need a human.
* **AI\-first by default.** 
 A new product has no ticket history to mine — you'll build on informed guesses, watch the first 500 conversations closely, correct fast.
* **Voice of the first users.** 
 Weekly, with numbers: what's confusing, what's broken, what people actually want.
* **The hard cases.** 
 Payment disputes, safety and abuse reports, bans, anything legal\-sensitive. These stay with you and never run unsupervised.



  





**What we look for** 



* **2–5 years in customer support or support ops** 
 , including time as the senior person on a queue.
* **Daily hands\-on AI user.** 
 Not “I've used ChatGPT” — show us something you automated end to end.
* **You've led or trained agents.** 
 Even two or three people counts.
* Comfort with a blank page. A new product means no process, no data, no precedent.
* Strong on numbers. You can explain a CSAT drop, not just report it.
* Clear written English \+ fluent Hindi. More Indian languages is a real edge.
* Judgement under pressure. Err toward the user, but spot fraud.

title: Client Implementation & Service - Team Lead
description:
Who we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and delivery\-focused Team Lead to manage end\-to\-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding function. The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business\-as\-usual operations.
   

  

 The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
   

  

 Why this role is important to us
   

  

 The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day\-to\-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
   

  

 The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low\-risk transition into live reconciliation services.
   

  

 What you will be responsible for
   

  

* Lead assigned onboarding projects from requirement gathering through solution design, configuration, testing, production deployment, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Manage, coach, and develop onboarding specialists; allocate work, set priorities, monitor progress, and provide timely guidance.
* Establish project plans, roles, milestones, dependencies, controls, and success criteria for each implementation.
* Lead discussions with clients, custodians, fund administrators, operations, and technology teams to confirm reconciliation requirements, scope, assumptions, and delivery approach.
* Review and approve fund matrices, account structures, reconciliation types, data sources, frequencies, tolerances, matching criteria, workflows, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee analysis and validation of cash, position, transaction, and market\-value data received through SWIFT messages, flat files, and custodian portals.
* Direct data analysis and mapping for non\-SWIFT files and coordinate with ETL, technology, and deployment teams to establish scalable processing solutions.
* Oversee account, reconciliation shell, lead\-account, match\-rule, workflow, and static\-data setup in BUAT and production environments.
* Plan and oversee functional testing, BUAT, DITL, conversion rehearsals, production parallel testing, and go\-live readiness reviews.
* Act as the escalation point for complex reconciliation exceptions, configuration issues, delivery risks, client concerns, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and coordinate sustainable corrective and preventive actions with business, operations, and technology partners.
* Maintain oversight of project plans, open\-item logs, Jira tickets, risk and dependency trackers, status reports, decisions, and implementation documentation.
* Provide concise reporting to management and stakeholders on delivery status, milestones, risks, controls, capacity, and critical decisions.
* Ensure procedures, reconciliation playbooks, configuration records, control evidence, and handover documentation are complete, current, and audit\-ready.
* Oversee post\-production stabilization and ensure outstanding issues, risks, and actions are tracked through closure.
* Maintain a robust operational\-risk and control environment, including adherence to maker\-checker controls, information\-security standards, governance requirements, and escalation protocols.
* Monitor workload, quality, productivity, service levels, project capacity, and delivery performance; implement corrective action where required.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes, strengthen controls, improve client experience, and reduce manual effort through automation and workflow improvements.
* Lead team training, cross\-skilling, succession planning, knowledge management, and continuous capability development.
* Support system enhancements, strategic initiatives, operating\-model improvements, audit activities, and management reporting as required.


 What we value
   

  

* Strong understanding of middle office reconciliation, investment operations, and the investment\-management lifecycle.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, including static setup, reconciliation configuration, matching rules, tolerances, exception workflows, and administrative functions.
* Experience in external custody data acquisition, SWIFT\-message validation, file analysis, ETL data mapping, and production implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end\-to\-end onboarding projects while managing multiple priorities, dependencies, and timelines.
* Proven people\-leadership capability, including work allocation, coaching, performance support, knowledge development, and quality oversight.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to lead root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions.
* Effective stakeholder\-management, influencing, negotiation, and escalation skills across global teams.
* Strong risk and control mindset, with experience maintaining audit\-ready evidence and addressing operational or implementation risks.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive\-reporting skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical and operational matters into clear decisions, actions, and status updates.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, accountability, and a consistent focus on delivery quality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and working knowledge of project\-tracking, workflow, data\-visualization, and process\-documentation tools.


**Education And Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 7 or more years of relevant experience in middle office, reconciliation, investment operations, client onboarding, system implementation, or a related function.
* Prior experience leading a team, workstream, or complex implementation within a high\-volume, global operating environment.
* Practical expertise using TLM/TLP or another recognized reconciliation platform.
* Experience managing relationships with custodians, investment managers, fund administrators, technology teams, and global operations stakeholders.
* Experience managing implementation risks, testing governance, production readiness, stabilization, and operational handover.


**Additional Skills**
* Experience with JIRA, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, or related workflow and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of Agile or Waterfall project methodologies.
* Demonstrated involvement in automation, system enhancements, process transformation, or operating\-model improvement initiatives.
* Experience preparing management information, capacity views, performance metrics, and executive\-level project updates.


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Account Manager- South
description:
Lead the safe, reliable, compliant and cost\-effective operation and maintenance of multiple industrial water and wastewater treatment sites. The role has end\-to\-end accountability for plant performance, contractual KPIs, customer satisfaction, workforce capability, maintenance systems, budgets, vendors, statutory compliance and continuous improvement across the assigned portfolio.
 



 The successful candidate will provide strong technical and operational leadership to site managers and multidisciplinary teams, standardize O\&M practices across locations, and ensure timely resolution of critical operational and customer issues.
 



 2\. Scope of Responsibility
 


* Oversee multiple O\&M contracts and treatment facilities operating on a continuous shift basis.
* Provide governance and technical direction for WTP, ETP, STP, RO and ZLD facilities, including associated pumping, clarification, filtration, sludge handling, evaporation and drying systems.
* Manage mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, automation and process performance through site teams and specialist support functions.
* Own service delivery in line with contract terms, agreed budgets, customer specifications, environmental requirements and internal standards.



 3\. Key Responsibilities
 



 A. Multi\-Site Operations \& Performance
 


* Take overall ownership of day\-to\-day O\&M performance across all assigned sites and ensure uninterrupted availability of critical water systems.
* Review plant operating parameters, water quality, throughput, recovery, uptime and consumption trends; initiate corrective action for deviations.
* Conduct structured site reviews and risk\-based visits, with focused support for underperforming or critical facilities.
* Coordinate rapid technical support for breakdowns, chronic problems and process upsets to minimize downtime and customer production impact.
* Drive process optimization, debottlenecking, reliability improvement and operating\-cost reduction without compromising safety, quality or compliance.
* Ensure effective shift deployment, escalation protocols and management coverage across sites.



 B. Treatment Process \& Technical Oversight
 


* Provide technical governance for raw\-water treatment, clarification, filtration, cooling\-water systems, ETP, STP, RO, UF/NF where applicable, MEE, ATFD, filter press, clarifier, thickener, oil skimmer and complete ZLD systems.
* Monitor influent and effluent quality, RO recovery and rejection, membrane performance, chemical dosing, sludge generation, evaporation efficiency and final discharge or reuse quality.
* Guide root\-cause analysis and sustainable resolution of process, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and automation issues.
* Ensure calibration and documentation of instruments, gauges and measuring devices as per schedule and audit requirements.
* Maintain current technical knowledge and promote adoption of proven operating and maintenance practices.



 C. Maintenance \& Reliability
 


* Establish and govern preventive, predictive, condition\-based, time\-based and breakdown maintenance programs.
* Ensure maintenance planning, work\-order discipline, shutdown planning, spares management and equipment\-history records are effective at every site.
* Review critical equipment health for pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, dosing systems, dewatering equipment, membranes, evaporators, dryers, MCCs, VFDs, PLC/SCADA and field instruments.
* Lead failure investigations, root\-cause analysis and closure of corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive equipment reliability, reduced repeat failures and optimized maintenance cost.



 D. Safety, Environment \& Compliance
 


* Be accountable for a goal\-zero safety culture across the assigned sites.
* Ensure compliance with HSE/EHS requirements, permit\-to\-work systems, SOPs, risk assessments, PPE, chemical handling, lockout/tagout and emergency preparedness.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and environmental events are reported, investigated and closed with effective corrective actions.
* Conduct and monitor safety audits, toolbox talks, hazard\-register reviews and statutory inspections.
* Maintain environmental, legal and customer compliance records in audit\-ready condition.



 E. Contract, KPI \& Customer Management
 


* Establish and review site KPIs in line with contract requirements, including plant availability, water quality, throughput, recovery, downtime, consumption, cost, safety and customer satisfaction.
* Prepare consolidated monthly MIS, performance dashboards, variance analysis and recovery plans for management and customer reviews.
* Lead customer meetings, technical discussions and escalation management; ensure timely closure of observations and commitments.
* Protect contractual performance and billing by ensuring KPI evidence, service records, approvals and monthly documentation are complete and timely.
* Identify contract risks, scope gaps and change requirements, and escalate them with clear technical and commercial justification.



 F. Budget, Cost \& Commercial Control
 


* Prepare and manage annual and monthly O\&M budgets for the assigned portfolio.
* Monitor actual expenditure against budget and control manpower, chemicals, energy, spares, maintenance and subcontracting costs.
* Develop savings initiatives through process optimization, chemical and energy reduction, improved reliability and resource productivity.
* Plan critical spares, consumables, annual maintenance and shutdown requirements based on operational risk and contract obligations.
* Support timely customer billing, certification and resolution of performance\-linked deductions or commercial issues.



 G. Team Leadership \& Capability Building
 


* Lead site managers, engineers, supervisors, technicians, operators and support teams across locations.
* Define accountability, review staffing and shift structures, and ensure deployment matches plant criticality and skill needs.
* Recruit, onboard, coach, train and develop site teams; maintain skill matrices and succession plans for critical roles.
* Set clear performance expectations and conduct structured reviews, while promoting discipline, ownership and collaboration.
* Ensure technically competent manpower is available to troubleshoot critical equipment and process issues.



 H. Systems, Standardization \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Standardize SOPs, checklists, log sheets, maintenance practices, reporting formats and escalation mechanisms across sites.
* Ensure critical work instructions are practical, pictorial and available in a language understood by the workforce where required.
* Use performance data to identify systemic issues, benchmark sites and replicate best practices.
* Coordinate effectively with Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, HR, Finance and corporate support functions.
* Promote digital tools such as CMMS/SAP, dashboards and MS Office applications for planning, documentation and performance control.



 4\. Key Performance Indicators
 



**KPI Area** 




**Measures** 




**Safety \& Compliance** 




 Zero injuries; closure of audit findings; statutory and environmental compliance
 



**Plant Performance** 




 Availability, uptime, throughput, treated\-water quality and adherence to operating targets
 



**Process Efficiency** 




 Recovery, chemical consumption, energy consumption, water reuse and sludge or reject management
 



**Reliability** 




 Breakdown frequency, repeat failures, preventive\-maintenance compliance and downtime
 



**Commercial** 




 Budget adherence, cost savings, billing documentation and reduction of performance deductions
 



**Customer** 




 Satisfaction, escalation closure, review effectiveness and completion of commitments
 



**People** 




 Manpower productivity, training completion, skill coverage and retention of critical capability
 



 5\. Qualification \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Environmental or a related engineering discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant O\&M experience, preferably in industrial water and wastewater treatment, utilities, heavy industry, metals, chemicals or similar process industries.
* Proven experience managing multiple sites, large contracts or a geographically distributed O\&M portfolio.
* Demonstrated hands\-on exposure to water and wastewater treatment and ZLD operations, together with multidisciplinary maintenance management.
* Experience in customer\-facing roles, budgeting, vendor management, workforce leadership, KPI governance and management reporting.



 6\. Required Technical Knowledge
 


* Water treatment processes: clarification, filtration, disinfection, demineralization and membrane systems.
* Wastewater and reuse systems: ETP, STP, RO, sludge handling and ZLD, including MEE and ATFD where applicable.
* Mechanical systems: pumps, motors, blowers, compressors, agitators, valves, piping and rotating equipment.
* Electrical and instrumentation: HT/LT interfaces, MCC/PCC, VFDs, PLC/SCADA, transmitters, analyzers, control valves, interlocks and calibration.
* Maintenance systems: preventive, predictive, condition\-based and breakdown maintenance; root\-cause analysis; spares planning.
* HSE, environmental compliance, statutory requirements, quality systems and audit documentation.
* Working knowledge of CMMS/SAP, MS Office and data\-based reporting tools.



 7\. Leadership Competencies
 


* Ownership and accountability across multiple operating locations.
* Strong planning, prioritization and decision\-making under operational pressure.
* Customer orientation with confident technical and commercial communication.
* Analytical problem\-solving and disciplined closure of corrective actions.
* Ability to coach teams, build trust and create a safety\-focused performance culture.
* Effective cross\-functional coordination, negotiation and stakeholder management.
* High integrity, adaptability and willingness to travel frequently.



 8\. Decision\-Making Authority
 


* Operational decisions required to protect safety, compliance, equipment and continuity of service.
* Deployment of manpower and resources within the approved organization structure and budget.
* Prioritization of maintenance, spares and technical support based on plant criticality.
* Vendor and service\-provider recommendations in accordance with company procedures.
* Escalation of contractual, commercial, safety and compliance risks to appropriate management.



 9\. Candidate Profile
 



 A hands\-on, results\-oriented O\&M leader who can manage a diverse portfolio of water and wastewater treatment plants, strengthen site leadership, build reliable operating systems and maintain strong customer confidence. The candidate should combine process knowledge with maintenance discipline, commercial awareness, people leadership and an uncompromising approach to safety and compliance.

 . Acting as a trusted advisor for customers, the CSBP will work alongside our Partners and Professional Services team to drive customer outcomes and ensure Anaplan delivers high ROI. As the primary customer contact for any platform challenges, the CSBP will handle critical issues and ensure customer satisfaction.

* Grow the Anaplan footprint by conducting workshops to build customer mindshare on new use cases and solutions resulting in upsell or cross sell opportunities.
* Own key relationships with customers and proactively maintain high levels of engagement with a focus on increasing customer satisfaction and loyalty
* Act as the voice of customer to our internal stakeholders, including flagging and managing risks, advocating for their needs and ensuring alignment on objectives.
* Identify renewal risk and work with Renewal managers and Account executives on a mitigation plan
* Advise customer on developing a Center of Excellence or similar governance structure to enable customers self\-sufficiency on Anaplan
* Develop customer success assets and playbooks and help drive customer references and case studies


**Your Qualifications** 
* 8\+ years of work experience in customer success, presales or management consulting

 ambiguity.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
We are a global learning platform on a mission to motivate every learner by empowering every educator. From K–12 classrooms and universities to corporate training settings, our platform is trusted in over 150\+ countries by 75 million monthly active users.
 



 In the U.S., 90% of schools use Wayground to engage students and transform learning through technology. Wayground is a high\-growth, profitable SaaS company backed by leading investors including Tiger Global, GSV, and Nexus Venture Partners.
 



  





 This Customer Success Manager role focuses on partnering with K\-12 schools across the U.S. It’s a high\-scale position managing a large volume of accounts, each with a varying Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR). Our approach combines strong data insights and the use of sophisticated Customer Success tools to enhance the educational journey and achieve strategic goals.
 



  





  





**What you'll do:** 



* **Own the Renewal Process:** 
 Proactively manage and drive renewals for your accounts, ensuring a seamless and positive experience to maintain long\-term partnerships
* **Strategic Stakeholder Engagement:** 
 Build and nurture relationships with key customer stakeholders to identify their priorities, address concerns, and highlight the value of our solutions
* **Deliver Value\-Driven Conversations:** 
 Regularly demonstrate the ROI and impact of our products by aligning customer goals with our platform's capabilities to reinforce the value proposition
* **Mitigate Churn Risks:** 
 Identify at\-risk accounts early through health checks and engagement signals, and implement tailored action plans to re\-engage and retain them
* **Uncover Growth Opportunities:** 
 Partner with customers to identify ways to expand adoption, upsell additional offerings, and drive deeper product usage that aligns with their strategic objectives
* **Collaborate for Success:** 
 Work cross\-functionally with Sales, Onboarding, and Support teams to ensure customers achieve success and meet milestones that lead to retention and growth
* **Track \& Report Progress:** 
 Monitor key metrics (e.g., product adoption, usage, health scores) to track progress, report outcomes, and guide conversations that drive retention and expansion



  





  





**Who you are:** 



* 2\+ years of customer success experience with US market exposure.
* Experience in consumer products in the ed\-tech sector is a bonus.
* Excellent written communication skills and impeccable grammar.
* Working with CRMs such as Salesforce, Gainsight, or Zendesk.



  





  





 We're a small, passionate, tech\-first team solving big challenges in education. We move fast, build with data, and obsess over creating delightful experiences for our global community of educators and learners.
 



 The pandemic has changed work in many ways, especially by enabling remote work. Many companies have chosen to be remote first. At Wayground, we work best in the office brainstorming using whiteboards, having conversations over coffee/walks, or overhearing a hallway conversation. Learning happens through osmosis. We understand that driving/ubering takes work in Bangalore. We’ll take care of the commute for you.
 



 Beyond taking care of commute, we will cover health care benefits for you, your family, and your parents. We invest in our employee’s health and wellness. Through books and courses, we invest in their learning and development. Oh, and finally, we have healthy lunches, dinners, and a stocked pantry to snack on all day.
 



  





 Wayground is an equal opportunity employer and we believe diversity is key to our success.

title: Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:
**About Kapture CX**
 Founded in Bengaluru in 2014,
 **Kapture CX** 
 began as an enterprise customer support software company and has evolved into an
 **AI\-first Agentic Operating System for Enterprises** 
 .
   

  

 Kapture helps enterprises scale AI execution while keeping humans in control. Its
 **AgentOS platform** 
 enables enterprises to deploy, orchestrate, monitor, and optimize AI agents across critical business workflows — including
 **customer support, sales, collections, and claims** 
 .
   

  

 Kapture’s AI agents can execute workflows end\-to\-end across
 **voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels** 
 , with human intervention built in wherever judgment, empathy, or decision\-making is required.
   

  

 Today, Kapture is trusted by
 **1,000\+ enterprises across 18 countries** 
 , helping organizations transform customer experience, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes through
 **AI Agents, Agentic AI, Voice AI, Conversational AI, and intelligent automation** 
 .
   

  

**What is this role all about?**
 As a
 **Senior Customer Experience Manager** 
 , you will own the success and growth of a portfolio of enterprise customers on the Kapture platform. You will act as a trusted partner to both business and technical stakeholders, driving CSAT, customer adoption, platform value, advocacy, retention, and long\-term account health.
   

  

 You will combine customer engagement, business understanding, technical expertise, and strong delivery capabilities to help customers achieve their objectives on Kapture. You will also identify opportunities for platform optimization, solutioning, and account growth while partnering closely with internal teams to resolve complex challenges and continuously improve the customer experience.
   

  

**Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:**
**Client Engagement**
* Own the overall health and success of a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring strong adoption, satisfaction, retention, and long\-term value.
* Build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders and act as a strategic advisor on customer objectives and platform usage.
* Lead QBRs, health checks, success planning, and key customer conversations to understand evolving needs and drive measurable outcomes.
* Proactively identify customer risks, address concerns, and build mitigation plans to strengthen customer relationships and renewal readiness.


**Project \& Delivery Management**
* Drive customer onboarding, implementation, integrations, and adoption initiatives, ensuring effective coordination across customers and internal teams.
* Manage multiple customer engagements and cross\-functional dependencies to ensure timely delivery and resolution of customer priorities.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams to drive customer initiatives and ensure effective execution.


**Business Acumen**
* Understand customer business objectives and translate them into opportunities to improve platform adoption, utilization, and ROI.
* Analyze customer health, usage, feedback, and engagement trends to identify risks, improvement opportunities, and areas for growth.
* Identify expansion opportunities and partner with Customer Success and Sales teams to support account growth and long\-term customer value.
* Capture customer feedback and translate recurring needs and business challenges into actionable inputs for relevant internal teams.


**Technical Expertise**
* Understand the customer's technical architecture and integration setup well enough to have credible conversations with technical stakeholders.
* Maintain/contribute to troubleshooting guides, implementation docs, and RCAs. Owning the documentation of all projects involved in.
* Partner with Engineering/SRE to drive resolution of complex technical escalations, translating root cause into business impact and next steps for the customer.
* Own complex technical escalations by analyzing logs, debugging issues, andPartner with Engineering and Product teams to diagnose issues, drive resolution, and ensure effective communication with customers.


**Solutioning \& AI**
* Recommend platform configurations, workflows, integrations, and best practices that address customer requirements and improve business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Kapture's automation and AI capabilities to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Work with Product and technical teams to translate customer requirements into scalable solutions and product improvements.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and contribute to scalable solutions rather than addressing issues individually.


**People Management**
* Mentor and support Customer Experience team members by sharing customer management, technical troubleshooting, and platform best practices.
* Support the team in managing complex customer situations and contribute to building stronger customer\-facing capabilities.


**What does success look like in this role?**
 Success in this role means
 **customers consistently realize measurable value from Kapture's platform, demonstrate strong adoption and engagement, and maintain healthy long\-term relationships with Kapture** 
 .
   

  

 You build trusted relationships across business and technical stakeholders, proactively resolve customer risks, deliver customer initiatives effectively, and use technical and business insights to improve customer outcomes. You also contribute to retention, account growth, and scalable solutions that improve the overall customer experience.
   

  

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Basic Requirements**
* You have 5–7 years of experience in fast paced, complex, growth environments in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, or Enterprise SaaS.
* You have experience managing enterprise customers across business and technical stakeholders.
* You have a strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, onboarding, adoption, retention, and stakeholder management.
* You have experience working with APIs, integrations, troubleshooting, and enterprise SaaS implementations.
* You have experience managing multiple Enterprise SaaS customer engagements in the geography and working cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams.
* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to balance customer, business, and technical priorities.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**
* Have exposure to AI\-powered CX, conversational AI, chatbots, or automation platforms.
* Have experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Have experience creating customer playbooks, implementation guides,dashboards, campaign management, troubleshooting documentation, and RCAs.
* Have experience identifying recurring customer issues and driving preventive or scalable solutions.
* Have experience identifying and supporting account expansion opportunities.
* Have experience with dashboarding, APIs, integration frameworks, SQL/NoSQL databases or data flows, tools such as Kafka, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.

 Copado is the leading DevOps platform for Salesforce, revolutionizing how the world's largest organizations achieve success in their Salesforce deployments. Our mission is to accelerate the Salesforce development lifecycle, support digital transformation, and deliver unparalleled value to our customers. We continuously innovate, ensuring our platform meets the evolving needs of Salesforce developers and operations professionals.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Technical Account Manager (TAM) for Technical Excellence teams is a highly technical, strategic advisor dedicated to supporting enterprise and strategic customers. Located in India, this role sits at the center of a high\-energy, multicultural, and globally distributed network.
   

  

 Moving beyond the traditional scope of account management, this position requires a strong technical aptitude in DevOps architecture, Salesforce release and test management, and pipeline orchestration to provide best practices, hands\-on, day\-to\-day guidance directly with customer engineering and release teams.
   

  

 At the heart of this role is our Genius Bar concept. You will act as a technical partner, diagnostic expert, and true extension of the customer’s team. You will leverage deep technical acumen across Salesforce DevOps, Copado CI/CD, Copado Robotic Testing (CRT), and Copado AI (Agentia) to run 1:1 coaching sessions, conduct proactive health checks, host group clinics, and streamline delivery pipelines.
   

  

 You will work closely with global cross\-functional teams (Support, Customer Success, Services, Engineering, Product), collaborating creatively across time zones and cultures to solve complex pipeline and automation challenges.

* Familiarity with Copado AI / Agentia platforms
* Passion for live architectural coaching and translating tech concepts to executive guidance
* Calm, analytical approach during high\-severity release blockers

description:

 At CodeChef, we are building a platform for practical CS education. CodeChef has evolved from a Platform with only Competitive programming capabilities to a platform where a user can learn entire 4 year CS Education on CodeChef. Colleges collaborate with CodeChef to integrate our learning and assessment environment into their Academic Labs.
 



 Are you passionate about coding and want to make a lasting impact by helping students learn effectively? Join us in bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and real\-world application, while staying connected to the latest in tech. This isn't just teaching – it's about building the future of CS education.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The
 **Account Manager (AM)** 
 will serve as the primary relationship owner for colleges enrolled in the CodeChef College Program. The AM acts as the strategic bridge between the college and CodeChef’s internal teams, ensuring seamless onboarding, smooth program execution, stakeholder engagement, revenue scale\-up, and long\-term retention.
 



 This is a high\-ownership, high\-accountability role requiring strong coordination skills, stakeholder management, execution rigor, and the ability to drive outcomes both externally and internally.
 


* **Note on Travel:** 
 This role requires being on the move. Expect to spend
 **60\-70% of your time traveling** 
 to college



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Sales Closure \& Onboarding


* Join the final stage meetings led by the BD team to support deal closure.
* Establish relationships with key stakeholders (HODs, faculty members, management).
* Ensure smooth onboarding post\-signature.
* Coordinate with internal content teams once the college syllabus is shared.
* Ensure course creation aligned to the syllabus and delivered within committed timelines.



  





 2\. Program Execution \& Monitoring
 


* Own all client communication (Email \& WhatsApp).
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for the college.
* Ensure weekly reports are sent to the college on time.
* Monitor timely execution of assessments by the support team.
* Track course progress and faculty engagement.
* Identify gaps (e.g., low student completion, inactive faculty monitoring) and take corrective actions.
* Escalate to senior college stakeholders (Owner/Vice Chancellor) when necessary to ensure compliance and progress.



  





 3\. Stakeholder Engagement
 


* Conduct monthly meetings with HODs and faculty .

* Build strong institutional relationships to ensure program success and expansion.



  





 4\. Revenue Retention, Scale\-Up \& Expansion

title: Manager - Lender Partnerships
description:
**About Rupeek**




 Rupeek, established in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, stands as India's leading asset backed digital lending fintech platform. Committed to making credit accessible to Indians in a fair and convenient manner, Rupeek pioneers innovative financial products focused on monetizing India's $2 trillion gold market. Leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology and an automated asset light supply chain, Rupeek is transforming the gold loan disbursal landscape across 40\+ cities in India. With a customer base exceeding 5,00,000\+, the company's strategic partnerships with top banks and financial institutions underscore its commitment to building gold\-backed assets through low\-risk, low\-touch, and friction\-free processes.
 



 Rupeek's impressive journey is supported by key investors such as Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, Bertelsmann, and Elevation.
 ***In Apr 2024, Rupeek turned profitable and raised 200Cr.\+ in equity capital from Manipal Group and Elevation Capital to fund its next phase of growth***
 . Join us in redefining the future of finance through innovation, technology, and a commitment to financial inclusivity.
 



  





**Profile Summary**




 As a Lending Partnerships P\&L at Rupeek Fintech, your role is pivotal in establishing, scaling and managing driving strategic initiatives in partnerships with lender partners. You will be expected to drive engagement on all levels \- management, technology, product, operations, PnL and finance \-between Rupeek and partner banks to deliver strong book and revenue growth for the managed partnerships. The profile also entails creating and managing deep relationships with senior management of top banks across the country.
 



 Candidates who excel at managing multiple communication and project threads, like interacting and dealing with a variety of people from multiple functions to create path\-breaking products in the fintech partnership ecosystem, will find this role extremely exciting and rewarding!
 



  





**Job Title:** 
 Manager \- Lender Partnerships (P\&L)
 



**Education:** 
 MBA, CA or a related banking/finance degree
 



**Experience:** 
 5\-15 years of relevant experience
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**Job Responsibilities**



* **Account Management Excellence:** 
 Oversee the end\-to\-end management of lending partnerships, ensuring a high level of client satisfaction and deliver YoY book and revenue growth.
* **Program Management:** 
 Set up and manage operating cadence with middle and senior management of Rupeek and partner teams to ensure seamless business delivery.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Create and manage relationships with partner banks’ multiple delivery teams to ensure strong liaisoning across the board
* **Product and Process Understanding:** 
 Have a good understanding of working products (term loans, bullet loans, credit card etc.), engagement model ( Co\-lending Model, Banking Correspondent Model) and business processes to be able to hold partner conversations with confidence.
* **Lending Partnership Strategy:** 
 Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for establishing and expanding lending partnerships in alignment with business objectives.
* **New Business Development:** 
 Identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities within the midmarket, SMEs, and startup segments to expand the lending partnership portfolio.
* **Collaboration with Cross\-functional Teams:** 
 Work closely with product, technology, and marketing teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of lending solutions.
* **Performance Metrics and Reporting:** 
 Establish and monitor key performance indicators, regularly reporting on the success and challenges of lending partnerships, with actionable insights for continuous improvement.
* **Traveling:** 
 The role requires the candidate to travel frequently to cultivate and maintain partnerships effectively. Engage with lending institutions, clients, and stakeholders on\-the ground to strengthen relationships and drive partnership success.



  





**Skills \& Qualifications**



* MBA, CA or a related banking/finance degree from a top\-tier institution.
* 5\-15 years of working experience, preferably in the lending domain.
* Experience of business product management for a lending product is a must
* Additional consideration for prior experience of working in a partnership role \- lender partnerships, enterprise sales, platform business for BFSI.
* As the role entails a lot of stakeholder interaction, excellent written and oral communication is a must have.
* For each aspect of delivering on partnership, a lot of negotiation is required to drive consensus. Consequently, strong negotiation skills are a must have for this role.



  





 Join our pioneering team at Rupeek Fintech and play a pivotal role in shaping the future landscape of lending partnerships in the Fintech sector!
