title: Head of Customer Experience(Customer Success)-India
description:
**About Exotel** 




  





 Exotel is one of Asia’s leading customer communication platforms, helping businesses build better customer experiences through cloud\-based communication solutions.
 



 We bring together
 **CPaaS, CCaaS, and Voice AI** 
 to help businesses manage customer conversations across voice and digital channels. Our platform powers
 **billions of customer interactions globally** 
 , enabling enterprises to connect with their customers at scale, automate conversations, and deliver seamless experiences.
 



 With a strong presence across
 **India, APAC, the Middle East, and Africa** 
 , Exotel works with thousands of businesses across industries. We are building the next generation of AI\-powered customer communication, where intelligent voice and digital experiences become an integral part of how businesses engage with their customers.
 



 At Exotel, you’ll work in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment alongside teams across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, solving complex problems at scale and shaping the future of customer communication.
 



  





**Job Location: Gurugram/ Bengaluru** 




  





**About the Role** 




  





 You own retention and expansion of Exotel's domestic enterprise business — a large, revenue\-critical share of our named accounts, already paying us in at least one SKU across CPaaS, CCaaS, and Voice AI / voice\-bot streaming.
 



 The first job is to defend that base. These accounts are already running revenue\-critical infrastructure on Exotel, and protecting and expanding that, before anything else, is what this role is accountable for.
 



 The second job is the whitespace inside this base. The average paying account today uses only a fraction of our full portfolio, which spans CPaaS, CCaaS, and Voice AI. Most of these customers are proof the product works — they just haven't been sold the rest of what we do. This role owns both: hold the base we've already won, and grow their footprint from there.
 



 This is not a support role and not a coordination role. You are the single named owner of Net Revenue Retention for enterprise India, and the frontline escalation point when anything in the customer's experience (delivery, support, billing, product, or platform) breaks. When a strategic account has a problem that spans multiple internal teams, you run it end\-to\-end until it's resolved, not until it's routed.
 



  





  





  





**What You Own** 




  





**1\. Retention \& Expansion — the revenue mandate** 




  




* Own NRR and GRR for the full domestic enterprise book, reported and defended monthly against target.
* Build the account\-level whitespace model that turns average SKU attach — currently \~1\.5 products per paying account — into a prioritised, quota\-bearing cross\-sell funnel across CPaaS (voice, SMS/WhatsApp/RCS), CCaaS (ECC/Harmony), and Voice AI/voice\-bot products, focused on the accounts we've already converted.
* Own account tiering and segmentation (strategic / growth / maintain) so QBR depth, executive coverage, and expansion effort are allocated by risk and headroom, not by who escalates loudest.
* Partner with Sales leadership on renewal forecasting and the handoff line between net\-new logo acquisition and install\-base expansion, so no account falls into the gap between the two.



  





**2\. Customer Governance \& Executive Engagement** 




  




* Own the QBR program end\-to\-end: cadence, content standard, and executive attendance,
* Build and maintain an account health\-score model (usage depth, support load, sentiment, commercial trajectory) that flags churn or expansion risk before it shows up in a renewal conversation.
* Act as the named executive sponsor for the top tier of strategic accounts.



  





**3\. Escalation Ownership \& Cross\-Functional Orchestration** 




  




* Be the single accountable owner of enterprise customer escalations — running point across Delivery, Support, Finance, Tech, and Product until resolution, with authority to pull the right people into a room.
* Define and enforce a severity framework and SLA for escalations, so "pillar to post" becomes a repeatable operating process with clear ownership at each stage, not a hero act each time.
* Build the structured feedback loop from escalations and expansion conversations into the product roadmap — this team sees where the product is costing revenue before anyone else in the company does.



  





**4\. Team Leadership** 




  




* Hire, structure, and lead the enterprise Customer Experience team (Account/Relationship Managers and CSMs) — define role charters, account/territory assignment, and career paths.
* Run the team's operating cadence: weekly pipeline and risk reviews, monthly business reviews, and a quarterly NRR readout to company leadership.



  





**How the role will be measured** 




  




* Net Revenue Retention (NRR)



 Expansion \+ retention across the book, net of churn/downgrade
 



  




* Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)



 Pure retention floor — logo and revenue churn
 



  




* Cross\-sell/expansion revenue



 New product attach (CPaaS ↔ CCaaS ↔ Voice AI) across the active paying base tracked against the SKUs\-per\-account baseline
 



  




* QBR coverage %



 Share of tiered accounts receiving the QBR cadence and depth defined for their tier
 



  




* Account health score trend



 Leading indicator of churn/expansion risk — usage, support load, sentiment, commercial trajectory
 



  




* Executive relationship coverage



 Named exec sponsor mapped to every strategic\-tier account
 



  




* Team ramp time \& attrition



 Time\-to\-productivity for new CSMs/AMs; regretted attrition
 



  





  





  





**What You Bring** 




  




* 15–20 years overall, with 6–8\+ years leading enterprise Customer Success or Account Management teams in B2B SaaS, CPaaS, CCaaS, or adjacent cloud/API infrastructure businesses.
* A track record of owning a book of comparable scale
* Direct experience running complex, multi\-stakeholder escalations in a technical or platform business — telephony, contact centre, messaging, or API infrastructure strongly preferred.
* Executive presence — comfortable running QBRs and holding renewal/expansion conversations with CXOs at India's largest enterprises.
* Data fluency — builds and defends a whitespace or health\-score model with numbers, not anecdotes.
* Proven people leadership — has hired, structured, and scaled a CS/AM organisation, with a clear philosophy on account assignment and career progression.



  





  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* Prior exposure to conversational/voice AI, CPaaS, or CCaaS platforms specifically.
* Depth in one or more of Exotel's core enterprise verticals — BFSI, healthcare, logistics, or e\-commerce.



  





**First 90 / 180 Days** 




  




* Day 30: Account tiering complete across all named accounts; health\-score and SKU\-attach baseline published for the active paying accounts.
* Day 90: Whitespace/expansion model live per tier; escalation severity framework and SLAs operational.
* Day 180: Demonstrable, defensible movement in the NRR trend line and in QBR coverage against the tiered target.



  





**Role Logistics** 




  




* Reporting line: Chief Business Officer.

 Education

Proactively plans team resources and engages corporate teams to influence maturation and presales.  Solution Design and Proof

 Applies advanced sales methodologies (e.g., challenger sales) and coaches team to lead and inspire global customers in digital transformation solutions, emphasizing security improvements, and shaping and enabling scalable change across subsidiaries.

title: Sr. Associate Director - Affluent Relations
description:

* Generate new business via sales promotions, out\-marketing calls and presentations and in\-branch contacts
* Participate actively in branch sales planning to generate action plans for meeting targets
* He/She is aware of bank’s Mis\-selling \& Sales Policies and ensure adherence all the times.
* Ensure high level of customer service in the Branch. Manage difficult customer situations
* Ensure compliance with internal and external guidelines and ensure minimal comments in audits and other inspections
* Ensure transactions are processed with a high level of accuracy and commitment in order to satisfy customer needs
* Ensure validity and completeness of transactions processed and ensure concessions relative to exchange rate, fees, charges etc. are authorized/ overridden by appropriate authorities
* Ensure adherence to laid down processes, facilitate first time resolution. Minimize rejections and customer complaints
* Monitor customer satisfaction survey ratings, net promoter score or any other survey/ feedback ratings taken from customers and ensure continuous improvement if below bench\-mark, sustain and better quality service

* Find ways to improve operational efficiency and control costs to meet cost budgets
* Be multi\-skilled to handle all kinds of transactions and services in the bank
* Manage growth and attrition of the base, facilitate customer up\-streaming. Improve product per customer
* Ensure he/ she is fully aware of all the policies and procedures issued in relation to ORMA, Group Code of Conduct, KYC/CDD/EDD \& Money laundering prevention. He/she must ensure compliance with these policies and procedures on an ongoing basis. Any suspicious transaction must immediately be reported to the supervising officer.
* Premises management in areas of merchandising, housekeeping as well as store management. Branch upkeep and maintenance
* Responsible for health and safety for all. As part of the Health and Safety guidelines you should:
* Take reasonable care for the health and safety of co\-workers and those who may be affected by your actions or your omissions; Co\-operate with Management to support and promote Health and safety in the workplace;
* Ensure that your actions do not put others at risk; Work in a healthy and safe manner;
* Encourage others to work in a healthy and safe manner;
* Report all accidents and incidents and bring to the attention of the management any hazard in the workplace


**Business**
**Sales And Service Objectives**
* Maximize sales performance to achieve given revenue targets for the zone as well as Distribution network through liability products \[Current /Savings /Term deposits], wealth management products and asset related products
* Develop, implement and manage a best\-in\-class sales capability
* Lead the implementation of the liability strategy at the Branch
* Review, analyze and manage the customer portfolio for profitable growth
* Initiate development of strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and cross sell
* Support where necessary, via joint customer calls and identify potential customers
* Together with Branch Managers, enhance the bank’s image through area promotions, community activities etc.
* Manage service delivery in the network to the highest competitive standards
* Monitor service standards for the network and audit expected behaviors.


**Processes**
**Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure satisfactory ratings in all internal/external audits conducted at all branches in the zone
* Control and periodically check operational risks and workflows
* Review key operational risks and efficiency indicators


**Integration/ Change Management**
* Facilitate the implementation of new systems and processes across the branch network
* Lead the transaction migration initiative at the area


**Segment Ownership**
* Implement all segment/ product initiatives in the zone (PRB/ Premium/ Personal/ SME)
* Jointly own the delivery of segment / product (PRB/ Premium/ Personal/ SME) targets with the branch managers \& segment associate directors


**People \& Talent**
**People Management**
* Drive and embed a strong performance culture through inspiring, motivating, and rigorous performance management discipline. Develop and build talents within the network through optimal resourcing, capacity planning, succession planning and engagements
* Achieve high employee engagement and satisfaction. Retain talent, check attrition. Manage and mentor network staff and Union interface to ensure overall employee satisfaction
* Identify training, development and counselling needs for staff
* Undertake career growth planning for performers in the branch network


**Governance**
* Ensure he/ she is fully aware of all the policies and procedures issued in relation to ORMA, Group Code of Conduct, KYC/CDD/EDD and Money laundering prevention and ensure compliance thereto. Any suspicious transaction must immediately be reported as per guidelines
* He/ She is aware of bank’s Mis\-selling \& Sales Policies and ensure adherence all the times within the network
* Premises management in areas of merchandising, housekeeping as well as store management. Branch upkeep and maintenance
* Responsible for health and safety for all. As part of the Health and Safety guidelines you should:
* Take reasonable care for the health and safety of co\-workers and those who may be affected by your actions or your omissions; Co\-operate with Management to support and promote Health and safety in the workplace
* Ensure that your actions do not put others at risk; Work in a healthy and safe manner
* Encourage others to work in a healthy and safe manner
* Report all accidents and incidents and bring to the attention of the management any hazard in the workplace
* As a manager you are also responsible for the health and safety aspects within your area of control. You need to ensure that
* Your employees are adequately trained and supervised to perform their tasks in a safe manner and are free to raise any Health and safety issues and these issues are addressed appropriately.
* The contractors working in your area or for you are working in a safe \& healthy manner


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate, and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* WRB Head
* Head \- Affluent Banking
* Region Area Director
* Leadership Team
* Department Heads


**Other Responsibilities**
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in India; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;

**Technical Skills:**
* Strong knowledge of retail banking products (CASA, loans, deposits, insurance, investments).
* Wealth knowledge and customer handling skills
* Analytical skills

**Behavioural Competencies**
* Excellent communication skills and presentation skills
* High level of inter\-personal skills \& integrity
* Ability to influence Senior Management and provide thought leadership


**Qualifications**
* Educational Background: Preferably a Master’s Degree in any discipline, other banking certifications will be an advantage
* Work Experience: Experience in running sizeable profit centers, distribution networks with full accountability for strategy, costs and revenue.
* Track record of successful multi\-product sales in a retail business.


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Technical Account Manager - Growth Technology, India
description:
Why Join Us?
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced, dynamic and results\-driven Head of Growth Technology Sales to lead and accelerate our Growth Technologies business in India. This role will have strategic ownership of solutions including AI, SASE, Cloud Security, Web Application \& API Security (WAAP), Email \& Collaboration Security, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), and any emerging technologies identified as part of the Growth Technology portfolio.

You will report to the Regional Sales Director and collaborate closely with the country leadership, product specialists, and broader sales organization to achieve aggressive growth objectives.

 To drive growth and market leadership in key technology domains by building and executing a winning sales strategy, developing a high\-performing team, and delivering exceptional business outcomes for Check Point in India.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Sales \& Growth Execution

* Develop and execute sales strategies and go\-to\-market plans aligned with regional and global priorities.

**Qualifications**
 What You Bring

title: Affiliate & API Partnership Manager
description:
**Affiliate \& API Partnership Manager** 




**Location: Bangalore** 




  





**About NIRA** 




  





 NIRA is an exciting fintech startup which, starting with credit, is building financial services for India’s mass market.
 



  





 Today, if you were to think of the largest financial brands in India, you’d think of the banks: HDFC, ICICI, Kotak etc. They all serve the richest cohort of India’s society. Over the last few years some newer brands have emerged that target upwardly mobile millennials; think Slice, Moneyview, Uni Cards etc. The mass market, or Middle India, remains a white space. This is the gap that NIRA is looking to fill.
 



  





 Launched in 2018, NIRA has found a very strong product market fit, and has established itself as the category leader for the mass market segment. Since the passing of Covid, the company grew quickly and achieved profitability in 2023\. Last year brought some challenging headwinds, but we weathered those well and are well placed for our next phase of growth. This is a huge market, we need to go after it.
 



  





 Beyond personal loans, we’ll introduce both new credit and non\-credit products. NIRA will become the holistic provider of financial services for Middle India.
 



 NIRA was acquired by Tilt in 2025\. It continues to operate under its own band.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We’re looking for a driven and analytical Affiliate \& API Partnership Manager to boost lead generation and approvals through affiliate and API vendor channels. You’ll manage partner relationships, track performance, and help scale our growth efficiently.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Identify, onboard, and manage affiliate and API vendors.
* Optimize campaigns to improve lead\-to\-approval conversion.
* Monitor daily performance using tools like Appsflyer, and Excel.
* Negotiate payouts, track CAC, and remove fraudulent/non\-performing vendors.
* Collaborate with Tech, Risk, and Product teams for API integration and quality checks.
* Drive regular performance reviews and share actionable reports.
* Execute bulk communication campaigns to re\-engage or onboard partners.
* Share performance tracking reports with partners on a regular basis to enable transparency and iterations to campaign strategy.



  





**Requirements** 




  




* 2–5 years’ experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partnerships, or API Vendor Management.
* Strong analytical, coordination, and communication skills.
* Hands\-on experience in data tracking, campaign optimization, and reporting.
* Prior experience in fintech, NBFCs, or digital lending preferred though not essential.



  





**Performance Goals** 




  




* Increase approvals and lead quality through affiliate \& API channels.
* Maintain accurate, timely reports and improve efficiency month over month.
* Strengthen partnerships to drive consistent, high\-quality growth.



 If you’re proactive, data\-driven, and love scaling growth through smart partnerships, we’d love to connect!

title: Customer Success Associate (Commercial Accounts)
description:
As a Customer Success Associate, you will focus on the long term strategic relationship with our customers, drive adoption, and identify growth opportunities across a high volume of Datadog customers to ensure successful product use and retention. You’ll be an advocate for the customer internally and focus on providing a positive experience for a high volume of accounts. Associates follow a well\-defined methodology to identify the customer’s unique needs and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. As we scale our Customer Success team, furthering personal development and team success is a top priority.
   

  

*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture \- the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work\-life harmony that best fits them*
**What You’ll Do:**
* Identify target opportunities, manage the full sales cycle and proactively build strategic relationships with customers and focus on retention.
* Manage requests from your book of business such as but not limited to technical support escalations, billing questions, documentation/enablement requests to ensure a positive customer experience
* Pivot account management strategy based on different customer requirements and needs seamlessly and efficiently
* Act as an advisor to customers to ensure they’re leveraging the solution effectively
* Monitor and identify usage trends to uncover renewal risks and support greater adoption rates
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with internal Datadog teams (support, product, finance, and legal)


**Who You Are:**
* Customer\-minded, always trying to provide the most value possible
* Driven and motivated by a career in sales with a strong desire to grow a career in Customer Success.
* A strong communicator (written and verbal) with excellent attention to detail
* Experienced in independently negotiating contract terms and overcoming pricing objections for up\-sell/cross sell activities
* 2\+ years of experience in a customer account facing role and desire to grow a career in Customer Success
* Passionate about building long term and lasting relationships


*Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.*
**Benefits and Growth:**
* Best\-in\-breed onboarding
* Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message
* An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds
* Intra\-departmental mentor and buddy program for in\-house networking
* Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
* New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
* Generous global benefits


*Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.*
**About Datadog:**

title: Asset Manager
description:
**Manage the complete banking requirements of SME and corporate clients, including working capital, term loans, trade finance, foreign exchange, cash management, transaction banking and liability products, while identifying opportunities for cross\-selling and deepening client relationships.** 




 The candidate will be responsible for sourcing, advising and managing business banking relationships across working capital, trade finance, term lending, supply chain finance, export finance, business\-purpose mortgages, and insurance cross\-sell \- syndicated across BlissMoney’s panel of banks and NBFCs.
 



**1\. Products \& Services You Will Manage** 




  





**1\.1   Working Capital Finance** 




 ·       Cash Credit, Overdraft, Working Capital Demand Loans (WCDL), Dropline Overdraft, Short\-term loans and ad\-hoc limits
 



**1\.2   Trade Finance** 




 ·       Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Bill Discounting, Buyer’s Credit, Supplier’s Credit, Packing Credit, Post\-Shipment Finance, Export Bill Negotiation, Import Finance, Supply Chain Finance
 



**1\.3   Term Lending** 




 ·       Business Loans, Machinery / Equipment Finance, Commercial Property Loans, Capex Funding
 



**1\.4   Supply Chain \& Receivables Finance** 




 ·       Dealer Finance, Vendor Finance, Invoice Discounting, Factoring, Channel Finance
 



**1\.5 Export \& International Trade Finance** 





 ·       
 
**FCNR Funding:** 

 foreign\-currency funding sourced against FCNR(B) deposit\-linked facilities.
 





 ·       
 
**PCFC (Packing Credit in Foreign Currency):** 

 pre\-shipment export finance in foreign currency, complementing rupee\-denominated Packing Credit above.
 





 ·       
 
**EEFC Account\-Linked Facilities:** 

 supporting exporters who retain a portion of earnings in foreign currency.
 





 ·       
 
**Forfaiting:** 

 non\-recourse purchase of export receivables, distinct from and complementary to factoring.
 





 ·       
 
**Standby Letters of Credit (SBLC):** 

 for clients with cross\-border trade or contractual guarantee requirements.
 





 ·       
 
**External Commercial Borrowings (ECB) Facilitation:** 

 for larger export/import\-oriented clients seeking foreign currency term funding.
 




 ·       
 **ECGC\-Backed Export Credit Insurance:** 

 insurance
 
 \-supported export credit for clients trading in higher\-risk markets.
 



**1\.6 Business\-Purpose Mortgages** 




 ·       Loan Against Property (LAP) \- primarily for business owners raising capital against commercial or personal property.
 



**1\.7 Insurance Cross\-Sell** 





 ·       
 
**Loan Protection Insurance:** 

 bundled with any loan closed, tying directly into BlissMoney’s existing insurance services.
 





 ·       
 
**MSME / SME Insurance Products:** 

 broader business insurance \- property, liability, and other MSME\-relevant covers \- offered as a cross\-sell alongside lending, not limited to loan protection alone.
 




**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




  





**2\.1 Sourcing Business Banking Relationships** 




 ·       Build a pipeline of SME and corporate clients across working capital, trade finance, term lending and export finance needs \- leveraging existing banking relationships plus BlissMoney’s referral network.
 



 ·       Work leads handed over by the Wealth/RM team and existing client base.
 



**2\.2 Credit Assessment \& Structuring** 




 ·       Assess each client’s working capital cycle, trade flows, and credit need \- structuring a proposal a lender will actually approve.
 



 ·       For trade finance specifically: correctly structure LC, BG and documentary credit requirements, with working knowledge of INCOTERMS and export/import documentation.
 



**2\.3 Syndication \& Placement** 




 ·       Place the structured requirement with the right lender from BlissMoney’s panel of banks/NBFCs, based on rate, turnaround time, and eligibility fit.
 



 ·       For larger or foreign\-currency requirements, structure the facility across more than one lender where needed \- true syndication, not just referral.
 



**2\.4 Lender \& Partner Relationship Management** 




 ·       Build and maintain relationships with banks and NBFCs to secure competitive terms and faster turnaround for BlissMoney clients, across both lending and deposit\-side referrals.
 



**2\.5 Cross\-Sell \& Internal Coordination** 




 ·       Work closely with RMs and the Advisory team to identify banking and insurance cross\-sell opportunities within BlissMoney’s existing client base.
 



 ·       Keep the Advisory team informed when a client takes on new business debt, since it affects their overall financial picture.
 



**2\.6 Compliance \& Documentation** 




 ·       
 **DSA Registration:** 
 BlissMoney operates as a facilitator, partnered with banks and NBFC institutions. This role \- or BlissMoney as an entity \- will be registered as a Direct Selling Agent (DSA) with each partner lender.
 



 ·       Follow RBI and FEMA guidelines on loan sourcing, fair practices and cross\-border trade transactions at every stage. Maintain complete, audit\-ready documentation for every case, including export/import documentation where applicable.
 



**3\. What We’re Looking For** 




  






 ·       
 
**Primary Fit:** 
 currently or previously a Relationship Manager in a bank’s Business Banking Group (BBG), Small \& Business Banking (SBB), Mid\-Enterprise Group (MEG), or Corporate/Trade Finance desk \- or an equivalent business banking role at another bank or NBFC.
 




 ·       
 
 Genuine comfort assessing business credit and trade finance requirements \- reading financial statements, understanding working capital cycles, and structuring proposals across both rupee and foreign\-currency facilities.
 




 ·       
 
 Working knowledge of export/import documentation, RBI/FEMA guidelines governing trade finance and cross\-border transactions.
 




 ·       
 
 Comfort managing a full cycle independently \- from sourcing through structuring to closing \- without a separate handover to another closer.
 




 ·       
 
 Existing relationships with banks/NBFCs and business\-owner clients are a strong advantage, given the target candidate profile above.
 




 ·       
 
 Clear, honest communication \- business banking is a trust\-sensitive relationship, and clients need someone who explains terms plainly, not someone who oversells.

title: Client Success
description:
**About Bazaarvoice**
 At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product\-passionate community \& enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user\-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever\-expanding retail, social \& search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands \& retailers to gain valuable business insights from real\-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.
   

  

 The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long\-term loyalty.
   

  

 Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.
   

  

 Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!
   

  

* Job Overview


 This role is vital in ensuring Bazaarvoice customers receive the maximum possible value from their contracted services and achieve stated goals in the areas of Social \& E\-Commerce. You will leverage innovative technologies to support some of the world’s leading brands.
   

  

 Our Client Success Managers (CSMs) own the long\-term relationship between Bazaarvoice and our clients. CSM are strategic consultants. They provide business solutions and platform optimization to their clients. CSMs also partner with Account Directors who own renewal and commercial conversations.
   

  

 This role is pro\-active and dynamic. Each CSM will need strategic planning skills and the ability to provide value\-based messaging to articulate the tangible value of Bazaarvoice and to motivate client action. CSMs will also need to manage priorities across a varied portfolio of 70\-80 accounts.
   

  

 Each CSM is responsible for the care of a diverse, named portfolio of accounts in North America. CSMs leverage a variety of methods to drive adoption, increase satisfaction, mitigate risk, and identify opportunities for expansion. These methods are a blend of direct, digital, live, and pre\-recorded content. As a CSM, you will use strategic recommendations to drive value in our partnership and help our clients achieve their desired business outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Advise clients on strategies to maximize the value of their Bazaarvoice products and solutions by incorporating user\-generated content into online and offline operations including marketing, merchandising, customer service, product development, and distribution relationships.
* Observe and track trends across portfolio analytics to recommend best practices.
* Execute high\-value activities and manage client lifecycle across a significant portfolio using productivity tools (Salesforce, Gainsight, etc).
* Discover and influence client’s internal metrics for success working with Bazaarvoice, and ensure the client knows how to achieve and measure those results to maximize ROI.
* Help key stakeholders and client c\-level team understand the value they are receiving from Bazaarvoice.
* Manage client health by identifying and documenting risks, and working with cross\-functional team members to develop successful client outcomes.
* Promote new feature adoption to enhance client satisfaction and program performance.
* Prioritize and effectively blend tech\-driven, 1:many, and 1:1 client interactions across a diverse portfolio of SMB accounts.


**Skills And Experience Necessary For The Role**
* 2\-4 years of experience in account management or client success roles with US clients, ideally within software, online and/ or other marketing/ e\-commerce technologies.
* Skillful in time management, organizational systems, and prioritization.
* Ability to manage high volume of accounts and directly own client relationships concurrently.
* Sufficient in meeting deadlines and expectations with minimal supervision.
* High level of comfort with Microsoft Office and Google suites.
* Outstanding oral, written, and client\-facing presentation skills.

title: Customer Success
description:
**About Anthropic**
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join Anthropic's India\-based Customer Success team as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across India helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities \- API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.
   

  

 You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us. In partnership with the broader account team you, will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage (consumption \& seat based) grows and evolves.
   

  

 Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, implement change management strategies, optimize use cases, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our product development and go\-to\-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.
   

  

 As a founding CSM in India, you'll be a pioneer \- helping to build regional processes, establishing new customer relationships, and representing Anthropic's brand in a high\-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment with global teams, requiring someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and can work effectively across time zones.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build trusting, strategic relationships with key Indian customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion
* Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions
* Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and regional nuances to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption/ adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer
* Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both our consumption\-based and seat\-based products to drive full value from contracted commitments
* Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs as the voice of Indian customers
* Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment
* Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows
* Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end\-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement
* Own the customer experience across their lifecycle — managing comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conducting Quarterly Business Reviews, and serving as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic
* Build Anthropic's brand and customer relationships as one of the founding members of the India CS team, developing where needed, India\-specific processes, playbooks, and best practices that account for regional business cultures


**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* 12\+ years of experience in customer\-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Success Engineer or similar)
* Experience driving success across both consumption\-based and seat\-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each
* Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns
* Experience explaining and demonstrating technical products to various audiences
* Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans
* Cross\-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs
* Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple customer relationships
* Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems
* Experience working in and building a growing region, while navigating across time zones with US\-based headquarters
* A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves'' mentality. You are a true team player


**Logistics**
**Minimum education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
   

  

**Required field of study:** 
 A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
   

  

**Minimum years of experience:** 
 Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
   

  

**Location\-based hybrid policy:** 
 Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
   

  

**Visa sponsorship:** 
 We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
   

  

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** 
 Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
   

  

**Your safety matters to us.** 
 To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
   

  

**How We're Different**
 We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
   

  

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
   

  

**Come work with us!**
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
 **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** 
 Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for an Assistant Manager, Customer Success to own the parent\-and\-student relationship from onboarding through renewal. This is a retention\-first, commercially\-minded role: you’ll be the trusted point of contact for a portfolio of families, responsible for keeping students engaged, parents confident, and renewals flowing. Success is measured not by activity but by outcomes — attendance, learning progress, refund prevention, and a renewal rate as per industry standards
 



 The ideal person sits at the intersection of customer care and sales. You genuinely enjoy building relationships with parents, you’re comfortable having commercial conversations about renewals and packages, and you treat every family’s lifetime value as your personal responsibility.

**Own the renewal (primary mandate)**

* Consistently achieve good
 **renewal rate** 
 as per industry standards
* Proactively identify at\-risk families ahead of renewal dates and run save / win\-back plays.
* Position packages, add\-ons, and upgrades that match each student’s learning journey.



**Manage parent relationships \& queries** 



* Serve as the primary point of contact for parents, resolving queries around scheduling, tutors, curriculum, billing, and progress promptly and empathetically.
* Build trust through proactive, regular communication rather than reactive support.



**Drive engagement — attendance \& homework** 



* Track student attendance and homework completion across your portfolio; flag drop\-offs early.
* Intervene when engagement dips, coordinating with tutors and operations to get students back on track — because engagement is the leading indicator of renewal.



**Prevent refunds \& reduce churn** 



* Own refund prevention: identify dissatisfaction early, understand the root cause, and resolve it before a parent requests a refund.
* Negotiate and de\-escalate constructively, balancing parent satisfaction with business retention.



**Nurture for long\-term LTV** 



* Build long\-term relationships that extend customer lifetime value — guiding families across levels and years, not just the current package.
* Deliver a consistently delightful experience that turns parents into advocates and referral sources.



**Own the customer lifecycle** 



* Manage the full customer journey — onboarding, activation, ongoing engagement, renewal, and expansion.
* Monitor account\-health signals across the lifecycle and act on them proactively.
* Maintain accurate records of interactions, renewal status, and account health in the CRM.
* Collaborate with Sales, Tutor Operations, Product, and Support to remove barriers and improve the parent experience; surface recurring feedback to the relevant teams.



  





**Requirements** 




**Must\-have** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, or Sales \- ideally in edtech, online tutoring, or a B2C subscription business.
* **Proven track record in sales and renewals** 
 — you’ve personally owned retention / renewal targets and hit them.
* Strong relationship\-building and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with parents.
* Commercial acumen — comfortable with renewal conversations, negotiation, and objection handling.
* Data\-comfortable: able to track attendance / engagement metrics and act on account\-health signals.
* Empathy and patience in handling parent concerns, escalations, and refund situations.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with strong numerical aptitude and the ability to analyze, interpret, and derive meaningful insights from data.



**Good\-to\-have** 



* Experience managing a high\-volume B2C portfolio (many accounts at once).
* Background in education, tutoring, or working with parents and children.
* Experience with customer success / engagement tooling.



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)** 



* Consistently maintaining
 **renewal rate** 
 as per
 **industry standards** 
 .
* Measurable reduction in refund requests and churn.
* High parent satisfaction (CSAT / NPS) and improved student attendance and homework\-completion rates.
* Growing lifetime value across your book of families through renewals and appropriate upgrades.

SAP CDE helps customers accelerate their innovation adoption, delivering the flexibility to adapt to business changes, rapidly implement technologies and standardize and optimize operations of SAP centric solutions. The mission of the CDE Organization is to maximize the customer success by helping to manage complexity, ensure stable operations, mitigate risk and lowering total cost of operation, support customers on their journey to the intelligent enterprise powered by S4/HANA and releasing investment as well as customer resource capacity for innovation.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 The CDM is the voice of the client within SAP and recognized as the main contact and escalation point for all questions and issues with regards to the ECS engagement
   

  

 The Customer Delivery Manager (CDM) is the personal point of contact for all ECS customers, managing and coordinating all account activities with internal stakeholders and customers. The CDM cooperates closely with the Technical Service Managers (TSM) and the Project Lead (PL) during larger customer projects. The CDM builds a solid customer relationship and acts as a trusted advisor to the customer.
   

  

 The CDM ensures that SAP HANA Enterprise Cloud customers receive the best possible service by focusing on customer satisfaction, contract adherence and profitability. He/She is responsible for ensuring contractually agreed services are being rendered and that change requests are processed in a timely manner.
   

  

 The CDM cooperates closely with the customers’ IT department and business stakeholders, cooperatively planning and coordinating service requests. Also he is in contact with the Management / C\-Level and acts as trusted advisor who grows the business by driving the client’s digital transformation and generating higher customer value. The CDM shares monthly / quarterly reporting on the Service Level with the customer and advises on new services or other developments within SAP HANA Enterprise Cloud that increase the business value for the customer.
   

  

 The CDM role has variations depending on the customer’s contract type.
   

  

 CDM Tasks
   

  

 Some of the CDM’s task include:
   

  

* Actively drives the cloud transformation agenda with key client stakeholders to ensure adoption of S/4HANA and cloud standardization
* Lead the customer engagement and ensures seamless alignment across multiple internal and external stakeholders such as SAP Services, SAP Product support, ECS Partners and customer’s System Integrators or other Hosting Partners
* Perform administrative tasks required to manage the engagement (staffing, reporting \& controlling).
* Manage proactive delivery of service plans and reactive support requests
* Host regular status and governance meetings with customers and other SAP stakeholders (extended account team)
* Drive transformation and onboarding towards SAP Cloud Solutions
* Drives end\-to\-end customer engagement including commercial responsibility (costs and profitability), customer expectations, delivery team success, customer reporting and invoicing
* Achieve customer reference collateral and customer satisfaction responses
* Deliver best through proactive mindset and de\-escalate critical customer situations
* Protect and grow engagement scope and manage commercial change requests
* Participate in team\-internal knowledge sharing and coach other team members
* Expected to spend up to 20% of time onsite at client location


**Education And Qualification / Skills And Competencies**
 WORK EXPERIENCE
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred in Business Administration, Computer Science, Technical Engineering, Economics or related field
* Must have Knowledge of SAP’s cloud business, cloud and hybrid infrastructure and cloud operation processes
* Experienced in IT service providers and managing outsourcing engagements.
* SAP Basis, technology, and/or functional knowledge are very important.
* Technical infrastructure know\-how and technical understanding of virtualized system landscapes is critical for this role.
* Strong SAP technology stack expertise including SAP ECC, S/4HANA, NetWeaver, and SAP Basis administration.
* Experience with SAP HANA and enterprise databases (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2\).
* Knowledge of Linux, Unix, and Windows operating systems supporting SAP environments.
* Experience with hyperscaler platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
* Understanding of cloud and hybrid SAP landscapes, virtualization, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with SAP ECS, RISE with SAP, and cloud transformation programs.
* Knowledge of SAP Solution Manager and/or SAP Cloud ALM.
* Experience leading SAP upgrades, migrations, and technical transformation initiatives.
* Strong project management skills \& customer\-facing experience
* Strong ability to translate between technical and non\-tec hnical audience with confidence
* Strong engagement management, relationship building and de\-escalation skills
* Excellent presentation, communication and moderator skills
* High competency in multi\-tasking and ability to manage multiple engagements in parallel
* Accustomed to working in an international and global virtual matrix organization
* High proficiency in English. Additional languages are a big plus
* Knowledge and certifications in standards and methodologies for SAP IT operations (e.g. SAP CCoE, ITIL V4 Foundation or Expert Level, Run SAP standards, Solution Manager ALM) are beneficial.
* Certification in project management methodology (e.g. PMP) is beneficial
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience in project management or SAP Operations
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing role
* Minimum 4 to 6 years of experience in service management capacity managing multiple clients.

title: Strategic Accounts Manager
description:

This role collaborates with internal stakeholders and customer leadership teams to identify opportunities, develop account\-specific strategies, and support achievement of business objectives across assigned accounts.

title: Senior Manager – Delivery & Client Fulfilment
description:
**Role Purpose** 




 Drive client acquisition and account growth while owning day\-to\-day delivery and fulfilment on those accounts. Sales is a main part of this role, alongside delivery: the role opens and grows client relationships, converts demand into requirements, and ensures they are fulfilled on time and at quality through the Talent Acquisition organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Sales \& Business Development** 



* Acquire new clients and vendor empanelment across Oracle, SAP, Digital, Cyber Security and Data Engineering.
* Farm and expand existing accounts; grow wallet share, requirement volumes and service lines.
* Build and run the sales pipeline — lead generation, client outreach, funnel hygiene, conversion and win rate.
* Support commercial discussions, rate cards, MSAs and renewals in line with approved guidelines.
* Track market demand, competitor rates and hiring trends; bring intelligence back to shape the offering.



**Delivery \& Client Fulfilment** 



* Own end\-to\-end fulfilment on assigned accounts — requirement intake, calibration, allocation with the TA managers, submissions, interviews, offers and onboarding.
* Run daily and weekly delivery reviews with TA managers; track submissions, interview\-to\-offer ratios, TAT and open positions.
* Ensure quality and SLA adherence; resolve delivery bottlenecks and escalations quickly.
* Agree feasibility on client turnaround times, volumes and headcount with the Global Head – Talent Acquisition before committing to clients.
* Coordinate with bench, onboarding and resource management to improve redeployment and reduce bench cost.



**Client Management** 



* Be the primary point of contact for assigned clients on both business development and delivery.
* Lead account reviews and client governance calls; present delivery performance and pipeline.
* Build relationships with client hiring managers, procurement and vendor management teams.
* Manage client feedback, satisfaction and account retention.


- 


**Key Performance Indicators** 



* New clients and empanelment added; account expansion and wallet share.
* Requirement inflow, pipeline conversion and win rate.
* Fulfilment rate, closures, TAT and SLA adherence.
* Submission\-to\-interview and interview\-to\-offer ratios.
* Bench utilization and redeployment.
* Client satisfaction and account retention.



**Requirements** 



* 15\+ years in staffing, RPO or IT consulting, with strong command of contract and permanent staffing.
* Proven record in both sales (new logos, account growth) and delivery (requirement fulfilment) in an IT staffing environment.
* End\-to\-end TA knowledge — sourcing, screening, offer management, onboarding and bench.
* Experience across Oracle, SAP, Digital, Cyber Security or Data Engineering hiring markets preferred.
* Strong client communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Working knowledge of an ATS and MIS reporting.
* Based in Bangalore and working from the office.

title: Strategic Partner Manager
description:
**About Us**
 Proofpoint is a global leader in human\- and agent\-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.
   

  

**How We Work**
 At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values
   

  

**Bold** 
 in how we dream and innovate
   

  

**Responsive** 
 to feedback, challenges and opportunities
   

  

**Accountable** 
 for results and best in class outcomes
   

  

**Visionary** 
 in future focused problem\-solving
   

  

**Exceptional** 
 in execution and impact
   

  

 Corporate Overview
   

  

 In today’s cyber threat landscape, protection starts with people. At Proofpoint, that simple truth fuels our passion for protecting users, the data they create, and the systems they rely on from a uniquely people\-centric perspective.
   

  

 And we’re just as passionate about finding the right people to help us in that mission. When you join Proofpoint, you’re helping to
   

  

* Build and enhance our proven security platform
* Blend innovation and speed in a constantly evolving cloud environment
* Analyze new threats and offer deep insight through data\-driven intel
* Collaborate with customers to help solve their toughest security challenges


 We are singularly devoted to helping our customers protect their greatest assets and biggest security risk their people. That’s why we’re a leader in next\-generation cybersecurity—and why more than half of the Fortune 100 trust us as a security partner.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Strategic Partner Manager is a senior\-level individual contributor responsible for managing and optimizing operational performance across Proofpoint’s third\-party Technical Customer Support vendor partners. This role ensures that vendor activities are aligned with business priorities, drives operational improvements, and amplifies the effectiveness of our global support ecosystem.
   

  

 as a Strategic Partner Manager
   

  

 Acting as a key strategic advisor to the Director, Vendor Management, this role requires strong analytical skills, operational depth, and the ability to influence both internal stakeholders and external vendor leaders—without direct people management.
   

  

 Your day\-to\-day
   

  

 Vendor Strategy \& Relationship Management
   

  

* Partner closely with vendor leadership to ensure alignment with Proofpoint’s goals, support strategy, and customer experience standards.
* Serve as a strategic liaison between internal teams and vendor partners to drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Monitor contract adherence and identify opportunities to optimize vendor services.


 Operational Excellence
   

  

* Evaluate vendor performance across KPIs, SLAs, quality metrics, and productivity benchmarks.
* Identify operational gaps, propose structured improvement plans, and track progress through completion.
* Support readiness for product changes, workflow modifications, and major program rollouts.


 Cross\-Functional Partnership
   

  

* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Support Operations, and internal Support teams to ensure vendor alignment with business needs.
* Represent the vendor organization in cross\-functional meetings, project discussions, and operational reviews.
* Communicate vendor impact, risks, and opportunities clearly to senior leadership.


 Program \& Process Leadership
   

  

* Lead vendor\-related initiatives and process improvement programs—driving structure, documentation, and execution.
* Maintain operational playbooks, escalation guides, SOPs, and readiness materials.
* Partner with training and quality teams to ensure consistent vendor skill development.


 Data Analysis \& Reporting
   

  

* Analyze vendor data to identify performance trends, root causes, capacity issues, and customer\-impacting concerns.
* Build dashboards, scorecards, and executive\-level summaries to highlight insights and drive decision\-making.
* Provide recommendations based on data—focusing on efficiency, quality, and customer experience.


 Escalation and Issue Management
   

  

* Support vendor escalations, incident management, and service disruptions.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive cross\-functional resolution and long\-term corrective action.
* Track recurring issues and propose systemic solutions.


 Strategic Support
   

  

* Support the Director in defining vendor strategy, long\-term operational planning, and organizational alignment.
* Assess vendor capabilities and recommend changes to staffing models, resourcing, or support coverage


 What you bring to the team
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in Technical Support, Vendor Management, Customer Support Operations, or related fields.
* Strong background in global support environments or outsourced/BPO operations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Advanced analytical skills with experience in metrics, dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor messaging for executive audiences.
* Experience managing complex projects or programs with cross\-functional collaboration.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
* Experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or technical support environments.
* Familiarity with workforce planning, vendor capacity modeling, or support forecasting.
* Background in business process optimization or operational strategy.


 Why Proofpoint
   

  

 Protecting people is at the heart of our award\-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions, and the people who work here are the key to our success. We’re a customer\-focused and driven\-to\-win organization with leading\-edge products—and many exciting reasons to join our team. We believe in hiring the best the brightest and cultivating a culture of collaboration and appreciation. We are a diverse, multinational company with opportunities in all functions, and leaders that welcome candidates from all walks of life. Apply today and explore your future .
   

  

**Why Proofpoint?**
 At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us
   

  

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits
* Career success on your terms
* Flexible work environment
* Annual wellness and community outreach days
* Always on recognition for your contributions
* Global collaboration and networking opportunities

title: Strategic Partnerships
description:
**About Astra:** 




 Astra Security is a leader in the penetration testing space, recognized by G2 in the Pentest category. With headquarters in the US \& India, Astra is the trusted security partner for leading brands including Muthoot Finance, Loom, CompTIA, NIIT, Goldcast, HackerRank, Sprinto, ITC \& more. Its one\-of\-a\-kind continuous pentest platform is trusted by 1,200\+ companies across 100\+ countries, from fast\-growing startups to Fortune 100 giants.
 



 Astra's autonomous pentest platform pairs AI agents with certified human pentesters to continuously pentest applications and infrastructure at scale. Vulnerabilities are discovered, validated, and chained the way a real attacker would. Beyond pentesting, Astra's suite includes a DAST Scanner, Cloud Vulnerability Scanner, and API Security Platform, giving teams continuous coverage across web apps, cloud environments, and APIs from a single dashboard. With over 18,000 vulnerabilities detected daily, Astra helps customers prevent millions in potential losses while saving thousands of developer hours. Last year alone, Astra uncovered more than 6\.8 million vulnerabilities for its customers.
 



 Astra's research team actively contributes to the OWASP community, including helping shape the OWASP Autonomous Penetration Testing Standard (APTS) and contributing to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Generative AI Security Risks. Astra is CREST\-accredited, CERT\-IN empaneled, and a PCI ASV, reflecting its commitment to the highest standards of security testing.
 



 We've been awarded by the President of France Mr. François Hollande at the La French Tech program and Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi at the Global Conference on Cyber Security. Loom, MamaEarth, Muthoot Finance, Canara Robeco, ScripBox etc. are a few of Astra’s customers
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 At Astra Security, we are building the future of cybersecurity with Autonomous Pentesting — helping teams continuously discover, validate, and fix vulnerabilities across their applications and infrastructure.
 



 We are looking for a Product Partnerships leader to build and scale Astra's ecosystem of technology partners across cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, developer tools, compliance, and adjacent platforms.
 



 This is a high\-impact, commercially focused role where you will identify the right technology partners, unlock product integrations and marketplace opportunities, and build joint go\-to\-market motions that translate into measurable pipeline and revenue.
 



 You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to take partnerships from identification and negotiation through integration, launch, co\-selling, and revenue generation.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**Build Astra's Product Partner Ecosystem** 



* Identify and establish partnerships with complementary SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud, developer, compliance, and technology platforms across key geographies.
* Build relationships with Product, Partnerships, Alliances, and GTM leaders within partner organizations.
* Develop a structured partner pipeline based on customer overlap, product fit, integration potential, and commercial opportunity.
* Own the end\-to\-end partnership lifecycle from prospecting and business case development to negotiation, launch, and ongoing growth.
* Build a scalable product partnership strategy across different geographies and partner segments.



**Drive Product Integrations \& Marketplace Partnerships** 



* Identify high\-value integration opportunities that strengthen Astra's product offering and increase customer adoption.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering to define integration requirements, priorities, and launch plans.
* Build partnerships that enable Astra to participate in technology marketplaces and partner platforms.
* Drive marketplace and platform\-sourced business by creating repeatable partner\-led acquisition motions.
* Track adoption, pipeline, and revenue generated through product integrations and technology partnerships.



**Build Joint GTM \& Co\-Sell Motions** 



* Develop joint value propositions, solution positioning, sales plays, and enablement with strategic partners.
* Work with Sales teams to identify and activate joint customer opportunities.
* Build co\-selling and co\-marketing motions that generate measurable partner\-influenced pipeline.
* Coordinate joint launches, webinars, campaigns, events, and other GTM initiatives where relevant.
* Establish processes to track partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline through the sales funnel.



**Drive Commercial Outcomes** 



* Directly own business outcomes from product partnerships, including partner\-sourced ARR and partner\-influenced pipeline.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful partnerships across additional products, customer segments, and geographies.
* Establish clear business cases and success metrics for each strategic partnership.
* Regularly measure partnership performance and double down on partnerships demonstrating strong customer and commercial impact.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Act as the internal owner and champion for strategic product partnerships.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure partner initiatives move from concept to execution.
* Bring partner and customer feedback into Astra's product and ecosystem roadmap.
* Create repeatable processes for evaluating, launching, and scaling partnerships.



  





**Key KPIs** 




 Success in this role will be measured through tangible commercial and ecosystem outcomes, including:
 


* Marketplace / Platform\-Sourced ARR
* Co\-Sell / Co\-GTM Pipeline Generated
* Number of Product Partnerships Unlocked in Each Target Geography
* Product integrations launched and activated
* Partner\-sourced / partner\-influenced revenue
* Partner activation and adoption
* Expansion of successful partnerships across products and geographies



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Experience in Product Partnerships, Technology Partnerships, Strategic Partnerships, Ecosystem Partnerships, or Platform Partnerships.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS, preferably cybersecurity or an adjacent technology category.
* Demonstrated experience building partnerships with technology products and SaaS platforms, rather than primarily reseller or channel relationships.
* Experience taking partnerships from identification → integration → marketplace / platform launch → joint GTM → revenue generation.
* Strong understanding of product integrations, APIs, marketplaces, technology ecosystems, and joint solution development.
* Demonstrated ability to build co\-sell and co\-GTM motions with sales teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience tying partnerships to measurable pipeline, ARR, adoption, or revenue outcomes.
* Experience working with US or global SaaS companies is highly preferred.
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Builder mindset with the ability to operate in a zero\-to\-one environment, create processes from scratch, and independently drive initiatives to completion.

title: Lead- Customer Success (7+Yrs)
description:
**The role** 




 You will own customer experience across TMRW's direct\-to\-consumer brands.
 



 For a set of brands, you will run the function directly — the team, service levels, agent partners, quality, escalations and the daily operating rhythm. Across the wider portfolio, you will own the standard: the playbook, the metric definitions, the tool stack, the quality framework, and a reporting layer that allows any brand to be compared with another on the same basis.
 



 The work is inherently cross\-functional. What brings a customer to us rarely originates inside customer experience alone — it runs through logistics, technology, communications and merchandising. A significant part of the role is diagnosing clearly, quantifying the impact, and partnering with the owning function to resolve it at source.
 



  





**Why this role** 




 Most customer experience roles give you one of two things: a queue to run at a single brand, or a standards remit with no operation underneath it. This one has both. You will run the function day to day for a set of brands — close enough to see what a fix does to the numbers within a week — and own the standard that carries across the rest of the portfolio.
 



  





**How you work** 



* You read customer contact as a signal about the business, not only as a workload to staff for.
* You would rather publish one number everyone trusts than several that flatter.
* You can defend every number you have claimed — how it was derived, what the base was, and what else moved at the same time.
* You judge automation on the experience it delivers, not only on what it deflects.
* You arrive with the diagnosis and the owner, not just the escalation.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity — you build the process rather than wait for it.
* You take ownership past the boundaries of the role when something important is broken.



  





 What you will own
 



**Customer experience operations** 




*For the brands you run directly* 
 — day\-to\-day support across chat, email, voice, WhatsApp and social. Staffing and shift coverage, answer rates, resolution service levels, and escalation handling.
 



**Agent partnerships** 




*For the brands you run directly* 
 — partner selection, commercial terms, service level governance, quality oversight and transitions. Agent capacity is largely outsourced; the outcome is owned here.
 



**Automation and tooling** 




*Across the portfolio* 
 — conversational AI and bot platforms, ticketing, social and calling tools. Platform consolidation and per\-contact economics, working with technology to deliver outcomes through them.
 



**Standards and governance** 




*Across the portfolio* 
 — ticket taxonomy, metric definitions, quality and audit framework, dashboards, SOPs and response libraries, applied consistently across brands.
 



**Voice of the customer** 




*Across the portfolio* 
 — Net Promoter Score programmes, uninstall and exit surveys, app store sentiment, and ticket\-led root cause analysis, routed to the teams that can act on it.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




**Reduce customer contact at source.** 
 Treat contact volume as a signal rather than a workload. Identify the underlying drivers, size them, and work with the owning function to remove them — alongside, not instead of, improving how well contacts are handled.
 



**Work across the portfolio rather than one brand at a time.** 
 Similar drivers recur across brands at different stages of maturity. Diagnose once, address in parallel, and build shared capability so each brand benefits from what the last one learned.
 



**Own the metrics and their definitions.** 
 Publish contact rate per order, customer satisfaction by channel, bot satisfaction, Net Promoter Score, first\-contact resolution, response and resolution service levels, and app ratings. Keep definitions consistent across brands and periods, and be clear about what has genuinely improved and what has not.
 



**Set the automation bar.** 
 Automation carries a growing share of contacts. Hold deflection and customer satisfaction together as a single question, and be deliberate about which queries should always reach a person.
 



**Manage partners commercially.** 
 Negotiate per\-contact and per\-seat economics, govern service levels, and plan vendor transitions with adequate overlap and clear knowledge transfer. Consolidate tooling where fragmentation is not earning its cost.
 



**Build quality as a system.** 
 Attribute dissatisfaction to its source — agent, process, technology or customer — and convert the pattern into coaching, process change or engineering work. Own sampling, audit cadence and training capacity.
 



**Partner with senior stakeholders.** 
 Present regularly to brand leadership and functional heads with a clear diagnosis, a named owner and a specific ask. Own escalations, including the difficult ones, and build the credibility that makes the standard worth adopting.
 



**Lead and grow the team.** 
 Four in\-house leads covering operations, quality and training report to you, alongside the agent teams run by our partners. Set the bar for who joins, run real development plans, and build a bench that can hold the standard without you in the room.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You will be in the ticket data, in vendor reviews and on escalations yourself, not only directing them.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 



* **Six or more years of experience, with at least four in customer experience or support operations**
* **Direct people management of support teams** 
 — in\-house, outsourced, or both, as their reporting manager
* **Experience in a direct\-to\-consumer or e\-commerce business**
