title: Head of Operations
description:
Head of Operations \| VYONE
 
**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
 



**Experience:** 
 8–10 years
 



**Role Type:** 
 Founding Team / Senior Leadership
 



  





 VYONE is building a new category in automotive ownership in India. Our ambition is to create a trusted ownership ecosystem that supports customers throughout their vehicle journey, from buying and servicing to insurance, maintenance, resale, and everything in between.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Head of Operations** 
 who can help us build that ecosystem from the ground up.
 



 This is not a traditional operations role where established processes already exist. We are looking for a
 **builder** 
 . Someone who enjoys starting with a blank sheet, is open to new ideas, challenges conventional ways of working, experiments quickly, and can convert ideas into scalable operating systems.
 



  





 The person joining us should have
 **8–10 years of operations experience** 
 , preferably across automotive, mobility, service businesses, marketplaces, customer experience, fleet management, dealer operations, insurance, or other businesses involving large partner ecosystems.
   




 What you will be responsible for
 
 You will own and build VYONE's operational backbone, including the processes, partnerships, service network, customer experience standards, and operational frameworks required to scale the business.
 



  





 A major part of your role will be identifying and building relationships with the right partners across the automotive ecosystem, including dealerships, service centres, workshops, insurance providers, roadside assistance companies, detailing partners, tyre and battery partners, financing companies, used\-car networks, and other relevant service providers. Partner identification, onboarding, governance, and performance management are already central themes in the current role definition.
 



  





 You will also work closely with the founders to identify
 **new business segments and opportunities** 
 where VYONE can create value. We want this person to continuously think about how the VYONE ecosystem can expand, what new categories we can enter, what partnerships we should build, and how those partnerships can create stronger value for both customers and VYONE.
 



 The role will involve building a strong
 **VYONE Business Partner Network** 
 across the market. You will help create a structured ecosystem where selected partners work with VYONE under clearly defined service standards, commercial arrangements, customer experience guidelines, and SLAs. The objective is not simply to onboard vendors, but to create a reliable network that becomes an important part of VYONE's competitive advantage.
 



  





 You will design operational processes across the complete customer lifecycle, ensuring that every interaction is simple, transparent, dependable, and built around customer trust. This includes defining workflows, escalation processes, quality standards, turnaround times, communication protocols, and partner accountability.
 



  





 You will also work closely with the product and technology teams to translate real\-world operational requirements into scalable systems, dashboards, workflows, and automation. As the business grows, your responsibility will be to ensure that processes that begin manually can eventually become structured, technology\-enabled, and scalable.
   




 Who we are looking for
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **entrepreneurial, hands\-on, commercially aware, and comfortable operating in ambiguity** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who can walk into a new market, understand how the ecosystem works, identify the right partners, negotiate relationships, build processes, solve operational gaps, and continuously improve the customer experience.
 



 Most importantly, you must have a
 **builder mindset** 
 . VYONE is still being built, which means ideas will evolve, processes will change, and new opportunities will emerge. We want someone who welcomes that environment instead of waiting for a finished playbook.
 



  





 Experience in automotive operations, mobility, fleet management, aftersales, dealer operations, service networks, automotive insurance, customer lifecycle management, marketplaces, or partner\-led businesses would be highly relevant.
 



  





 Strong experience in
 **partner and vendor management, operational process design, SLA management, customer experience, commercial negotiations, cost management, and operational performance** 
 will be important for this role.
   




 What success will look like
 
 Success in this role will mean building a dependable partner ecosystem, improving service quality, creating scalable operational processes, maintaining strong partner performance, controlling service economics, and delivering an experience that customers consistently trust.
 



 As VYONE grows, this person will play a major role in defining
 **how the business operates, how our partner ecosystem works, and how we build an entirely new category within India's automotive ownership market** 
 .
 



  





 If you have spent your career running operations but have always wanted the opportunity to
 **build something rather than simply manage something** 
 , we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Join VYONE and help us build the operating ecosystem behind the future of car ownership in India.**

title: Customer Success Executive – Client & Partner Operations
description:
Customer Success Executive – Client \& Partner Operations
   


**Bengaluru (HSR Layout) · On\-site, 5 days · Immediate joiners preferred** 
  




 About Finkraft
   


 Finkraft is a Bengaluru\-based travel\-fintech recovering money that large enterprises silently lose every year in their expense and compliance processes. We work with
 **1,250\+ enterprise clients** 
 , including
 **HCL, Philips, Volkswagen, Cipla, BCG, Tata Communications, JSW, Cleartrip and BCD** 
 — Fortune 500 manufacturers, global consulting firms and India's largest IT services and travel companies.
   





 For a single client this runs into crores a year. We've built the platform and the data engine. What turns it into recovered money is a network of partner businesses doing their part — and that is the function you'd be joining.
   




 Role \& responsibilities
   

* **Own a partner portfolio end to end.** 
 You're the single point of contact for your set of partner businesses — onboarding them, getting them transacting, and keeping the relationship warm enough that next month is easier than this one.
* **Drive high\-volume outbound follow\-ups.** 
 This is a phone\-first role: 60–90 conversations a day with operations staff, finance teams and business owners to close out pending documentation and commitments.
* **Escalate and unblock.** 
 When a partner who committed three weeks ago goes quiet, there's no escalation matrix handed to you. You work out who in that organisation can actually say yes, and you get to them — by phone, by WhatsApp, or by showing up.
* **Onboard new partners onto the platform,** 
 walking them through the process and getting them to first transaction quickly.
* **Conduct on\-ground visits across Bengaluru** 
 where a face across the table moves things faster than a call — to onboard, unblock, or repair a stalled relationship.
* **Resolve client escalations.** 
 When an enterprise client flags something missing, you're the person who chases it down, fixes it, and reports back.
* **Coordinate internally** 
 with data, product and operations teams to close cases that need more than a follow\-up.
* **Maintain accurate, current records.** 
 Every commitment, follow\-up and outcome logged — what we report to our clients is only as good as your tracker.


 Requirements
   

  

 Education \& eligibility
   

* **Any graduate.** 
 Stream and institution are not filters — we hire on capability, not credentials.
* **Fluent English and Hindi** 
 on the phone, with the confidence to hold a commercial conversation with a business owner or finance controller. Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi or Bengali is a genuine advantage and we weight it in selection.
* **Working comfort with Excel / Google Sheets** 
 — filters, lookups, and a tracker you keep clean without being asked.
* **Based in Bengaluru or willing to relocate,** 
 available to work 5 days a week from our HSR Layout office.
* **Immediate or 15\-day joiners preferred.**


 Preferred background
   


**1\+ year in an outbound, outcome\-owned role.** 
 Industry doesn't matter. What matters is that you were measured on whether the thing happened — not on how many calls you logged.
   





 Backgrounds that map well:
   




* Customer success or post\-sales, where renewals and adoption were yours to hit
* Collections and recovery — B2B, consumer, or NBFC
* Fee and payment recovery in edtech
* B2B inside sales or account management
* Client servicing in a role where you chased external stakeholders for deliverables


 Benefits
   

  

 Why this role is worth your time
   


 This isn't a support function sitting downstream of the business. It is one of our two largest revenue lines, and the difference between a portfolio worked well and one worked badly shows up directly in what we bill and what our clients get back. You'll deal with finance and operations leaders at Fortune 500 companies, and you'll see the outcome of your own work in a number every month.
   





 Growth from here runs into account ownership, partner management, and team leadership as the function scales. We'd rather promote from here than hire above it.

title: Sr. CSM (Logistics Tech)
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

****ABOUT THE ROLE:****
 We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own our enterprise customer relationships end to end. Our CS team owns the full commercial relationship, strategic account management, adoption, renewal, expansion, and customer support, working directly with enterprise customers and their C\-suite. This is a senior individual\-contributor (IC) role for someone who can build trust and credibility at that level.
   

  

 At the heart of the role is discovery. The best expansion comes from deeply understanding what each customer is really trying to achieve, where their pain sits, and how Portcast turns their data into decisions and measurable business impact. Strong discovery is what lets you deepen adoption, grow your accounts, and drive real revenue from your existing customers, through upsell, cross\-sell, and new teams and regions.
   

  

 You'll also be technically fluent enough to be the customer's first point of contact on their questions and tickets, triaging the issue, working with our Data team to get the answer, and communicating a clear resolution back to the customer, all alongside the strategic work: QBRs, success plans, renewals, and expansion.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* Enterprise customers deeply adopt Portcast with measurable business outcomes, and see you as a trusted advisor at both the operational and C\-suite level.
* Discovery that consistently surfaces real customer needs and turns them into adoption, retention, and expansion.
* A steady expansion pipeline from existing accounts (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams and regions), with CS trusted, internally and by customers, to identify and drive those deals.
* Fast, credible resolution of customer questions and tickets, in partnership with the Data team, so customers always get reliable answers and stay confident in Portcast.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Own the full enterprise customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, and retention, ensuring a smooth, high\-impact experience.
* Lead discovery: deeply understand each customer's goals, workflows, pain points, and internal decision processes, so you can grow the account and drive expansion.
* Be a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, including C\-suite, aligning Portcast to their strategic goals and addressing their challenges.
* Identify and drive expansion (upsell, cross\-sell, new teams, new regions) in partnership with Sales, positioning CS as a credible driver of new revenue from existing customers.
* Own customer questions and tickets: triage the issue, work with the Data team to get the answer, then review and communicate a clear resolution back to the customer.
* Run QBRs, success plans, and regular check\-ins, using data, outcomes, and clear narratives to drive adoption and expansion.
* Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to channel customer feedback and influence the roadmap.
* Analyze customer usage and data to surface actionable insights and continuously improve the customer journey.


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Logistics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent.
* 7\+ years in a commercial, customer\-facing role, Customer Success, Account Management, Pre\-sales/Solutions, or Sales, within the logistics industry or logistics technology space.
* A pre\-sales or solutions background is highly valued. Strong discovery is one of the most important skills in this role, it's what lets you expand existing customers and drive new revenue.
* Logistics / logistics\-tech domain: familiarity with freight forwarding and global logistics workflows, and the ability to confidently engage customers across operations and commercial stakeholders.
* Comfortable with enterprise customers and their C\-suite, with strong stakeholder management across functions and seniority levels.
* Technical fluency: comfortable with basic data, APIs, and SaaS concepts, enough to handle customer questions and tickets, work with our Data team, and translate technical answers into clear customer\-facing resolutions.
* A track record of driving account expansion (upsell, cross\-sell) and revenue growth from existing customers.
* Experience running QBRs and structured account success plans, using data and outcomes to drive adoption and expansion.
* Excellent, structured communication, especially with complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise customers.
* High ownership and independence, with the ability to operate in a lean startup environment and a bias for action.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Work at the intersection of AI, data, and logistics: help enterprise customers turn predictive data into decisions and measurable business impact.
* Real impact from day one: we're lean by design, with few layers between you and the outcome, so your work moves adoption, retention, and expansion directly.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: This is where discovery lives. We dig beneath what a customer asks for to what they're actually trying to achieve, staying genuinely curious about their business, their workflows, and how a freight forwarder really operates. That depth is where every expansion starts.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We own the customer relationship and the commercial outcome end to end, adoption, renewal, and expansion, and we stay on an account until the value is real and the number moves.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for a renewed contract. We aim for customers who adopt deeply, expand with us, and become advocates, and we hold ourselves to that standard on every account.
* Effectiveness: We focus on the outcomes that matter, real adoption, retention, and revenue growth from our customers, not check\-ins or activity for their own sake. We prioritize the accounts and conversations that actually move the business.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring all service activities are running smoothly and issues are addressed promptly
* Monitor ongoing delivery of elluminate® platform services across assigned accounts, proactively identifying and resolving operational gaps before they affect the client
* Coordinate day\-to\-day activities across internal teams — including Engineering ( Tier 3 R\&D), Tech Services (Tier 2\), IT (Infrastructure), Product Development, Implementation Team, Customer Success and Product Support — to ensure seamless, timely service execution
* Track open action items, outstanding deliverables, and client requests across all active engagements; follow through until each item is fully resolved
* Serve as the escalation point for operational issues, triaging problems quickly and mobilizing the right internal resources for resolution

* Participate in the transition of accounts from the Implementation team to steady\-state service delivery, ensuring continuity of knowledge, documentation, and client experience throughout the handover process
* Ensure all service activities adhere to agreed\-upon SLAs, quality standards, and regulatory requirements including ICH/GCP guidelines and 21 CFR Part 11
* Conduct regular operational reviews of active engagements, reviewing delivery metrics, identifying trends, and driving corrective actions where needed
* Maintain thorough and accurate service documentation, including status reports, issue logs, meeting notes, and delivery records
* Support audit readiness by ensuring client\-facing deliverables and internal processes meet required compliance and quality benchmarks

* Participate in regular client operational meetings, providing clear and accurate updates on service status, open items, and upcoming milestones
* Communicate service changes, delays, or risks to clients in a timely and professional manner, always paired with a resolution path
* Gather and document client operational feedback; relay themes internally to help improve processes and service delivery
* Ensure the client experience is consistent and well\-coordinated across all touchpoints, from onboarding through steady\-state service delivery
* Identify inefficiencies in service workflows and work collaboratively with internal teams to implement practical improvements

* Bachelor’s degree required; field in life sciences, health sciences, information systems, or a related discipline preferred
* 5\+ years of experience in a service/project management, service/project delivery, or operations role within the life sciences, clinical research, or health technology sector preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; ability to work confidently with global stakeholders across the US, Europe, and Asia Pacific
* Comfortable working in shifts or flexible hours to overlap with US and European client time zones as required
* Detail\-oriented and process\-driven; comfortable working within defined frameworks while identifying opportunities to improve them


**Technical Skills \& Experience**
* Hands\-on experience managing the operational delivery of technology\-enabled services in a regulated clinical environment
* Solid understanding of clinical data management concepts, clinical trial operations, ICH/GCP guidelines, and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements
* Experience working with or supporting EDC systems (e.g., Medidata Rave, Veeva Vault EDC) or clinical data platforms strongly preferred
* Strong organizational skills with a proven ability to track multiple concurrent workstreams, deliverables, and open items without dropping the ball
* Proficient with Microsoft 365 applications (Teams, Outlook, Excel, Word, SharePoint) and familiarity with project (SmartSheet) or service management tools (Service Now, Zendesk)
* A dependable team player who takes ownership of outcomes and thrives in a fast\-paced, client\-focused environment

title: Senior Manager - HVAC LNM
description:
Who we are
   

  

 Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
   

  

 For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

 The Service Sales Manager will be responsible for driving Labour \& Material sales growth across Building Automation Systems (BAS) and Low Side service offerings. The role focuses on developing strong customer relationships, generating service business opportunities, influencing project specifications, and achieving sales and profitability targets while ensuring customer satisfaction.
   

  

 How You Will Do It
   

  

* Drive Labour \& Material (L\&M) service sales to achieve assigned sales targets and margin objectives.
* Build and maintain relationships with building owners, consultants, contractors, and key stakeholders to promote Johnson Controls service solutions.
* Influence project specifications and position Johnson Controls products and services during the early stages of project development.
* Conduct customer meetings, site visits, market surveys, and sales presentations to identify new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with operations and service teams for solution development, proposal preparation, costing, and quotation submissions.
* Develop and maintain existing customer accounts while actively pursuing new customers and service agreements.
* Negotiate commercial and contractual terms with customers and effectively resolve business\-related concerns.
* Prepare service proposals, technical submissions, quotations, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure timely order booking and smooth handover of awarded projects to the operations team.
* Maintain an updated pipeline of opportunities and provide regular sales forecasts, tender status, and activity reports.
* Support collection activities and work closely with customers to ensure timely payments.
* Plan and execute sales and marketing strategies to increase market penetration and customer engagement.


 What We Look For
   

  

**Required**
* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related Engineering discipline.
* Experience in service sales, project sales, or solution sales within Building Automation Systems (BAS), Building Management Systems (BMS), HVAC, ACMV, or related industries.
* Understanding of building services, HVAC systems, BAS/BMS solutions, and service business operations.
* Strong sales, negotiation, presentation, and customer relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Ability to travel frequently based on business requirements.


**Preferred**
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and developing customer accounts.
* Strong network with consultants, building owners, facility managers, and key market influencers.
* Knowledge of the North India building services and service sales market.
* Experience in Labour \& Material service sales for BAS, HVAC, or building technologies.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Achievement of assigned sales revenue targets.
* Achievement of gross margin and profitability objectives.
* Development and growth of strategic customer accounts.
* New customer acquisition and opportunity creation.
* Conversion rate of proposals and quotations.
* Collection performance and receivables management.
* Accuracy of sales forecasting and pipeline management.


**What We Offer**
 We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi\-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**Description**
**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword — it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Job Details**
 You will be responsible for the successful design and technical delivery of complex, enterprise\-level Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions for our customers, working in an AI\-Native delivery environment. These technologies include but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Marketing Cloud studios and builders, Agentforce Marketing, and cross\-cloud integrations — all increasingly accelerated by AI tooling and agentic delivery methods.
   

  

 The solutions you design are built for the long term and scale seamlessly with the customer's growth plans. You have proven experience designing scalable, high\-quality solutions for large enterprise clients, and you're eager to up\-skill on AI Fluency — using AI developer assistants (e.g., Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, Claude) and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate design, coding, and delivery. You should be able to understand client requirements, collaborate across internal and external teams, document solution design, and deliver a quality implementation of the project — faster and smarter with AI\-assisted workflows.
   

  

 You should be able to support customers in designing, developing, coding, and launching complex email campaigns, dynamic content, and landing pages, using AI coding assistants to speed up development where useful. You have experience coding HTML emails and landing pages, using Marketing Cloud's proprietary scripting language (AMPscript) and Server\-Side JavaScript. You should also be able to onboard onto Agentforce Marketing and build Customer Journeys, leveraging AI\-native tools and agentic frameworks to accelerate journey design and personalization.
   

  

 In this role, we're looking for someone with hands\-on experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and other Salesforce clouds, integration, and data management — plus genuine curiosity for AI\-driven ways of working.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead technical discovery sessions and discussions with clients, confidently articulating technical designs, integration strategies, and potential trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, set and manage expectations, and oversee day\-to\-day client interactions and resolve escalations.
* Work with customers to understand key campaign parameters such as subscriber audience, program frequency, degree of personalization, and overall creative approach.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Plum** 




  





 Welcome to Plum, where we take a step towards building the most trusted \& loved insurance \& healthcare provider for people \& companies, one step at a time, one person at a time. We got into this space when the founders, Saurabh \& Abhishek, felt that this industry was a unique combination of a large industry (100k Cr\+ Premiums), growing fast (20%\+ CAGR over past 20 years), where the customer experience was not close to what we could deliver using technology.
 



  





 Over the past 5 years, we have done what no one could expect to \- innovate, raise the customer experience bar while onboarding more than 4000 companies, 700,000 lives, 20 of India’s unicorns while delivering great value to our customers (our NPS is more than double the industry average).
 



  





 We are on a mission to provide the highest quality insurance and healthcare to 10 million lives by FY2030 through companies that care and are backed in our mission by Tiger Global and Peak XV Partners.
 



  





**About the team** 




  





 Plum’s Account Managers operate with 4 core principles:\-
 


1. **We exist to disrupt the insurance industry by raising the bar on customer experience.**


* The insurance world has a lot of ‘hairy problems’ \- over\-complicated systems, too much paperwork, low trust, too much fine print, too many hiding features
* We want to be the company that is a friendly insurance \& health partner not just a service provider, who just takes over, who are super easy to use and super smooth to work with


1. **We will learn from our customers \- We handle more diverse customers than you can imagine and from them our AMs learn and become rock\-stars.** 
 Our customers range from Large Global Capability Centres, Fast Growing Start Ups, niche enterprises like Aerospace\-focused companies, etc.
2. **We are a team which keeps trying to raise the bar in everything \- from quality of work, people growth to a culture of promoting from within**


* All our current team leaders started off as ICs in the past 2\-3 years and are now leading businesses of \> 20 Cr of Premiums’
* We aim to be the first insurance broker in India to manage 10,000 customers and want folks who build systems//processes to achieve this.



  





**About the role** 




  





 Having found product/market fit, we’re in the midst of transitioning from 'start\-up' to ‘scale\-up’. We are looking for builders, hackers and straight\-up hustlers to help us build something memorable. We’re looking for outstanding account managers who have consistently delivered high customer satisfaction, thrive in taking full ownership of delivering delight to customers and folks who are hungry to smash targets. We want people who want a run a mini business of your own
 



  





***Note: This role will be based in Bangalore for the first 6 months for training, after which it will transition to Mumbai as the full\-time base location.***




  





**Responsibilities** 



* You will manage a set of diverse accounts in an end\-to\-end manner, having 100% accountability of all the outcomes of that account \- from escalations to relationship building to retention and revenue.
* To get started, you would develop a good understanding of the product and work with different teams to make internal processes more efficient
* Once you build some credibility, you will also be responsible for cross\-selling and getting customer referrals to build your own book.



**Role Requirements** 



* Ideally 3\-5 years of experience in B2B sales and a customer\-facing role
* Very strong written and verbal communication and high numeric ability
* High customer empathy and extreme ownership
* Strong problem solver, can hustle to unblock customers
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams to resolve issues
* Strong adherence to SLAs and processes

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**What You’ll Gain**
* Deep Cement Industry Experience by working with real cement plants, equipment, operating data, and reliability challenges.
* Customer Management Experience by working closely with Customer Success Managers and enterprise customers.
* Applied AI Experience by seeing how AI models detect anomalies, generate alerts, and identify potential equipment issues.

* Value \& Impact Thinking by learning how technical insights translate into measurable improvements in reliability, downtime, and plant performance.

title: Manager, Customer Success Scaled Accounts
description:
**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a Manager, Customer Success, Scaled Accounts in India with atleast 10 years of exp to lead a high\-performing team supporting a scaled portfolio of smaller customers through a lighter\-touch, high\-volume Customer Success motion. This role is designed to bridge the gap between digital\-only coverage and strategic named coverage, with a focus on protecting ARR, improving customer outcomes, and delivering strong in\-timezone support across APAC and Middle East customers.
   

  

 Unlike a traditional Customer Success leadership role focused on a smaller number of large, strategic accounts, this manager will lead a more programmatic, high\-scale model. The focus is on retention, renewal readiness, operational excellence, portfolio health, team productivity, and coordinated customer support rather than deep executive sponsorship of a limited number of complex enterprise relationships.
   

  

 This is a strong fit for a leader who combines Customer Success judgment with operating discipline, coaching capability, technical fluency, and the ability to build a repeatable scaled motion that delivers strong customer outcomes at efficient cost.
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 This role is being created to address a clear coverage gap in International Customer Success. OneTrust has identified a meaningful population of customers below the strategic named\-CS threshold who still need guided support, especially in the 50–100K ARR band, where a scaled human\-touch motion can improve retention and customer outcomes without the cost of full strategic coverage.
   

  

 The role also supports the key outcomes identified in the India team strategy: higher retention, better APAC and Growth coverage, greater resilience during attrition or handoffs, and sharper focus for strategic CSMs on their highest\-complexity accounts.
   

  

**Your Mission**
* Build and lead a scaled Customer Success team in India that delivers consistent, high\-quality coverage for smaller accounts through a lighter\-touch, repeatable engagement model.
* Improve retention and renewal readiness across the assigned book of business by ensuring strong execution, early risk identification, and disciplined customer follow\-through.
* Create a lower\-cost, high\-impact coverage layer that strengthens support for APAC and Middle East customers while allowing strategic CSMs to stay focused on larger, more complex accounts.
* Establish the operating rhythms, team standards, portfolio segmentation, and success measures needed to run scaled Customer Success effectively.
* Act as a continuity and performance leader who can stabilize coverage during transitions, support cross\-functional execution, and scale what works.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership and Coaching**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of scaled CSMs supporting a larger\-volume portfolio of smaller customers.
* Set clear performance expectations around retention, renewal readiness, customer engagement quality, operational hygiene, and portfolio management.
* Provide regular coaching on customer communication, prioritization, risk management, product guidance, and account execution.
* Support hiring, onboarding, ramping, and career development for the India\-based scaled CS team.


**Scaled Motion Design and Execution**
* Build and run a structured, repeatable Customer Success motion for smaller accounts, including engagement cadences, success planning lite, adoption check\-ins, renewal\-readiness touchpoints, and proactive risk reviews.
* Define how the team segments accounts, prioritizes effort, and balances breadth of coverage with quality of execution.
* Ensure the team delivers value in a scalable way rather than replicating a strategic named\-account model.
* Continuously refine playbooks, workflows, and intervention triggers to improve efficiency and outcomes.


**Retention and Renewal Performance**
* Own renewal performance and retained ARR outcomes across the scaled team’s portfolio in partnership with Sales, Renewals, ECS, and Support.
* Ensure the team identifies churn risk early, drives mitigation plans, and improves readiness ahead of renewal events.
* Track portfolio health trends and turn signals into clear actions, escalation paths, and performance improvements.
* Use data to focus the team on the accounts and motions that create the greatest retention impact.


**Customer Experience And Regional Coverage**
* Improve in\-timezone responsiveness and customer experience for APAC, Middle East, and other assigned regions.
* Ensure smaller customers receive the right level of guidance, follow\-up, and product support without unnecessary complexity.
* Build a team culture that combines customer empathy with efficiency, clarity, and accountability.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Partner closely with Support, Product, Professional Services, CSAs, Sales, Renewals, and regional CS leaders to improve customer outcomes and reduce execution friction.
* Create strong handoff and escalation processes between scaled coverage and strategic coverage.
* Surface recurring product, process, and customer experience themes that should inform broader Customer Success strategy.
* Act as a key stakeholder in designing how scaled Customer Success complements digital and named models.


**Operational Management and Capacity Planning**
* Manage team capacity, portfolio allocation, coverage continuity, and productivity across a high\-volume book of business.
* Maintain strong CRM and Gainsight hygiene, reporting discipline, and inspection rhythms.
* Help create resilience in the operating model during attrition, parental leaves, backfills, or organizational transitions.
* Report on business performance with clear metrics and recommendations for leadership.


**Success Measures**
 Success in this role will be measured through a combination of business impact, team performance, and operational execution, including:
   

  

* Renewal rate and retained ARR across the scaled portfolio.
* Improvement in renewal\-readiness execution and risk mitigation quality.
* Team productivity across a higher\-volume book of business.
* Response time, backlog management, and follow\-through for APAC and Middle East customers.
* Strength of CRM and Gainsight hygiene, signal capture, and portfolio inspection.
* Quality of hiring, onboarding, coaching, and team development.
* Ability to create a scalable, repeatable Customer Success motion that improves outcomes without the cost of a full strategic coverage model.


**Experience And Skills Required**
* Proven experience leading Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, Professional Services, Solutions Consulting, or another customer\-facing SaaS team.
* Prior people\-management experience, including coaching, performance management, and team development.
* Strong understanding of scaled or commercial Customer Success models, including how to run high\-volume portfolios effectively.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complexity, align stakeholders, and lead through clarity.
* Good technical fluency and the ability to guide teams supporting product adoption, customer questions, and use\-case problem solving.
* Strong operational discipline, analytical thinking, prioritization, and execution rigor.
* Customer\-first mindset, sound judgment, and comfort working cross\-functionally in a fast\-moving environment.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on operating leadership.


**Preferred Background**
* Experience with OneTrust products or with comparable privacy, GRC, data governance, consent, or compliance platforms.
* Experience leading SMB, mid\-market, commercial, or scaled Customer Success teams rather than only strategic enterprise coverage.
* Experience supporting customers across APAC, Middle East, or other international markets.
* Experience building or improving playbooks, operating cadences, and portfolio\-management frameworks for scaled teams.
* Comfort operating in a lighter\-touch CS motion that is structured, repeatable, and commercially disciplined.


**What Makes This Role Different**
 This is not a traditional strategic Customer Success leadership role. It is a scaled\-team management role for a leader who can build a broader\-coverage model, run a higher\-volume operating motion, and deliver strong retention and customer outcomes through disciplined, programmatic execution.
   

  

 The role is designed to extend quality human coverage to customers who matter commercially but do not require the depth of a strategic $100K\+ named\-CSM model. Success will come from building a repeatable team motion that protects ARR, improves responsiveness, and strengthens the overall International Customer Success model.
   

  

 Where we Work
   

  

 We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
   

  

 Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
   

  

 Resources
   

  

 Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
   

  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram


 Your Data
   

  

 You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
 **.** 
 You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
   

  

 Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
   

  

**Our Commitment to You**
 When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

**The Company**
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.

title: Forward Deployed Client Partner
description:
**Forward Deployed Client Partner** 




**Fibr AI \| Bengaluru (On\-site) \| Full\-time Experience: 1\-3 years** 




  





 You've spent your first couple of years in Customer Success learning how to keep a client happy. You've run calls, chased tickets, kept the dashboard green. But you've also noticed that most of the real decisions get made above you, and your job is mostly to execute a system someone else built.
 



 This is the role where you stop executing someone else's system and start learning how to build one.
 



  





**WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT** 




  





 Most junior CSM roles at bigger SaaS companies put you in a narrow lane: one part of the client journey, a script to follow, a senior person who owns the actual relationship. Here, you own the relationship from week one. You run the onboarding, you sit on the client calls, you make the judgment calls on what needs to be escalated and what you can solve yourself. You will have people to learn from, but the account is yours to run.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 



1. **Own the onboarding journey** 
 Run kickoff calls, gather requirements, and get new clients live fast. You will lead the technical onboarding conversations directly with client teams, not sit in on someone else's call.
2. **Be the client's first point of contact** 
 Handle the day\-to\-day relationship: the weekly check\-ins, the status updates, the moments where a client needs to hear from a real person, not a ticket number. You decide what gets communicated and when.
3. **Learn to diagnose, not just relay** 
 Get comfortable digging into a script issue, a tracking problem, or a campaign question yourself before looping in tech. You will build real technical fluency here, not just people skills.
4. **Build judgment fast** 
 You will decide what is urgent, what can wait, and what needs to be flagged up. Nobody hands you a rulebook for this. You build the instinct by doing it.
5. **Shape how this function grows** 
 We are building our Customer Success playbook now, and your experience in your first few months will directly shape how the next person after you gets onboarded and trained.



**WHO THIS IS FOR** 



1. 1 to 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Onboarding, Account Management, or a similarly client\-facing role, ideally in B2B SaaS, martech, or a fast\-moving tech environment.
2. You are not afraid of the technical side. Tracking scripts, integrations, campaign data, you want to understand how things actually work, not just report on them.
3. You communicate clearly and proactively. If something is going to be late, the client hears it from you before they have to ask.
4. You want more ownership than your current role gives you, and you are ready to earn it fast.



  





**HOW WE WORK** 




 You will work closely with a small, experienced team and have real access to how decisions get made here. There is no ladder of approvals between you and getting something done for a client.
 



  





**WHY FIBR AI** 




 Fibr AI is building the agentic web layer, infrastructure that turns static websites into intelligent, personalized experiences. We work with major enterprise clients across fintech, insurance, healthcare, and consumer brands. Backed by Accel, early team, meaningful growth ahead, and a real chance to grow fast alongside the company.

title: Mgr, NGS Programs
description:
**Job Summary**
 Lead a global support program that serves as the first line of support for data issues, deals, bookings, the Quote\-to\-Order (Q2O) process and the FPVR process. The role provides responsive support for global accounts and Renewal Specialists, using data, analytics and reporting to resolve operational issues and enable consistent execution across Renewals and Customer Success. A critical accountability is to identify problem areas and improvement opportunities, then translate analysis into clear insights on business value, expected benefits and return on investment (ROI) to guide prioritization and decision\-making. 
   

  

 Job Resposibilities
   

  

**First\-Line Business Support** 
 : Provide responsive first\-line support for data issues, deals and bookings. Assess requests, clarify business impact, coordinate resolution and maintain clear communication through closure.
   

  

**Q2O \& FPVR Process Support** 
 : Support Quote\-to\-Order and FPVR processes by resolving operational questions, identifying breakdowns, coordinating corrective action and improving support consistency.
   

  

**Global Accounts Support** 
 : Provide dependable support for global and strategic accounts, recognizing cross\-region dependencies, urgency and revenue impact while coordinating stakeholders toward timely resolution.
   

  

**Renewal Specialist Enablement** 
 : Enable Renewal Specialists with accurate data, actionable reporting, process guidance and structured issue support that improves productivity and customer outcomes.
   

  

**Data, Analytics \& Reporting** 
 : Use data analysis and reporting to identify trends, recurring issues, problem areas and improvement opportunities. Quantify business value, expected benefits and ROI to support prioritization and informed decisions.
   

  

**Issue Triage \& Resolution** 
 : Establish effective intake, prioritization, ownership and escalation practices. Track issues to closure, identify root causes and reduce repeat incidents.
   

  

**Process Efficiency :** 
 Identify opportunities to simplify support processes, remove handoffs and redundancies, reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time, quality and stakeholder experience.
   

  

**Program Governance \& Leadership** 
 : Manage support priorities, service measures, risks and stakeholder communication across regions. Build alignment and accountability for consistent program delivery.
   

  

**Business Value \& ROI Insights** 
 : Identify high\-impact problem areas and improvement opportunities. Develop fact\-based benefit cases, quantify expected business value and ROI, and provide recommendations that guide investment and prioritization decisions.
   

  

 Job Qualification
   

  

**Support Program Management :** 
 Experience leading global support programs, service priorities and cross\-functional execution against measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Data Issue Management :** 
 Strong ability to diagnose data issues, assess business impact, coordinate ownership and drive timely resolution.
   

  

**Deals, Bookings \& Process Knowledge** 
 :Working knowledge of deals, bookings, Q2O, FPVR and renewals processes, including their operational and revenue dependencies.
   

  

**Global Stakeholder Leadership :** 
 Ability to support global accounts, align regional and functional stakeholders and influence outcomes without direct authority.
   

  

**Data, Analytics \& Reporting** 
 : Strong analytical and reporting capability, including identifying improvement opportunities and translating operational data into actionable business\-value and ROI insights.
   

  

**Process Improvement :** 
 Demonstrated success simplifying workflows, reducing manual effort and improving service efficiency, quality and consistency.
   

  

**Communication \& Execution :** 
 Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, urgency and disciplined follow\-through in a support environment.
   

  

**Business Value \& ROI Analysis** 
 : Demonstrated ability to assess improvement opportunities, establish value drivers and assumptions, quantify benefits and ROI, and communicate decision\-ready recommendations to leadership.

title: Franchise Area Manager
description:
**Job Description – Franchise Area Manager** 




**Position** 




**Franchise Area Manager** 




**Department** 





 Franchise Operations
 




**Reporting To** 





 Senior Operations Manager / Head – Franchise Operations
 




**Role Overview** 





 The Franchise Area Manager will be responsible for managing and driving the overall performance of franchise outlets within the assigned area. The role involves franchise partner management, operational excellence, sales growth, new store openings, compliance, issue resolution, and coordination with internal teams such as Finance, SCM, Marketing, Training, and Business Development.
 





 The candidate will act as the primary point of contact between the brand and franchise partners and will ensure that all outlets operate in line with brand standards and business objectives.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Franchise Partner Management** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with franchise partners.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational and business\-related concerns.
* Understand partner concerns and provide timely solutions.
* Conduct regular partner reviews and performance discussions.
* Ensure effective communication of brand policies, initiatives, campaigns, and operational updates.
* Drive partner engagement and improve overall partner satisfaction.



**2\. Store Operations \& Performance** 



* Monitor day\-to\-day operations of assigned franchise outlets.
* Track outlet sales, profitability, customer experience, operational compliance, and service standards.
* Identify performance gaps and prepare corrective action plans.
* Conduct regular store visits and audits.
* Ensure adherence to SOPs, food quality, hygiene, service, and brand standards.
* Follow up on operational issues until closure.



**3\. Sales \& Business Growth** 



* Drive sales growth across the assigned franchise network.
* Analyse outlet\-wise sales trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Track key business metrics such as sales, AOV, order volumes, discounts, online visibility, and customer ratings.
* Work with partners to improve outlet profitability.
* Identify underperforming outlets and implement action plans.
* Monitor aggregator performance across platforms such as Swiggy and Zomato.



**4\. New Store Opening / NSO** 



* Coordinate end\-to\-end new store opening activities for assigned outlets.
* Work closely with BD, Projects, SCM, Marketing, Training, Finance, and franchise partners.
* Ensure outlet readiness before launch.
* Track equipment, inventory, branding, licenses, training, aggregator onboarding, and other launch requirements.
* Ensure smooth transition from pre\-opening to post\-opening operations.
* Monitor the performance of newly opened outlets during the initial period.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Coordinate with
 
**Finance** 

 for royalty, outstanding payments, credit notes, settlements, and other partner\-related financial matters.
* Coordinate with
 
**SCM** 

 for stock availability, supply issues, transportation, and procurement concerns.
* Coordinate with
 
**Marketing** 

 for campaigns, creatives, promotions, local marketing, and NSO activities.
* Coordinate with
 
**Training** 

 to ensure franchise staff receive required product and operational training.
* Coordinate with
 
**Tech/IT** 

 for Rista, POS, aggregator, and other system\-related issues.
* Work with the
 
**Legal team** 

 for agreements, amendments, notices, and franchise\-related documentation.



**6\. Compliance \& Brand Standards** 



* Ensure franchise partners comply with all brand, statutory, and operational requirements.
* Monitor FSSAI, licenses, agreements, certificates, and other mandatory documentation.
* Conduct periodic audits and ensure closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, quality, and brand standards.



**7\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation Management** 



* Take ownership of franchise partner escalations.
* Analyse root causes and provide practical solutions.
* Ensure issues are tracked and closed within agreed timelines.
* Escalate critical matters to senior management with clear facts, impact, and recommended action.
* Maintain an issue tracker and ensure there are no repeated unresolved concerns.



**8\. Reporting \& MIS** 



* Maintain regular outlet and franchise partner trackers.
* Prepare weekly/monthly performance reports.
* Track sales, collections, NSO, outlet performance, audits, complaints, and action points.
* Share business insights and improvement plans with management.
* Maintain accurate records of partner discussions and commitments.



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Outlet Sales Growth
* Same Store Sales Growth
* Franchisee Profitability
* Franchise Partner Satisfaction
* New Store Opening Timelines
* New Store Ramp\-up Performance

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Technical Success Manager
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.

description:
**About BiteSpeed**
 Hey there! We are a
 **Sequoia\-backed SaaS startup** 
 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.**
 We’re currently working with
 **3000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
   

  

 💡
 **Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!**
**Check out more about us here** 
 \- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200\+ odd 5\-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).
   

  

**We’ve had some solid investors back us** 
 (making it easier for you to stalk us since you’d do this anyway) \-
   

  

 Ecommerce AI startup BiteSpeed raised USD 3\.5 million
   

  

 E\-commerce AI start\-up BiteSpeed raises $3\.5 million funding led by Peak XV’s Surge
   

  

 BiteSpeed Raises $1\.9 Million Seed Funding From Sequoia India's Surge
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an
 **Enterprise** 
**Account Manager** 
 to own the
 **entire customer lifecycle** 
 at BiteSpeed — from onboarding and implementation to retention, renewals, cross\-sell, upsell, and account expansion.
   

  

 This isn't a traditional customer success role focused only on support and relationship management. We're looking for someone who can
 **build strong customer relationships while also identifying growth opportunities and driving revenue from existing accounts.**
 You'll work closely with customers to help them achieve their goals, maximize the value they derive from BiteSpeed, and uncover opportunities to expand their partnership with us.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the end\-to\-end customer journey — onboarding, implementation, adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships and become a trusted advisor for your customers.
* Lead customer onboarding and ensure a smooth implementation experience with faster time\-to\-value.
* Drive product adoption and customer engagement by helping customers unlock the full potential of BiteSpeed.
* Own renewals and retention, ensuring customers continue to achieve measurable business outcomes.
* Proactively identify and drive cross\-sell, upsell, and expansion opportunities across your portfolio.
* Work closely with customers to understand their business goals, growth plans, and evolving requirements to uncover additional revenue opportunities.
* Monitor account health, product usage, and engagement metrics to identify both risk signals and growth opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal teams across product, sales, support, and growth to deliver a seamless customer experience.


**What Makes You a Good Fit**
* You have 2\-5 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a similar customer\-facing role.
* You have hands\-on experience managing the complete customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion.
* You have a strong commercial mindset and are comfortable driving cross\-sell, upsell, and revenue growth within existing accounts.
* You enjoy consultative conversations and can confidently discuss ROI, business outcomes, and growth opportunities with customers.
* You can balance customer advocacy with business goals, creating win\-win outcomes for both.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced environment and can manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously.
* You genuinely enjoy helping customers succeed and take ownership of building long\-term partnerships.


 Salary and Location
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team.
   

  

**Our Way Of Life**
 Over time we’ve realised that while we’re super excited about shaping the future of commerce, a big part of why people join us and stick with us is because they resonate with our way of life. You could call it work culture \- but it ends up becoming more than just that.
   

  

 It’s taken us time to discover and articulate what our culture feels like, this evolving document is an attempt to candidly share what it’s like working at BiteSpeed.
   

  

**Our Purpose**
 At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create. Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:\-
   

  

* Personal Transformation


 We like to think of BiteSpeed as being a gym for our careers. It’s where we come to do great work we can be proud of and push ourselves in the pursuit of excellence. Is it comfortable? No. Is it painful? Sometimes. Is it fulfilling? Yes.
   

  

 We were never the company that was supposed to win \- We started out of a dorm room, solo founder, early engineers who hadn’t written code in their lives setting out to build a global SaaS company.
   

  

 Our roots are in doing things we are unqualified for and we bet on people who want that journey for themselves. There are stories of people across the company from a 20 year old who’s never done sales closing enterprise deals to a college intern owning an enterprise product lifecycle \- these are the stories we are proud of. If someone can look back after 2 years of working at BiteSpeed and say they don’t identify with who they were, we’d call it a success and we want to help them get there.
   

  

* Wealth Creation


 Somehow most companies are shy about wanting to make money. It’s looked at as this thing which everyone does but no one really talks about.
   

  

 We’re not ashamed of doing it for the money. Wealth unlocks choice. If life is an amusement park, we think there is value to getting an unlimited rides pass. It's purposeful for us to try to create wealth that allows people to achieve their life's dreams \- whether that's owning a house or booking a dream vacation for their parents. We do this by ensuring everyone in the team gets equity and there are generous cash \& equity bumps on a frequent basis to reward performance and alignment in values.
   

  

* Winning Together


 We’re not here for a participation certificate. We’re playing to win. The keyword here is ‘together’. Winning ‘together’ is about recognising it’s a team sport. We don't care about man of the match awards, either we win the trophy or we don’t. There is a certain camaraderie that comes with winning together that’s hard to explain, but it’s deeply fulfilling and energising. The question we ask ourselves is \- can we play the game like it’s never been played before?
   

  

 Our Values
   

  

 Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.
   

  

 We have 5 core values:\-
   

  

* Go Above And Beyond


 We value people who care about doing a good job. Going above and beyond is about doing more than the bare minimum that gets the job done and raising the bar each time we have the opportunity to do so
   

  

* Making Things Happen


 Each company has an operating rhythm and this is that for us. Making things happen is the opposite of being passive. It’s about high agency, about always believing there is a way to get what we want and either finding the way or making the way
   

  

* Say It Like It Is


 We are candid and direct when it comes to sharing feedback, transparent with our numbers and intellectually honest about the realities of any business situation
   

  

* Progress Over Perfection


 We’re not building rockets. We care about moving fast and iterating towards perfection. We like to take a minimum viable approach to prioritisation and problem solving and actively look for 80/20 solutions
   

  

* Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously


 Great things are built when people can contribute to pursuits beyond themselves. Being low ego, not needing praise to do a good job, taking feedback with humility, being self\-critical all add up to this
   

  

 Perks \& Benefits

* Personal Development \- We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.
* Salary In Advance \- Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.
