description:
DialNexa is a next generation CPaaS and AI Voice platform. Businesses use us to automate the conversations that actually move revenue: sales calls, support, collections, follow ups and other high volume voice workflows. AI voice agents, telephony, automation, analytics and integrations, in one stack.
 



  





 We are hiring a Customer Success Manager who can sit across from a CXO in the morning and debug a webhook payload with an engineer in the afternoon.
 



  





**WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS** 




 You own a portfolio of B2B and enterprise accounts end to end:
 



 Contract \> Discovery \> Technical Onboarding \> Configuration \> Testing \> Go Live \> Adoption \> Optimisation \> Renewal
 



  





 This is not a check in and report CSM role. You will be inside call recordings and transcripts, spotting where an AI agent loses the customer, then working with the client and our AI team to fix the prompt and the conversation flow.
 



  





**THE DETAILS** 




 Location: Bengaluru, work from office with flexibility
 



 Experience: 3 plus years
 



 Compensation: up to 12 LPA
 



 Reporting to: Director, Customer Success
 



 Device: Bring your own laptop (mandatory)
 



  





  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




 Account management
 



 • A portfolio of enterprise and B2B customers, as their primary point of contact
 



 • Relationships across business, operations, technology and decision making stakeholders
 



 • Account specific Customer Success Plans, regular account reviews and QBRs
 



  





 Onboarding and go live
 



 • Requirements, implementation coordination, onboarding milestones, risks and blockers
 



 • Fast Time to Value, with close monitoring of the first 30 to 90 days
 



  





 AI voice agent performance
 



 • Analyse call recordings and transcripts, find gaps in conversation flows and agent responses
 



 • Improve connection rate, answer rate, completion rate, conversion rate, transfer rate, AI resolution rate, call duration, response latency, drop rate and cost per conversation
 



 • Partner with Product and AI teams on recurring performance issues
 



  





 Adoption, consumption and growth
 



 • Track usage, minutes, credits, campaigns and feature adoption
 



 • Spot stagnant or declining consumption early and build recovery plans
 



 • Surface new use cases and partner with Sales on upsell and cross sell
 



  





 Retention and churn
 



 • Own customer health scores and churn indicators
 



 • Own escalations through to resolution and customer acceptance
 



 • Renewal readiness well ahead of contract expiry
 



  





 Voice of the customer
 



 • Translate business requirements into clear product and technical requirements
 



 • Work with Product and Engineering on bugs, API issues, integrations, voice quality, latency and AI agent behaviour
 



  





**WHAT YOU NEED** 




 • 3 plus years in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Success or Technical Account Management
 



 • Experience in B2B SaaS, CPaaS, CCaaS, Cloud Communications, Voice AI or Conversational AI
 



 • Track record managing multiple enterprise accounts through onboarding, adoption, retention and renewals
 



 • Comfort with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, API authentication, CRM and ticketing integrations
 



 • Working understanding of telephony and VoIP, DID provisioning, IVR, call routing and call flows
 



 • Familiarity with voice AI agents, LLM fundamentals, prompt engineering basics, STT, TTS and call analytics
 



 • Strong analytical, communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills
 



  





 You do not need to be a developer. You do need to be technical enough to diagnose whether an issue sits in customer configuration, the API, an integration, telephony, the AI agent, the workflow or the platform, before it reaches an engineer.
 



  





**STRONGLY PREFERRED** 




 CPaaS platforms, Voice AI, Conversational AI, CCaaS or contact centre, cloud telephony, CRM integrations, IVR or voicebot platforms, LLM based applications.
 



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 90 DAYS** 




  





 • Independently running your accounts, with a clear read on each customer's business objectives
 



 • Structured onboarding and clean go lives
 



 • Confident first level technical discussions
 



 • Measurable movement on retention, adoption, consumption, NPS and CSAT, and expansion
 



  





**HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED** 




  





 Renewal and gross retention \| NPS and CSAT \| Feature and use case adoption \| Minutes, credits and transactions \| Upsell and cross sell \| Time to go live and time to value \| Healthy vs at risk accounts \| Escalation closure \| AI conversion, resolution and completion rates
 



  





  





**WHY DIALNEXA** 




 Don't just build a career. Build what's next.
 



  





 We are shaping how businesses talk to their customers, through AI, intelligent voice, SaaS and next generation CPaaS. We believe in ownership over hierarchy, innovation over convention, and growth through opportunity. You will work with ambitious people, take on real problems, and have the freedom to experiment and make a visible difference.

 **Manager – Technical Support**

* Lead, coach, and develop Technical Support and Integration Engineers.

* Recruit, onboard, and retain top talent.

* Own key support metrics including SLA Compliance, First Response Time, Resolution Time, Queue Health, Backlog, CSAT, Escalations, and Engineer Productivity.

* Drive automation, process improvements, and operational best practices.
* Develop and maintain support playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.



  





**Technical Leadership** 




  




* Build deep expertise across Bureau's products, APIs, SDKs, and integrations.
* Guide engineers in troubleshooting complex application, integration, API, SDk, database, and platform issues.
* Ensure complete diagnostics and quality root cause analysis before Engineering engagement.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to improve platform/ product stability and customer experience.



  





**What you'll bring** 




  





**Customer Support Leadership** 




  




* Proven experience leading enterprise Technical Support teams.
* Strong expertise in customer lifecycle management, incident handling, and executive escalations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and customer relationship skills.



  





**Support Operations** 




  




* Experience managing L2/L3 support organizations with expertise in:
* Ticket Queue Management
* Workforce Planning \& Scheduling
* SLA \& Incident Management
* Escalation Management
* Backlog Reduction
* Operational Reporting



 Experience supporting global customers across multiple time zones is preferred.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




  




* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS platforms with experience in:
* SQL
* REST APIs
* Web \& Mobile SDKs
* Third\-party Integrations
* Application Logs \& Databases
* Monitoring and Log tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Superset, and AWS
* Networking, Scripting, and Programming
* Exposure to AI/ML\-powered support tools and automation



  





**Leadership** 




  




* Proven experience managing high\-performing technical teams.
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in Technical Support or Product Support, including leadership experience.
* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS products and globally distributed teams.
* Experience in FinTech, Banking, Identity Verification, or Digital Fraud Prevention is a plus.



  





**Our Culture** 




  




* We hire self\-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most



  





**Compensation** 




  




* Competitive salary \+ potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

title: Manager - Customer Success
description:
We're Hiring — Manager, Retailing Platform @ factori.com (2 positions)
   


**If you can hold a room of 200 small\-business owners on a webinar and leave them with something they'll actually use to grow — we want to talk to you.** 




**Company:** 
 Sushine Exports Private Limited (factori.com)
 



**Location:** 
 Headquarters at Bannerughatta, Bengaluru (on\-site, full\-time)
 



**Reports to:** 
 Founder \& CEO
 



**Openings:** 
 2
 



**Experience:** 
 4–8 years across digital marketing, e\-commerce, or business consulting/training.
 **Compensation:** 
 Up to ₹8 LPA, based on qualifications, experience, and current CTC.
 



  




 About factori.com
 
 Welcome to
 **factori.com — The Factory for the World.** 




 factori.com is a global manufacturing and commerce platform that connects
 **500\+ partner manufacturers across India** 
 with business buyers, brands, institutions, and entrepreneurs worldwide. Our vision is to onboard
 **100,000\+ manufacturers globally by 2030\.** 




 One of our three core offerings is
 **retailing.factori.com** 
 — a plug\-and\-play platform that lets any entrepreneur launch their own e\-commerce store in 30 minutes, on their own domain, with instant access to thousands of ready\-to\-ship products. Thousands of retailers are already live on it — and our goal is to make every one of them successful.
 



  




 About the role
 
 Thousands of entrepreneurs — homemakers, students, first\-time founders, side\-hustlers — have launched their own online stores on retailing.factori.com. What most of them need next isn't more features. It's someone who teaches them how to sell.
 



 That's this role. You'll be the growth teacher and business consultant for our active retailer community — running high\-quality webinars week after week, and helping retailers turn their stores into real, growing businesses. Your success is measured in one place:
 **the sales growth of the retailers you coach.** 




  




 What you'll own1\. Webinars — your main stage
 * Design and run a regular calendar of webinars for active retailers on: digital marketing, social media marketing, performance marketing, community marketing, and running an e\-commerce business.
* Make them practical — every session ends with steps a retailer can execute on their store the same day.


 2\. Business consulting for retailers
 * Go beyond broadcast: consult with retailers on their specific store, category, pricing, and promotion challenges.
* Diagnose why a store isn't selling and prescribe the fix — traffic, catalogue, pricing, promotion, or persistence.


 3\. Driving retailer sales
 * Own the number that matters: more orders per active retailer, month on month.
* Track which retailers attend, what they implement, and what moved — double down on what works.


 4\. Content that compounds
 * Turn your best sessions into repeatable playbooks, guides, and recorded content the whole retailer base can use.



  




 What we're looking forMust\-have
 * **Hands\-on digital marketing depth** 
 — you've actually run social media, performance, or e\-commerce campaigns, not just talked about them.
* **A natural teacher and presenter** 
 — you can hold an audience on a live webinar, explain marketing to a first\-time entrepreneur in plain language, and enjoy doing it.
* **Business consulting instinct** 
 — you can look at a small online store and quickly see what's blocking its sales.
* **Comfort with scale and repetition** 
 — multiple sessions a week, every week, at a consistently high standard.
* Fluent English; Hindi and/or Kannada a strong advantage for our retailer base.


 Nice\-to\-have
 * Experience training, coaching, or consulting for SMEs, D2C brands, or seller communities (e.g., marketplace seller\-education teams, agency training roles, ed\-tech instruction).
* Your own content presence — a channel, page, or community you've grown.
* Familiarity with e\-commerce storefront tools, SEO basics, and WhatsApp\-led selling.


 What you get
 * **Up to ₹8 LPA** 
 CTC, basis qualifications, experience and current CTC.
* **Reports directly to the Founder \& CEO** 
 — this is a flagship initiative, not a side project.
* A live audience of thousands of retailers from day one — your teaching shows up in real businesses growing.
* Full ownership of the webinar and retailer\-education engine at a fast\-scaling platform.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 CrowdStrike is seeking a Corporate Account Manager to ensure that our regional customers are successful and thriving with our next generation endpoint technology. This is a full sales cycle role in which you will proactively advocate for the customers in corporate segment, while focusing on high levels of adoption to ensure customer satisfaction. You will balance discovering upsell and cross\-sell opportunities while partnering with our renewals team to ensure timely renewals.
   

  

*This position is open to candidates that are located remotely in Hyderabad.*
****What You’ll Do:****
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients while collaborating with various internal stakeholders (Customer Success, Managed Services, etc.) to ensure the existing customer base in AP \& Telangana is receiving the value they expect from their previous purchase
* Manage the contract renewal cycle from scheduling initial meetings through negotiation, contract changes, and signature while ensuring customers renew at an escalated ARR rate.
* Achieve a quota of new sales growth within the customer base in AP \& Telangana.
* Be a customer advocate, driving relationships with key customers and creating new champions.
* Identify whitespace in accounts and create value\-based presentations to promote upgrades and cross\-sells.
* Consult with our existing customers to recommend additional solutions from the CrowdStrike portfolio to increase ingestion.
* Devise and execute account strategies and plans to maximize account growth.
* Provide high touch customer service, including escalation and coordination of support issues as needed.
* Deliver feedback to the Product Management team on new feature requests and product enhancements from your customer base.


****What You’ll Need:****
* Experience of full sales cycle experience in account management or net new logo capacity, selling to a technical audience such as engineers, IT, security, and other related fields.
* Strong ability to run a discovery, manage full sales cycle, handle objections, implement a multi\-faceted sales strategy such as working with partners, and close deals.
* Light experience and/or understanding of sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Sandler
* Track record of meeting or exceeding expectations in an individually focused, quota and/or metric carrying role.
* Ability to successfully balance a wide variety of daily tasks and adjust priorities on the fly in a fast\-paced environment over multiple engagements.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn new concepts quickly.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills demonstrated through email, conference calls, client visits and presentations, and internal meetings
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
* High level of comfort handling client objections and negotiations.


****Bonus Points:****
* Cyber Security industry experience
* Security and/or SaaS Sales experience
* Advanced experience and/or understanding of sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Sandler

* Support revenue forecasting and retention reporting in partnership with Sales Ops and Finance
* Cross‑Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with Account Managers on customer communication, pricing, and contract alignment
* Escalate renewal risks, exceptions, or delays to leadership as needed
* Subscription \& Licensing Management
* Manage renewals across:
+ CSP subscriptions
+ HSO IP subscriptions
+ ISV licenses
+ On‑premise products (e.g., GP, Business Central)

* Maintain clean data to support forecasting, reporting, and compliance

* Coordinate with Finance to ensure timely and accurate customer invoicing

* Confirm required documentation is stored in approved systems (e.g., SharePoint)
* Support audit readiness and contractual compliance
* Stakeholder \& Customer Support
* Act as a trusted operational point of contact for renewal questions
* Support Sales with licensing complexity, quoting questions, and renewal structuring
* Coordinate customer communications related to renewal timing and execution
* Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
* Support renewal performance reporting (volume, value, timing, exceptions)
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, or automation opportunities
* Contribute to documentation, SOPs, and scalability improvements

title: Senior Analyst, Business Operations
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Associate, Customer Success Partner to support day\-to\-day merchant operations and deliver outstanding customer experience. The ideal candidate will assist in resolving merchant queries, ensuring smooth transaction flows, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams for timely issue resolution. A basic understanding of payment methods and reconciliation processes will be an added advantage. This role is a great opportunity for someone who is eager to learn and grow in the fintech/customer success space.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Ownership of Merchant Issues:
+ Handle complex or high\-value merchant concerns, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolution with minimal follow\-ups.

* Escalation Management:
+ Take ownership of L2/L3 escalations, coordinate with cross\-functional teams (Product, Risk, Tech, FinOps), and ensure root cause identification and resolution.

* Workflow Optimization \& SOP Design:
+ Identify gaps in current processes and contribute to the creation or improvement of SOPs to enhance resolution efficiency and merchant experience.

* Merchant Communication \& Stakeholder Alignment:
+ Maintain clear and professional communication with merchants and internal stakeholders to keep all parties informed on resolution progress.

* Operational Reporting \& Metrics Tracking:
+ Track SLAs, TATs, and resolution quality metrics; generate reports for leadership to monitor performance and identify bottlenecks.

* Mentorship \& Peer Support:
+ Guide and mentor junior associates, conduct case reviews, and ensure adherence to quality and tone standards.

* Special Projects \& Initiatives:
+ Lead or contribute to strategic projects such as refund pattern analysis, feature enablement audits, or new payment flow adoption.

* Product Feedback Loop:
+ Identify and relay recurring merchant feedback or product issues to the product/tech teams for prioritization.

* Audit Readiness \& Compliance:
+ Ensure all customer interactions, tickets, and resolutions are properly documented to support internal or regulatory audits.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Education : Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, or a related field.
* Experience : Minimum 2–3 years of experience in customer service, operations, or a similar domain.
* Knowledge of Payment Ecosystem : Familiarity with UPI, Net Banking, Card Payments, eNACH, settlement processes, and refund mechanisms.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

title: Manager , Professional Services
description:
**Role** 




 We are looking for a Manager, Professional Services to join our Professional Services team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Director, Professional Services. You will lead a team of senior consultants, architects, and project managers deploying Zscaler solutions for strategic and large\-scale customers. You are a leader who connects with internal and external executives with ease, driving progress and solving complex issues with a direct, partnership\-oriented approach.
 



  





**What you’ll do (Role Expectations)** 



* Lead the hiring, onboarding, skills development, and performance management of a high\-performing technical team
* Drive collaboration across Sales, Support, and Product Management teams to ensure successful deployments and stakeholder interlocks
* Navigate and resolve complex project issues and escalations while maintaining consistent communication with executive stakeholders
* Manage all project resourcing, budgets, timelines, and deliverables while achieving operational excellence through Professional Services KPIs
* Partner with global leadership on long\-term strategic planning and organizational decision\-making to scale the practice



  





**Who You Are (Success Profile)** 



* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution.

title: Category Lead, Sports
description:
**Who we are** 




 Openhouse is building a new\-age learning ecosystem for children, bringing high\-quality
 



 learning experiences across academics, sports and extracurriculars closer to where children live.
 



 Backed by leading investors including Accel, Matrix Partners and GSV, Openhouse has grown to
 



 12 learning centres across Bangalore, reaching 10,000\+ children through our centres and
 



 programs. We are now taking this experience beyond our centres and into the communities
 



 where families live.
 



  





 Over the last three months, we have already gone live in 12\+ apartments, bringing Openhouse's
 



 learning experiences directly into residential communities. This is just the beginning. Our
 



 ambition is to build a significant At Apartment and At Home presence across Bangalore, making
 



 high\-quality learning accessible without children having to travel across the city.
 



  





**Why sports?** 




  





**Sports will be one of the strongest pillars of this expansion.** 




  





 Apartments already have something that makes sports uniquely powerful — children, facilities and
 



 communities in one place. Whether it is a badminton court, football ground, swimming pool,
 



 skating area or multipurpose space, there is an opportunity to turn existing community
 



 infrastructure into a vibrant sporting ecosystem for children.
 



  





 But great sports programs need more than just a facility. They need great coaches, strong
 



 academies, consistent operations and, importantly, opportunities for children to compete and
 



 progress.
 



  





  





**That's where openhouse comes in.** 




  





 We want to build a sports network where a child can discover a sport, find a great coach, train
 



 consistently, participate in competitions and progress — all within or close to their own
 



 community.
 



  





**about the role Preschool \& Extracurriculars** 




 We are looking for a Sports Category Manager who can build this ecosystem from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional vendor\-management or operations role. You will be responsible for
 



 building the supply side of Openhouse Sports — creating relationships with individual coaches
 



 and academies, identifying and onboarding great talent, and building a network that allows us to
 



 launch sports programs rapidly across apartments.
 



  





  





 There will be three key ways in which we build our sports network:
 



  





**1\. Build the supply ourselves** 




 Where an apartment has a sports facility but no coach, identify the requirement, find the right
 



 coach and deploy them.
 



  





  





**2\. Partner with individual coaches** 




 Identify talented coaches who are currently teaching independently but may be looking for a
 



 better professional opportunity. Give them access to multiple apartments and take away the
 



 operational workload, allowing them to focus on what they do best — coaching children.
 



  





  





**3\. Partner with established academies** 




 Work with existing cricket, football, badminton, swimming, skating, karate and other sports
 



 academies to bring their best coaches into Openhouse communities. In return, help these
 



 academies expand their footprint across Bangalore without disrupting their existing coach\-
 



 student ecosystem.
 



  





  





 Alongside this, you will help build an Openhouse sports competition ecosystem — inter\-
 



 apartment tournaments, leagues and events that give children opportunities to compete, create
 



 stronger community engagement and make sports a long\-term habit.
 



  





**what you will own Preschool \& Extracurriculars** 



* Build a strong network of individual coaches across major sports.
* Identify and establish partnerships with leading sports academies across Bangalore.
* Build a ready\-to\-deploy pool of coaches for new apartment launches.
* Own coach identification, evaluation and onboarding.
* Work with existing apartment coaches and explore opportunities to bring them into the



 Openhouse ecosystem.
 


* Map apartment facilities and requirements to the right coaches/academies.
* Build and manage long\-term relationships with coaches and academy partners.
* Work with the broader Openhouse team to launch sports programs across apartments.
* Track coach quality, parent feedback, attendance and retention.
* Build a calendar of tournaments, leagues and inter\-apartment competitions.
* Develop relationships with sports communities, clubs, tournament organisers and other



 relevant ecosystem players.
 


* Work with the marketing team to leverage competitions and sporting events for community



 engagement and brand visibility.
 



  





**who we’re looking for** 



* 3–5\+ years of experience in sports management, sports operations, academy management,



 coaching networks or a similar role.
 


* Strong understanding of the Bangalore sports ecosystem.
* Existing relationships with coaches, academies, clubs, sporting organisations or tournament



 organisers will be a significant advantage.
 


* Ideally, someone with a strong sports background who understands coaching, coaches and



 the sporting ecosystem.
 


* Exposure to multiple sports — cricket, football, badminton, swimming, skating, karate, tennis,



 squash etc.
 


* Strong relationship\-building and negotiation skills.
* Someone who is comfortable getting out of the office, meeting coaches and academy owners



 and building relationships on the ground.
 


* Strong execution orientation and an entrepreneurial mindset.
* Experience organising tournaments, leagues, competitions or sports events is highly desirable.



  





**Bangalore\-based** 
 with a strong local network.
 



  





**Success Metrics** 



* Your success will not simply be measured by the number of coaches onboarded.
* We want you to build the foundation of a
 **scalable Openhouse Sports ecosystem:**



**Great coaches → Great programs → More apartments → More children playing → More** 




**competitions → Stronger retention.** 



* Over the first 6–12 months, you should help us build a strong coach and academy network



 across Bangalore, enable rapid sports launches across apartments and establish competitions
 



 as a core part of the Openhouse sports experience.
 


* Ultimately, the ambition is simple: Make openhouse the most trusted sports partner for



 children and families living in communities across Bangalore.
 



  





**the practical bits** 



* Location: Bangalore
* Experience: 3\-5\+ years
* Function: Category Lead, Sports
* Reporting to: Head of Business \& Revenue

You’ll use customer and product data to identify strategic and at\-risk customers, deep dive into their behavior and engagement patterns to understand the underlying causes, and work with Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering to determine and drive appropriate actions.
 



 You’ll also work directly with customers and customer\-facing teams to understand issues, answer questions, and support customers who require additional attention. This position sits within the Product Team and serves as a bridge between customers and the teams responsible for improving the product experience.
 



 This is a remote opportunity for candidates located in India and requires regular overlap with U.S. working hours.
 



**What You'll Do** 




**Customer Engagement \& Risk Management (\~40%)** 



* Partner with Customer Success to identify and support strategic and at\-risk customers.
* Maintain a data\-informed view of customer engagement, adoption, and churn risk.
* Provide support to identified at\-risk customers and help ensure their concerns are addressed.
* Participate in customer meetings and product discussions to understand customer goals and challenges.
* Help identify and drive actions that improve customer engagement, adoption, and retention.



**Analytics \& Customer Investigation (\~20%)** 



* Regularly examine dashboards and customer/product usage data to identify customers with declining engagement, adoption risks, or other signals of churn.
* Deep dive into individual customer behavior and usage patterns to understand why engagement or adoption is changing.
* Investigate customer history, product usage, and other relevant signals to identify root causes.
* Develop clear, actionable findings and recommendations based on customer and product data.
* Track the impact of actions taken and use data to determine whether customer engagement or risk is improving.
* Build and maintain a reliable, data\-informed list of customers requiring attention.



**Product Partnership \& Customer Advocacy (\~20%)** 



* Bring customer findings, recurring issues, and product opportunities to Product Managers in a clear and actionable way.
* Partner with Product Management to investigate customer problems and validate potential solutions or workflows.
* Capture and synthesize customer feedback, enhancement requests, and recurring product challenges.
* Work with Solutions Engineering and Engineering when customer issues require deeper technical investigation or resolution.
* Validate new features and workflows with customers and share feedback to help improve the product experience.



**Cross\-Functional Customer \& Product Support (\~20%)** 



* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering to address customer questions and issues.
* Help troubleshoot customer\-reported product and data issues and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Support customer data onboarding, integrations, and account maintenance where applicable.
* Communicate customer issues and findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Follow issues through to resolution and ensure relevant customer\-facing teams are kept informed.



**Who You Are** 



* 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer\-facing SaaS role.
* Experience working directly with U.S.\-based customers and confidently leading customer conversations, presentations, and business reviews.
* Experience supporting or retaining strategic or at\-risk customers and understanding customer engagement or churn risk.
* Analytical and data\-driven, with experience using customer, product, or business data to identify risks, investigate customer behavior, and inform actions.
* Strong investigative and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to dig into customer issues, identify root causes, and determine appropriate next steps.
* Familiarity with customer\-facing web applications, data integrations, APIs, and common web technologies, with the ability to troubleshoot issues and work effectively with technical teams.
* Ability to work effectively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering teams.
* Strong communication, relationship\-building, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer engagements and priorities.
* Comfortable learning new products, workflows, and technical concepts quickly.
* Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of problems in a fast\-paced, changing environment.
* Ability and willingness to regularly work during required U.S. working hours.



 Nice to Have
 


* Experience in K\-12 education technology.
* Experience working with enterprise, strategic, or at\-risk customer accounts.
* Familiarity with student information systems (SIS), rostering systems, assessment platforms, or education data.
* Experience with SQL, APIs, data integrations, reporting tools, BI platforms, or CRM systems.
* Experience with Google Sheets or Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.



  
 **What We Offer** 



* Competitive pay, health insurance, accident insurance, life insurance, and a retirement savings plan.
* Paid annual leave, paid holidays, paid parental leave, paid leave for life events, and a paid year\-end holiday break.
* A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal wellbeing, including work from home funds, wellness checks, and more…



*Plus the intangible:* 



* A varied and challenging role in an innovative, global company.
* Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.

 Help organizations turn governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) goals into measurable business value. As a Client Success Advisor, you’ll guide key clients in configuring, adopting, and optimizing a GRC platform—strengthening retention, uncovering expansion opportunities, and helping teams work more effectively.
   

  

 You’ll combine GRC expertise, advisory skills, and a strong understanding of client needs to shape practical solutions, improve platform usage, and build lasting partnerships. Your work will influence client outcomes while contributing valuable insights to internal product and go\-to\-market teams.
   

  

**Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)**
* Advise clients on configuring, customizing, and optimizing GRC platform functionality to support their business processes and objectives.
* Assess client requirements, challenges, and goals, then recommend tailored solutions that deliver measurable value.
* Partner with clients on governance, risk, and compliance roadmaps, translating priorities into effective platform implementations.
* Drive adoption across the platform and its modules, identifying engagement risks and helping clients increase usage.
* Help clients identify and implement practical analytics use cases that improve automation, exception management, and reporting.
* Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, Support, and Sales teams to improve solutions based on real\-world client needs.
* Monitor regulatory developments, industry trends, and emerging GRC best practices to provide proactive, trusted advice.


**These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview**

title: Technical Implementation Manager
description:
**About Esper**
 Esper revolutionizes device management by redefining what it should be: a driver of business growth. With advanced and modern capabilities, automation replaces outdated workflows, re\-provisioning becomes obsolete, and managing by exception transforms efficiency, resulting in increased efficiency, improved ROI, and bolsters security for device fleets of all sizes. Esper has been recognized as number 735 on Inc. Magazine's 2025 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in America, and 133 on the 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500\. Some of the world’s most innovative brands, like Google, Doordash, Taco Bell, Clinical ink, SF 49ers, and Intelity, rely on Esper to deliver exceptional device experiences. Esper partners with the leading mobile device hardware manufacturers, solution providers, and distributors globally.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Technical Implementation Manager is the technical backbone of Esper’s customer accounts. This is an engineering role with a customer axis: TIMs own the implementation from contract sign through ful fleet scale, and they bring engineering\-level depth to every customer engagement. They build things, use AI as a daily tool, and hold the technical relationship inside every account they carry.
   

  

 TIMs operate as forward\-deployed technical experts alongside the Enterprise Account Manager. Together, they close the gap between contract sign and devices live, remove friction, resolve blockers, and connect the customer’s operational reality to Esper’s platform. The best TIMs know their accounts better than the customer knows themselves, and they use that knowledge to drive both customer success and Esper’s revenue growth.
   

  

 AI is not a side skill at Esper. TIMs are expected to use agentic AI tools across all facets of their responsibilities: accelerating implementation workflows, building automation and integration tooling, identifying optimal technical solutions, generating account insights, and forecasting customer behavior. The ability to build practical AI components that create real value for customers and the team is a core part of this role.
   

  

 Technical fluency at the device operations layer is non\-negotiable. TIMs must hold credible conversations with engineering teams and business stakeholders alike, without routing every question back to Esper Engineering.
   

  

**In Summary**
****Technical Implementation and Delivery****
* Own end\-to\-end device implementations from onboarding through full fleet rollout, including the project plan, escalation path, and all technical blockers
* Get hands\-on with devices, MDM software, and platform configuration; train customers to operate Esper independently


****Technical Expertise and Liaison****
* Serve as the primary technical escalation point: triage and resolve issues, engage Engineering only when required, and coordinate with hardware ecosystem partners (OEMs, ODMs, ISVs, VARs, 3PLs)
* Debug complex multi\-system issues, produce clear documentation, and provide deep expertise across Esper platform configuration, provisioning, and MDM/EMM architecture


****Account Management and Expansion****
* Partner with the Enterprise Account Manager on QBRs; surface expansion opportunities, maintain strong multilevel relationships, and advocate internally for customer needs with Product and Engineering
* Keep account records, device milestones, and next actions current in Salesforce


****Technical Engineering and AI****
* Use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, OpenCode, custom agents) daily across implementation planning, troubleshooting, automation, and documentation
* Leverage AI to generate account insights from calls, support history, and usage data to anticipate customer needs


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of Technical Delivery, Technical Implementation, Customer Engineering, or Solutions Engineering experience
* 2 or more years in a customer\-facing technical role with a revenue component (Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or similar)
* Demonstrated experience using agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot Workspace, or equivalent) as part of daily professional workflows; ability to build or configure AI skills, connectors, agents, and automated workflows
* Technical fluency at the device operations layer: Android, iOS, or Linux; MDM/EMM/UEM concepts; device provisioning, fleet configuration, and kiosk/POS environments
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across complex, multi\-system environments
* Proven ability to manage multiple implementations and customer accounts simultaneously without losing detail or urgency
* Strong communication and presentation skills: able to hold technical conversations with engineering teams and business conversations with executives in the same call
* Comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments without detailed specifications or runbooks
* Ability to travel approximately 5%


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Android/AOSP experience (device management, firmware, provisioning, build systems)
* Experience with MDM/EMM/UEM platforms
* Experience working with hardware ecosystem partners (OEMs, ODMs, VARs, 3PLs, ISVs)
* Background in device\-heavy verticals: QSR, retail, hospitality, healthcare, logistics, or payments
* Startup and enterprise experience; ability to operate effectively in both environments
* Proficiency with Salesforce or similar CRM as a system of record

title: Territory Business Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
 The role is accountable for sales targets \& delivery, ensuring timely collections, driving DG, and overseeing product liquidation in the assigned territory. The role requires effective market penetration, distributor and retailer management, and strong channel engagement while ensuring seamless execution of sales strategies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead DG, ensuring liquidation targets while acting as a knowledge hub on crop, pest, competition, and farmer practices for their territory.
* Work on segmentation, targeting, positioning, and preseason planning, ensuring execution of liquidation strategies.
* Drive sales through distributors and retailers, ensuring market penetration, share growth, and service excellence. Track distributor/retailer performance vs. POs, manage collections, and reconcile accounts.
* Monitor and consolidate product movement from distributor to retailer to farmer, ensuring accurate reporting of liquidation, inventory, and sales data.
* Strengthen distributor/retailer relationships, implement national programs, enforce trade discipline, manage stock returns, and communicate pricing and schemes.
* Liaise with KVKs, government agencies, and Agri. Dept. officials to drive local coordination.
* Work closely with ZDCLs \& ZBMs for seamless execution of DG activities and regularly update the sales team.
* Collaborate with the NC team to identify hotspots and connect farmers to VPDs.
* Supervise key DG activities, including farmer meetings and field days, ensuring strong market engagement.


**Activity Plan Breakdown**
* Retail Servicing \& Territory Planning (50%) – Ensure effective retail engagement, optimize territory coverage, and drive sales through planned servicing (13 days).
* Distribution Management (10%) – Strengthen distributor relationships, ensure stock availability, and streamline inventory operations (3 days).
* DG Delivery \& Supervision (30%) – Oversee DG initiatives, ensure execution excellence, and drive farmer engagement (8 days).
* Reporting, Planning \& Meetings (10%) – Track progress, analyse data, and align with teams for strategic decision\-making to create comprehensive territory channel \& sales strategy (3 days).


**Qualification, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor's / Master’s Degree in Agriculture.
* 3 to 5 years’ experience in agro\-input industry.
* Good communication \-oral and written\- in both English and local language.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Capability to achieve sales targets, by still retaining control on the market.
* Strong commercial acumen, understanding of the margin structure, conceptualizing schemes and articulating the advantages of our margins and schemes to the retailers and Distributors.

title: Key Account Manager, Maternity Hospitals (Multiple Cities)
description:
**About Us**
**BEMPU Health: Saving Lives, One Newborn at a Time**
 BEMPU Health is a purpose\-driven medical device company dedicated to improving newborn healthcare outcomes. We develop innovative, life\-saving devices for neonates, tackling critical challenges in resource\-limited settings. Funded by leading organizations like the Gates Foundation and USAID, our solutions are already making a difference in the lives of newborns in India and around the world. Our devices are used by UNICEF, government health programs, and top private hospitals, making a real impact on global newborn health. Join our mission and be part of something bigger!
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are hiring
 **Key Account Managers** 
 to own every private maternity hospital and hospital chain in their city. A single mid\-sized maternity hospital can become a substantial recurring account for us, so this is a role about depth rather than volume: landing new accounts, growing the ones we already have, and becoming the person every pediatrician and nursing superintendent in your city knows by name.
   

  

 We are hiring for
 **Bangalore, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune** 
 . Applicants from other cities are also welcome to apply.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the private maternity hospitals, nursing homes and hospital chains in your city as a named account list.
* Land new accounts: identify the high\-delivery\-volume hospitals, get the first meeting, place evaluation samples, and follow through to a first purchase order.
* Grow existing accounts by expanding from one product to our full range, and from one unit of the hospital to the whole facility.
* Build lasting relationships with neonatologists, pediatricians, nursing superintendents and procurement staff.
* Run in\-person product demonstrations and in\-service training for nursing and NICU staff.
* Maintain a territory coverage plan and log every visit, sample and outcome in our CRM.
* Feed back market intelligence on competitor activity, pricing and unmet clinical needs.
* Represent BEMPU at local medical conferences, CMEs and exhibitions.


**Requirements**
* 1 to 6 years of field or key account sales experience, ideally in medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare or pharma.
* A track record of meeting or exceeding targets in a B2B or healthcare setting.
* Existing relationships with pediatricians or neonatologists in your city are a strong advantage.
* High energy and a real willingness to travel within and around your city on a daily basis.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with clinicians and hospital staff quickly.
* Self\-motivated and able to manage your own schedule and territory with limited supervision.
* Good spoken English plus the main local language of your city.
* Basic proficiency with CRM or field reporting tools.
* Bachelor's degree; Science, Pharmacy or Business preferred.


**Benefits**
* A defined territory you genuinely own, with real targets and real rewards.
* Selling a product with published clinical evidence behind it, to clinicians who want it to work.
* Direct collaboration with BEMPU's leadership, product and clinical teams.
* Health insurance and statutory benefits as applicable.
* A clear growth path as the commercial team scales across cities.


**Start Date:** 
 As soon as possible.

title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 2\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health
* Experience in adopting and championing emerging delivery methodologies and tooling that accelerate team productivity, including experience adapting governance frameworks for new technology\-driven delivery models


**Preferred Qualifications**
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large\-scale programs
* MBA, or 3\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience in advising and influencing executive leadership
* Experience building trusted relationships with senior customer executives (VP\+) to influence strategic and operational decisions and managing escalation paths across complex stakeholder landscapes
* Experience in software development and proficiency in AI\-DLC or equivalent AI\-accelerated development methodologies at the governance and program leadership level, including experience adapting estimation, milestone tracking, and quality assurance frameworks for AI\-native delivery models


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
